66458.recognize_zh: 左圖手指掌面呈紫藍色斑駁變色 (acrocyanosis)，集中於指腹與指節；標示 R 的照片為接受兩劑 rituximab 後，手指膚色恢復正常，配合抗體 4+ 與冷凝集，支持冷抗體型自體免疫溶血。
features: Left panel (L): palmar surfaces of fingers with patchy violaceous to bluish mottled discoloration over the digits
Discoloration is distributed over distal and middle phalanges, sparing most of the palm
No visible ulceration, necrosis or digital gangrene of the fingers in this photograph
Right panel (R, after two doses of rituximab): fingers of both hands with normal pink skin color and no residual cyanosis
66458.describe_en: Clinical photographs show the palmar aspect of the fingers with patchy violaceous mottling consistent with acrocyanosis, without ulceration or necrosis visible on the digits. A comparison photograph taken after two doses of rituximab shows resolution of the discoloration with normal skin color. This is a clinical image rather than a morphologic specimen; in the setting of severe anemia, 4+ direct antiglobulin test with C3d positivity and red cell agglutination, the findings are consistent with cold antibody-mediated autoimmune hemolytic anemia with cold-induced acral circulatory symptoms responding to B-cell-directed therapy.

ddx.vs: Raynaud shows episodic, sharply demarcated triphasic (white-blue-red) color change and is not accompanied by hemolysis or a C3d-positive DAT.

Cryoglobulinemia causes acral purpura or necrosis with detectable cryoglobulins, low C4 and often vasculitic palpable purpura, and is confirmed by cryoprecipitate testing rather than cold agglutinin titer.
Embolic ischemia is usually asymmetric with fixed livedo, pain, necrosis and abnormal vascular studies, without resolution after rituximab.

66138.recognize_zh: 整個視野白血球極多，從前期細胞、骨髓球、後骨髓球到帶狀與分葉核中性球都有，右上還有一顆嗜鹼性球，呈 CML 的連續成熟光譜；上方箭頭細胞大、細胞質豐富且含嗜天青顆粒，下方箭頭細胞核偏心、細胞質粉紅，為骨髓球。注意上方細胞帶明顯顆粒，型態上較像前骨髓球而非典型骨髓母細胞。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: bands and segmented neutrophils, metamyelocytes, myelocytes and early precursors
Upper arrowed cell: large, moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm with azurophilic granules, oval nucleus with relatively fine chromatin
Lower arrowed cell: smaller cell with eccentric oval nucleus, more condensed chromatin and pinkish granular cytoplasm (myelocyte)
Basophil with coarse dark granules at upper right; a small lymphocyte at right
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
66138.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, including early precursors, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, with an accompanying basophil. The upper arrowed cell is a large immature granulocyte with an oval nucleus, relatively fine chromatin and moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules; its granularity favors a promyelocyte (or a granular blast) over an agranular myeloblast. The lower arrowed cell is a myelocyte with an eccentric nucleus, condensed chromatin and pink secondary granulation. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia; blast and basophil percentages should be enumerated by manual differential.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show predominantly mature neutrophils with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, few myelocytes, no basophilia and BCR::ABL1 negativity.
aCML shows striking dysgranulopoiesis (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger cells) with little basophilia, whereas granulocytes here are well granulated with a basophil present.
Leukoerythroblastosis has nucleated red cells and teardrop cells with a lower WBC and fewer myelocytes, unlike the dense granulocytic spectrum here.
Requires ≥20% blasts or extramedullary blast proliferation, which is not evident in this field where maturing forms dominate.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia — full granulocytic spectrum with basophil; arrowed cells are an early granular precursor (promyelocyte-like) and a myelocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：上箭頭帶 azurophilic 顆粒的大細胞、下箭頭核偏心粉紅胞質的細胞，分別問名稱；答 promyelocyte（或 granular blast）與 myelocyte。
CML 抹片典型：各階段顆粒球、myelocyte bulge、basophilia 與 eosinophilia；blast 通常 <10%（chronic phase）。
Blast 與 promyelocyte 的判讀直接影響分期；有 azurophilic 顆粒不必然排除 blast，但有明顯核周 Golgi 區與大量顆粒則偏 promyelocyte。
確診靠 BCR::ABL1；診斷時應做骨髓檢查含 karyotype 以評估 additional chromosomal abnormalities（如 +8、i(17q)、+Ph）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 上方顆粒豐富的大細胞易被直接數成 myeloblast 而高估 blast 比例；有明顯 azurophilic 顆粒與較豐富胞質時較符合 promyelocyte。

quiz.q: 下方箭頭所指的細胞是哪一成熟階段？右上方含粗大深色顆粒的細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Myelocyte；basophil。

65946.recognize_zh: 小淋巴球背景中散在具多葉、爆米花樣核的大型 LP 細胞，CD20 與 OCT2 強陽性並有 PD-1 T 細胞環繞；另一區域淋巴竇內有大型淡染組織球並吞入淋巴球（emperipolesis），S100 陽性，兩者並存為罕見的 RDD 合併 NLPBL 複合病灶。
features: Panel A: sheets of small lymphocytes with scattered large cells with multilobated, vesicular popcorn-like nuclei and small nucleoli (LP cells)
Panel B: CD20 highlights LP cells and background small B cells
Panel C: OCT2 strong nuclear staining in scattered large cells at low power
Panel D: PD-1-positive T cells in a patchy distribution corresponding to rosettes
Panel E: large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, round vesicular nuclei and engulfed lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
Panel F: S100 (red)/OCT2 (brown) double stain marking histiocytes (arrows) and scattered LP cells (arrowheads)
65946.describe_en: Lymph node excision shows vague nodular aggregates of small lymphocytes containing scattered large lymphocyte-predominant cells with multilobated, popcorn-like nuclei. The LP cells are CD20 and OCT2 positive and are surrounded by PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes. Separately, sinuses are expanded by large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and emperipolesis, which are S100 positive and also express OCT2. Findings are consistent with a composite lesion of nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell (Hodgkin) lymphoma and Rosai-Dorfman-Destombes disease.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte-rich background lacking small B-cell nodules and PD-1 rosettes.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15 positive with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/OCT2, unlike LP cells with strong CD20 and OCT2.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes lack emperipolesis and are S100 and cyclin D1 negative.
LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a and langerin, without emperipolesis.

65946.stain: H&E; IHC CD20, OCT2, PD-1; S100/OCT2 double

65754.recognize_zh: 組合圖：右下兩張高倍抹片見大型母細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性無顆粒，其中一顆細胞核一側凹陷呈杯狀（cup-shaped）；流式圖中紅色母細胞 TdT+、CD10+、cyIgM+、CD34 大多陰性，確認為前 B 型（pre-B）ALL，說明杯狀母細胞並非 AML 專屬。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli
Moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Nuclear invagination producing a cup-shaped (fish-mouth) nucleus in one blast in the right smear panel
Flow: blasts (red) CD45 positive, nuclear TdT positive, CD10 heterogeneously positive, CD20 largely negative
Flow: cytoplasmic IgM mu positive with CD34 mostly negative, defining a pre-B phenotype; residual B cells (blue) are CD20 bright/CD10 negative
65754.describe_en: The composite shows flow cytometry plots and two high-power smear panels. The smears show large blasts with fine chromatin, faint nucleoli and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm; one blast shows a prominent nuclear invagination giving a cup-shaped nucleus. The flow plots show a dominant blast population (red) that is CD45 positive, nuclear TdT positive, CD10 heterogeneously positive, CD20 largely negative and cytoplasmic IgM positive, with CD34 expressed only on a minority. Findings are consistent with pre-B acute lymphoblastic leukemia with cup-shaped blast morphology.

ddx.vs: NPM1-mutated AML cup-like blasts are typically CD34 and HLA-DR negative, MPO positive and lack TdT/CD19/cyIgM.
Myeloid cup-shaped blasts express CD13/CD33/CD117 and lack cytoplasmic CD79a and TdT with B-lineage markers.
Burkitt cells are TdT negative with surface light chain restriction and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm.
Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum of CD10/CD20/CD34 on flow rather than a discrete expanded population.

65690.recognize_zh: 三個嗜中性球周圍各被一圈緊貼細胞膜的血小板環繞（像衛星一樣），而背景游離血小板很少；這是 EDTA 引起的血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），會造成假性血小板減少。
features: Three segmented neutrophils, each rimmed by a ring of small platelets adherent to the cell membrane
Platelets are normal-sized, granular and not internalized within the neutrophil cytoplasm
Neutrophils otherwise normal with fine granules and segmented nuclei
Very few free platelets in the background
Red cells normocytic, normochromic
65690.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several segmented neutrophils encircled by rosettes of normal-appearing platelets adherent to their surface membranes, without evidence of platelet phagocytosis. Free platelets in the background are sparse, and the neutrophils and red cells are otherwise morphologically unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can produce a spuriously low automated platelet count; a repeat count in citrate or a heparin tube is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps form free-floating aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings attached to neutrophils.
In phagocytosis the platelets lie inside the neutrophil cytoplasm, often within vacuoles, instead of on its outer surface.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without satellites or clumps and persists when recounted in a citrate tube.
Bacteria are smaller, uniform, deeply basophilic and lack the granular platelet texture.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — rosettes of normal platelets adherent to neutrophil membranes, causing EDTA-related pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：病人血小板計數很低但無出血，給這張血片問「為什麼」：platelet satellitism 造成自動計數儀假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）。
機轉：EDTA 抗凝下，病人的 IgG 自體抗體使血小板黏附於嗜中性球表面；屬體外現象，與疾病活性或出血風險無關。
處置：以 citrate（或 heparin）採血管重測並校正稀釋倍數，或指血直接抹片/手動計數；避免不必要的血小板輸注、骨髓檢查或 ITP 治療。
每次遇到自動血小板偏低都應先看血片：EDTA 誘發的血小板凝集（常在羽毛緣）與衛星現象是兩大常見假性原因，也可能同時存在。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為嗜中性球吞噬血小板：衛星現象的血小板位於細胞膜外緣排成環；吞噬時血小板位於嗜中性球細胞質內，常在空泡中。

quiz.q: 病人自動計數血小板極低，血片見血小板環繞嗜中性球，此現象叫什麼？下一步如何確認真正血小板數？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism；改用 citrate 管重測（或手動/指血計數）

65626.recognize_zh: 單一母細胞核染色質細緻、核質比高，細胞質中可見一條細長、紅紫色的針狀包涵體（Auer rod），這是骨髓系母細胞的特徵，確立為急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞。
features: Single large blast, approximately 2 times red cell diameter, with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely granular, open chromatin
Scant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
One slender, rod-shaped, pink-red azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion (Auer rod) at the cell edge
Background normochromic red cells without other nucleated cells
65626.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a large blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains a single slender, needle-shaped azurophilic inclusion consistent with an Auer rod. The background red cells are unremarkable. The presence of an Auer rod establishes the myeloid lineage of the blast; findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia (or high-grade myeloid neoplasm with circulating blasts).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative.
APL cells contain bundles of multiple Auer rods and heavy azurophilic granules with bilobed nuclei, rather than a single rod in an agranular blast.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Auer rod / platelet overlying a cell or stain artifact
ddx.vs: True Auer rods lie within the cytoplasm in the focal plane and are MPO positive, whereas overlying debris is out of plane and MPO negative.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, irregular patches in the cytoplasm of mature neutrophils, not red rods in a blast.

exam.answer_en: Myeloblast with Auer rod — single slender azurophilic needle-like rod proving myeloid lineage (AML)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著細針狀包涵體問名稱與意義；答 Auer rod，由融合的 primary (azurophilic) granules 組成，確立骨髓系，排除 ALL。
細胞化學：Auer rod 為 MPO 與 Sudan black B 陽性；MPO ≥3% blasts 陽性支持骨髓系。
單一細長、兩端尖的 Auer rod 常見於 AML with t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1；多條成束（faggot cells）則見於 APL t(15;17) PML::RARA。
若為 APL 需立即處理 DIC 並啟動 ATRA，不待基因確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把紅血球重疊邊緣、血小板落在細胞上或染料沉澱誤認為 Auer rod；真 Auer rod 位於細胞質內、呈粉紅紫色、與細胞同焦平面。

quiz.q: 此母細胞細胞質內的針狀構造是什麼？它證明母細胞屬於哪一系？
quiz.a: Auer rod；myeloid lineage（AML）。

65562.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中，顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞的細胞質都有清楚的空泡（vacuolation），顆粒球顆粒減少，並伴有含鐵血黃素巨噬細胞與低細胞密度骨髓；兒童出現前驅細胞空泡要想到 Pearson 症候群。
features: Myeloid precursors (panels B-D) with hypogranular cytoplasm and multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Erythroid precursors with cytoplasmic vacuolation (panels E-F)
Hemosiderin-laden macrophage with coarse golden-brown pigment (panel E)
Monolobate megakaryocyte (panel G)
Fat-rich aspirate particle (panel A) and hypocellular biopsy with increased fat (panel H)
65562.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a fat-rich particle at low power. At high power, myeloid precursors are hypogranular and contain multiple sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, and similar vacuolation is present in erythroid precursors; a hemosiderin-laden macrophage and a monolobate megakaryocyte are also seen. The accompanying core biopsy is hypocellular with predominance of fat. In a child with cytopenias, findings are consistent with the vacuolated precursors and hypocellular marrow of Pearson marrow-pancreas syndrome; confirmation requires mitochondrial DNA deletion testing and iron stain for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Produces nearly identical vacuolated myeloid and erythroid precursors with ring sideroblasts and is separated by serum copper/ceruloplasmin and zinc levels rather than morphology.
Drug- or alcohol-related vacuolation is reversible and occurs in adults with exposure history, whereas Pearson syndrome presents in infancy with mtDNA deletion.
MDS shows clonal dysplasia with cytogenetic abnormalities, and prominent vacuolation of precursors is not a typical feature.

ddx.dx: Fanconi anemia or other inherited marrow failure
ddx.vs: These show hypocellular marrow without prominent precursor vacuolation and are diagnosed by chromosome breakage or genetic testing.

65434.recognize_zh: 血中異常細胞呈深藍嗜鹼性細胞質帶多個透明空泡，外觀像 Burkitt 細胞；但流式顯示 CD10+、CD34 部分陽性、表面輕鏈陰性的前驅 B 細胞，光學基因組定位找到隱匿性 MEF2D::BCL9 融合，實為 B-ALL。
features: Panel A: medium to large blasts with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin and visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles (Burkitt-like)
Panel B: CD19-positive cells lacking surface kappa and lambda, CD38-positive, with CD10 positivity and a CD34-positive subset
Panels C-D: Circos plots showing clustered chromothripsis-like rearrangements of chromosome 1 including MEF2D and BCL9
Panel E: optical genome mapping alignment demonstrating the MEF2D::BCL9 junction
65434.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium to large atypical cells with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, visible nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple clear vacuoles, closely resembling Burkitt lymphoma cells. Flow cytometry shows a CD19-positive population lacking surface immunoglobulin light chains, with CD10 expression and a CD34-positive subset (TdT reported positive, CD20 negative), indicating a precursor B-cell phenotype. Optical genome mapping demonstrates chromothripsis-like rearrangement of chromosome 1 with a cryptic MEF2D::BCL9 fusion. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with MEF2D rearrangement, mimicking Burkitt lymphoma morphologically.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are mature B cells with surface light chain restriction, CD20 positivity, TdT and CD34 negativity, and MYC rearrangement, none of which apply here.

ddx.dx: B-ALL with TCF3::PBX1 or other subtypes
ddx.vs: Other B-ALL subtypes share the precursor phenotype and can have vacuoles, so the MEF2D::BCL9 subtype is assigned only by genomic testing.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic or erythroid leukemia with vacuoles
ddx.vs: Vacuolated myeloid or erythroid blasts express MPO/CD64/CD14 or CD71/E-cadherin, not CD19/CD10/TdT.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: HGBL is a mature surface Ig-positive, TdT-negative lymphoma with MYC/BCL2 rearrangements by FISH, which were not found.

65242.recognize_zh: 中央一顆雙核的嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞（binucleate erythroblast），細胞質深藍、兩個核大小相近，是紅血球生成異常（dyserythropoiesis）的例子；周圍有顆粒粗大的桿狀與分葉嗜中性球。
features: Binucleate basophilic erythroblast with two similar-sized nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei with coarse granular chromatin and perinuclear clearing
Adjacent band and segmented neutrophils with coarse granulation
Myelocytes and scattered erythroid precursors in the background
Background of platelets and red cells without increased blasts
65242.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a binucleate basophilic erythroblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and two symmetric nuclei, indicating dyserythropoiesis. Nearby granulocytes, including bands and segmented neutrophils, show coarse granulation, and myelocytes are present. Blasts are not increased in this field, and prominent vacuolization is not evident in the erythroblast shown. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the dyserythropoiesis described in VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows identical multinucleated erythroblasts, so UBA1 sequencing, precursor vacuoles and inflammatory features are needed to identify VEXAS.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, rather than the coarse chromatin seen here.
CDA II shows many binucleate late erythroblasts from childhood with SEC23B mutation and normal granulopoiesis.

65306.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒中有多顆巨噬細胞，細胞質內充滿許多深紫色小點狀體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），並吞噬有核細胞（噬血現象）；視野中也可見游離於細胞外的小點狀原蟲，符合利什曼原蟲病。
features: Marrow particle containing numerous macrophages with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Many tiny dark purple dot-like intracytoplasmic organisms (amastigotes) within macrophages
Macrophages containing engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells, indicating hemophagocytosis
Extracellular amastigotes scattered around disrupted macrophages
Low-intermediate magnification precludes resolution of the nucleus-kinetoplast doublet
65306.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing numerous macrophages admixed with hematopoietic cells. Many macrophages contain multiple tiny dark-staining intracytoplasmic bodies, and several show phagocytosed nucleated cells. Similar bodies are also seen extracellularly adjacent to disrupted macrophages. At this magnification the nucleus and kinetoplast cannot be resolved, so oil-immersion review is advised. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis with associated hemophagocytosis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a surrounding clear halo, lack a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS-positive, whereas amastigotes show a nucleus plus rod-shaped kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Primary or other secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
ddx.vs: HLH from other causes shows hemophagocytosis without intracellular or extracellular punctate organisms.
Superimposed platelets lie in different focal planes, are granular and irregular, and lack the uniform oval nucleus-kinetoplast structure of amastigotes.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis with hemophagocytosis — marrow macrophages containing Leishman-Donovan bodies and engulfed nucleated cells
pearls_zh: 考法：同一張圖考兩件事：巨噬細胞內 LD bodies，以及吞噬有核細胞的 hemophagocytosis。
Leishmaniasis 是 secondary HLH 的重要可治療病因；HLH 病人（尤其有流行區旅遊史）應在骨髓仔細找 LD bodies。
HLH-2004 條件（8 項符合 5 項）：發燒、脾腫大、血球低下、高三酸甘油酯或低 fibrinogen、噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 升高。
治療原發感染（liposomal amphotericin B）常可使 leishmania 相關 HLH 緩解。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞外 amastigotes 易誤認為血小板；血小板無核、呈顆粒狀，amastigote 有核與 kinetoplast 的雙點結構，需油鏡確認。

quiz.q: 此圖除 LD bodies 外另一個重要現象是什麼？與哪個症候群相關？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；secondary HLH

65178.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與凝塊切片中巨核細胞數量增加、體積大且核分葉過多（hyperlobated），而網狀纖維染色未見明顯纖維化，搭配持續血小板增多，符合原發性血小板增多症樣表現（本例為 JAK2 R564Q 家族性）。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with trilineage hematopoiesis and several megakaryocytes at low power
Large megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and hyperlobated/hypersegmented nuclei
Clot section: megakaryocytes with large, deeply lobulated nuclei loosely scattered among hematopoietic cells and fat
No obvious atypical clustering or bare hyperchromatic megakaryocyte nuclei
Reticulin stain shows no significant increase in fibers
65178.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with trilineage hematopoiesis and increased megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are large with abundant granular cytoplasm and hyperlobulated nuclei. Clot sections show a cellular marrow with scattered large, hyperlobated megakaryocytes, without significant clustering. Reticulin stain shows no significant fibrosis. Findings are consistent with a thrombocytosis with essential thrombocythemia-like megakaryocytic morphology, correlating with the familial JAK2 R564Q variant.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal in size and lobation, not the giant hyperlobulated forms seen here.

Pre-PMF shows hypercellularity with granulocytic proliferation and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei, rather than loosely dispersed staghorn megakaryocytes.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf forms) with marked granulocytic hyperplasia, and BCR::ABL1 is present.
Morphology overlaps with ET, so family studies and germline sequencing are needed to distinguish inherited from sporadic clonal disease.

65114.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量單一型態的中型細胞佔滿，細胞質深藍色（強嗜鹼性）並布滿許多邊界清楚、打孔狀的小空泡（脂質空泡），核圓、染色質細點狀、有數個小核仁；深藍細胞質加上密集空泡是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞的經典抹片表現。
features: Diffuse replacement of the aspirate by a monotonous population of medium-sized lymphoid cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply punched-out, round clear vacuoles
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled chromatin and multiple small nucleoli
Moderately high N:C ratio with cohesive-appearing crowding due to smear thickness
Scattered intermixed RBCs and rare residual normal elements; some cells show magenta tone from staining variation
65114.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is extensively infiltrated by a monotonous population of medium-sized cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and several small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous discrete, sharply punched-out clear vacuoles, some of which overlie the nuclei. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. The starry-sky pattern is a histologic feature and is not assessable on this aspirate smear. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+, surface light chain-restricted, TdT-) and MYC rearrangement is required.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm, finer chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and usually few vacuoles, and they are TdT+ with absent surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with less uniform vacuolation, and lack the Ki-67 near 100% with isolated MYC rearrangement typical of Burkitt.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts have abundant greyer cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and are MPO/NSE or CD14/CD64 positive rather than B-cell marker positive.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138+/CD20- rather than CD20+/CD10+.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma in bone marrow — monotonous medium cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and numerous punched-out lipid vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：指深藍細胞質帶打孔空泡的細胞問診斷；答 Burkitt lymphoma（舊 FAB L3），空泡為中性脂質，Oil Red O 陽性。
遺傳：MYC 重排，最常見 t(8;14) IGH::MYC，另有 t(2;8) IGK::MYC、t(8;22) IGL::MYC；Ki-67 接近 100%。
表型：CD19、CD20、CD10、BCL6 陽性，表面 Ig 輕鏈限制，TdT 陰性、BCL2 陰性或弱；組織切片呈 starry-sky。
臨床急症：腫瘤增殖極快，化療前後易發 tumor lysis syndrome（高尿酸、高鉀、高磷、腎衰竭），需積極水化與 rasburicase，並做 CNS 預防治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 B-lymphoblastic leukemia；Burkitt 為成熟 B 細胞、TdT 陰性、表面 Ig 陽性，需用 Burkitt 專屬強化療程而非 ALL 療程。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質空泡內含何種物質？最常見的特徵性染色體轉位為何？
quiz.a: 中性脂質（Oil Red O 陽性）；t(8;14)(q24;q32) IGH::MYC。

64922.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞的細胞質布滿大小不一的空泡，內含一顆深染、濃縮的有核細胞核（被吞噬的淋巴球或紅血球前驅細胞），旁邊另有一個含淡染被吞噬紅血球的空泡，巨噬細胞本身有不規則形細胞核，為典型吞噬血球現象。
features: Large macrophage with abundant, extensively vacuolated (foamy) grey-purple cytoplasm
Engulfed nucleated cell with a dense, round, pyknotic nucleus (lymphocyte or erythroblast) within the cytoplasm
Clear phagocytic vacuole containing a pale ingested red cell
Macrophage nucleus irregular and elongated with fine, open chromatin
Surrounding red cells and scattered platelets, some adherent to the macrophage surface
64922.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and an irregular, elongated nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains an engulfed nucleated cell with a dense pyknotic nucleus and a separate vacuole containing a phagocytosed red cell. Platelets are scattered in the background and adherent to the cell. No atypical lymphoma cells are present in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, in keeping with immune effector cell-associated HLH-like syndrome after CAR T-cell therapy in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain fragmented apoptotic nuclear debris, whereas this macrophage contains an intact whole nucleated cell and a red cell.
Storage cells have wrinkled tissue-paper (Gaucher) or uniformly foamy lipid-laden cytoplasm without ingested intact blood cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet ring or vacuolated tumor cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show nuclear atypia and cohesive clusters with mucin vacuoles, not a bland histiocytic nucleus with phagocytosed blood cells.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis after CAR T-cell therapy — foamy vacuolated macrophage containing an ingested pyknotic nucleated cell and a red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：辨認巨噬細胞內兩種被吞物：深染濃縮的有核細胞核（lymphocyte 或 erythroblast）與淡染紅血球；兩者都位於空泡內才算真正吞噬。
CAR-T 後血球低下可為早期（與 CRS 相關）或延遲、雙相型；持續血球低下時骨髓檢查用來排除復發、感染、MDS 與 IEC-HS。
HLH 相關實驗室追蹤：ferritin、fibrinogen、triglyceride、AST/ALT、LDH；ferritin 在 CRS 也會升高，需看趨勢與臨床整體判斷。
被吞噬的淋巴球可能包括 CAR-T 細胞本身；過度活化的 T 細胞釋放 IFN-γ 驅動巨噬細胞活化，是 HLH 樣反應的核心機轉。
exam.pitfall_zh: 紅血球或血小板黏附在巨噬細胞表面易被誤判為吞噬；真正噬血時被吞物有清楚空泡包覆並與細胞質同焦平面，表面附著者則位於細胞邊緣外。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞空泡內可見哪兩種被吞入的血球成分？
quiz.a: 有核細胞（濃縮核，淋巴球或 erythroblast）與紅血球。

64858.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的晚期紅血球母細胞細胞質內有數顆小圓形深紫色核碎片（類 Howell-Jolly 小體），左中方另有一顆細胞核完全碎裂成許多小團塊（karyorrhexis），在骨髓抹片中屬於紅系造血不良的表現。
features: Small late erythroblasts (arrows) with round dense nuclei
Several tiny round dark-purple Howell-Jolly body-like fragments in the perinuclear cytoplasm
Erythroblast with nucleus broken into multiple discrete clumps (karyorrhexis), center-left
Cellular marrow with granulocytic precursors bearing pink granules and segmented neutrophils
Large cells with open chromatin and a dense dark megakaryocytic fragment at the upper right
64858.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with myeloid precursors at various stages of maturation and erythroid precursors. Several erythroblasts contain small round basophilic nuclear fragments resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (arrows), and one erythroblast shows karyorrhexis with nuclear breakdown into multiple clumps. These are features of dyserythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with erythroid dysplasia as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm, with correlation to cytogenetics and exclusion of secondary causes recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroblasts are enlarged with open sieve-like chromatin and are accompanied by giant metamyelocytes.
Mitoses show condensed chromosomes arranged in a plate or rosette without surrounding intact nuclear membrane, rather than round separate fragments.
Iron granules are small, irregular and Prussian blue positive, often forming a perinuclear ring on iron stain.
Toxic dyserythropoiesis may look similar but shows basophilic stippling in peripheral red cells and a relevant exposure history.

64602.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中大量小而緻密、無中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜偏藍的多染性紅血球與數個有核紅血球，並可見紅血球小團塊聚集，符合免疫性血管外溶血。
features: Numerous spherocytes: small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor
Increased polychromatophilic red cells (larger, bluish-gray)
Scattered nucleated red blood cells with small dense pyknotic nuclei
Small red cell aggregates/clumps in the thin area of the film
Occasional neutrophils and markedly reduced platelets
No schistocytes identified at this magnification
64602.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with a prominent population of spherocytes and conspicuous polychromasia. Several circulating nucleated red blood cells are present, along with small red cell aggregates. Scattered neutrophils are seen and platelets are markedly decreased; no significant schistocytes are identified at this power. In the setting of a recent RhD-incompatible transfusion and a positive direct antiglobulin test, findings are consistent with extravascular immune hemolysis due to a delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction.

ddx.vs: HS shows spherocytes with a negative DAT, family history, and no nucleated RBC surge or red cell clumping tied to recent transfusion, whereas DHTR is DAT-positive with a new alloantibody.

Morphology is identical (spherocytes, polychromasia); separation relies on eluate specificity—an alloantibody against transfused antigen (e.g. anti-D) in DHTR versus a panreactive autoantibody in WAIHA.
Cold agglutinins produce large irregular RBC agglutinates that disperse on warming with DAT positive for C3 only, rather than predominant spherocytes with IgG-mediated extravascular hemolysis.
TTP also causes severe thrombocytopenia but shows schistocytes with a negative DAT, whereas this film is dominated by spherocytes without evident fragments.

exam.answer_en: Delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction — numerous spherocytes with polychromasia and nucleated red cells (extravascular immune hemolysis)
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍大量 spherocyte 加 polychromasia，問「最可能機轉」；答 IgG 介導的血管外免疫溶血，搭配輸血史指向 DHTR。
DHTR 典型發生於輸血後約 3–14 天，由先前致敏產生的 anamnestic alloantibody 造成，常見抗 Kidd（Jk）、Rh、Kell、Duffy 抗原。
檢驗：DAT 陽性（IgG ± C3），eluate 可找到針對輸入紅血球抗原的 alloantibody；Hb 回落、LDH 與間接膽紅素上升。
Kidd 抗體效價易隨時間下降而在抗體篩檢中漏掉，是 DHTR 經典成因；鐮刀型貧血病人可發生 hyperhemolysis。
處置：找出抗體後輸注對應抗原陰性血，並登錄抗體紀錄避免再次發生。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 hereditary spherocytosis 或 warm AIHA：HS 為 DAT 陰性；WAIHA 形態相同但 eluate 為泛反應性 autoantibody；DHTR 的 eluate 則是針對特定輸入抗原的 alloantibody。

quiz.q: 圖中大量小而緻密、無中央淡染區的紅血球叫什麼？輸血後數天出現此抹片，應先做哪項檢查？
quiz.a: Spherocytes；DAT（direct antiglobulin test），陽性時做 eluate 與抗體鑑定。

64730.recognize_zh: 箭頭上方有一小群直徑約 2–4 µm、圓到卵圓形的紫色小體，聚集在破裂的巨噬細胞附近，是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigotes）；周圍可見許多具偏心核與核旁淡染區的漿細胞。
features: Small cluster of tiny round-to-oval purple bodies (amastigotes) near a disrupted macrophage, partly extracellular
Organisms far smaller than a red cell, uniform in size; kinetoplast difficult to resolve at this magnification
Numerous plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei, perinuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm (reactive plasmacytosis)
Mixed marrow precursors including myelocytes, band neutrophils and erythroblasts
No yeast capsules or budding forms
64730.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular background with granulocytic and erythroid precursors and an increased number of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear clearing. Above the arrow, a cluster of small, uniform round-to-oval organisms lies within and around the remnants of a disrupted macrophage. The organisms are much smaller than red cells; their kinetoplasts are not clearly resolved in this photograph. In context, findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes in the bone marrow with reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma shows a surrounding clear halo and lacks a kinetoplast, while Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus and a distinct bar-shaped kinetoplast.
Platelets are irregular granular fragments of variable size without internal structure, unlike uniform oval organisms with a defined nucleus.
The plasma cells here are mature-appearing and accompany organisms; neoplastic plasma cells would be atypical and show light-chain restriction.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent/banana-shaped with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast, rather than round-oval bodies.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis — cluster of Leishmania amastigotes near a disrupted macrophage, with reactive plasmacytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：amastigote 散在細胞外、巨噬細胞已破裂時，考官會問「為何仍判為寄生蟲而非血小板」；答大小均一的卵圓體且具核與 kinetoplast 結構。
骨髓背景漿細胞增多是 kala-azar 的伴隨特徵，反映多株性高 γ 球蛋白血症，不應誤判為漿細胞腫瘤。
骨髓抽吸找 amastigote 的敏感度低於脾抽吸，但出血風險較低，臨床較常用。
流行地區旅遊史（地中海、中東、南亞、東非、巴西）與 HIV 共病是重要病史線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把散在細胞外的 amastigote 當成血小板團：血小板為不規則顆粒狀碎片、大小不一且無內部結構；amastigote 大小一致、呈卵圓形並具核與 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 此骨髓背景中漿細胞增多，對應 visceral leishmaniasis 的哪一項實驗室表現？
quiz.a: 多株性高 γ 球蛋白血症（polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia）。

64666.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球細胞質內有一個橢圓形小酵母，中央是收縮的淡藍色細胞質，外圍有一圈不著色的空暈（capsule-like halo），這種胞內帶暈的小酵母是 Histoplasma capsulatum 的線索。
features: Neutrophil with five nuclear lobes (hypersegmented appearance) and coarse toxic-type granulation
Single intracellular oval yeast about 2–4 µm within the cytoplasm
Yeast shows retracted pale basophilic cytoplasm surrounded by a clear, poorly stained halo with a thin rim (pseudocapsule)
No budding forms or additional organisms clearly identified in this field
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional crenated forms
64666.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a neutrophil with a hypersegmented-appearing nucleus and prominent cytoplasmic granulation. Within its cytoplasm is a small oval yeast form with retracted basophilic cytoplasm and a surrounding clear, capsule-like halo. Only a single organism is evident in this field, although the description reports multiple yeasts. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum in a patient with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirm with culture, antigen testing, or GMS/PAS stains.

ddx.vs: Candida yeasts are larger, show budding and pseudohyphae, and lack the clear retraction halo around a small central cytoplasmic body.
Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and usually resides in macrophages rather than neutrophils.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a transverse central septum from fission rather than budding, a key morphologic separator in endemic Southeast Asian patients.
Döhle bodies are pale blue irregular cytoplasmic patches without a defined wall or halo, and debris lacks the uniform ovoid yeast structure.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — small oval intracellular yeast with a clear pseudocapsular halo within a neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：指中性球內帶透明暈的小圓體問「是什麼病原？」——答 Histoplasma capsulatum；halo 是細胞質收縮造成，並非真正莢膜。
周邊血看到病原代表高菌量的瀰漫性感染，常見於晚期 HIV、器官移植、使用 TNF inhibitor 等免疫低下者。
確認檢查：血液/骨髓培養（需時較久）、尿液或血清 Histoplasma antigen、組織 GMS 或 PAS 染色；瀰漫性感染可合併 HLH。
治療：中重度瀰漫性感染以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，之後改 itraconazole 維持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 在台灣與東南亞最需要區分 Talaromyces marneffei；後者呈長橢圓形、以分裂增殖並有中央橫隔，Histoplasma 為小卵圓形、窄基出芽，Leishmania 則有 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 中性球內這個帶透明暈的小酵母最可能是什麼？與 Talaromyces marneffei 形態上靠什麼區分？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；T. marneffei 呈長形並有中央橫隔（fission），Histoplasma 為出芽、無橫隔

64474.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞的細胞質內塞滿數十個 2–4 µm 的小圓形或卵圓形紫色小體，部分可見大的核與旁邊小點狀的動基體（kinetoplast），即利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan body）。
features: Large macrophage with a single oval nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous small (about 2-4 µm) round to oval intracytoplasmic organisms with dense purple nuclei
Some organisms show a second, smaller rod- or dot-like kinetoplast adjacent to the nucleus
Organisms lack a surrounding clear halo or capsule and are not budding
Background: neutrophils, a small lymphocyte, red cells, stripped elongated nuclei and fibrin/smear strands
64474.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a large macrophage whose cytoplasm contains numerous small, round to oval intracellular organisms, each with a purple nucleus and, in several, a smaller adjacent dot-like kinetoplast. No capsule or halo surrounds the organisms. The background contains neutrophils, lymphocytes, red cells, and stripped nuclei. The specimen site is not specified. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies), as seen in visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo (pseudocapsule), show narrow-based budding, and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped and lack a kinetoplast.
T. marneffei yeasts are elongated with a transverse central septum (fission) instead of a nucleus-kinetoplast pair.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying a macrophage or phagocytosed debris
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets lie in different planes with granular pink centers, lacking the uniform nucleus plus kinetoplast structure.

exam.answer_en: Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies) — numerous intramacrophage organisms each with a nucleus and adjacent rod-like kinetoplast
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨噬細胞內小圓體問「是 Histoplasma 還是 Leishmania？」——關鍵是每隻有「核＋旁邊小棒狀 kinetoplast」，且無透明暈。
Visceral leishmaniasis（kala-azar）：L. donovani / L. infantum，白蛉（sandfly）傳播；表現發燒、巨脾、全血球低下與高 γ-globulin 血症。
診斷：脾臟抽吸敏感度最高但有出血風險，骨髓抽吸較安全；rK39 快速抗體檢測與 PCR 輔助；免疫低下（HIV）者抗體可能偽陰性。
治療以 liposomal amphotericin B 為主；visceral leishmaniasis 可引發 secondary HLH，骨髓同時出現噬血現象時要記得找原蟲。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Histoplasma capsulatum 混淆；Histoplasma 有透明暈、會出芽、無 kinetoplast，Leishmania 無暈並有核與 kinetoplast 的雙點結構。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內這些小圓體除了核之外還有哪個構造可用來確認是 Leishmania？
quiz.a: Kinetoplast（位於核旁的小棒狀/點狀構造）

64410.recognize_zh: 紅血球內血紅素被推擠到細胞一側，另一側只剩一層薄膜包住的蒼白空泡狀區域（blister/eccentrocyte 樣外觀），這種偏心分布的無血紅素區是氧化性溶血（如 G6PD 缺乏症）的線索。
features: Normocytic red cells with hemoglobin retracted/condensed to one side of the cell
Sharply demarcated clear, vacuole-like zone bounded by a thin intact membrane (blister cells)
Some cells with a central or irregular pale blister rather than a peripheral one
Small dark punctate bodies within cells and at the membrane edge (possible Heinz bodies versus stain precipitate; not resolvable at this resolution)
Clean background without spherocyte clusters or schistocytes in these fields
64410.describe_en: Composite high-power views of a peripheral blood smear show several red cells in which hemoglobin is displaced to one side, leaving a clear, membrane-bound blister-like zone. Some cells contain multiple small dark punctate inclusions, several abutting the membrane; their nature (Heinz bodies versus precipitate) cannot be confirmed without a supravital stain, and image resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with blister cells/eccentrocytes, suggestive of oxidant hemolysis such as G6PD deficiency.

ddx.vs: Bite cells show a peripheral notch where the membrane edge is removed, whereas blister cells retain a thin membrane enclosing a hemoglobin-free space.
Stomatocytes have a central slit-like pallor, not an eccentric membrane-bound clear zone with hemoglobin pushed to the opposite side.
Artifact vacuoles are refractile, variably shaped and focus-dependent, and are not accompanied by condensed hemoglobin crowding to one side.
Pappenheimer bodies are small basophilic granule clusters without blister formation and stain with Prussian blue, whereas Heinz bodies require supravital stains.

exam.answer_en: Blister cells (eccentrocyte-like) — hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a membrane-bound clear zone, suggesting oxidant hemolysis such as G6PD deficiency
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球一側的透明泡狀區問「這是什麼細胞？聯想什麼疾病？」答 blister cell/eccentrocyte，氧化性溶血，最常見為 G6PD deficiency。
G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked，台灣列入新生兒篩檢；誘因包括蠶豆、感染、oxidant 藥物（primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase）及樟腦丸（naphthalene）。
Heinz bodies 需 supravital stain（crystal violet、new methylene blue）才看得到，Wright 染色看不見；脾臟移除 Heinz bodies 形成 bite cells。
急性溶血期 G6PD 活性可能偽正常（老紅血球已破壞、網狀紅血球酶活性高），臨床懷疑時應於數月後複驗。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 bite cell 混淆；bite cell 邊緣有缺口、該處細胞膜已被移除，blister cell 則保留薄膜包住無血紅素區，兩者常在氧化性溶血中並存。

quiz.q: 要看到這類溶血中紅血球內的變性血紅素沉積物，需用什麼染色？
quiz.a: Supravital stain（crystal violet 或 new methylene blue）看 Heinz bodies。

64282.recognize_zh: 血小板減少情境下的血片可見盔形細胞與紅血球碎片（schistocytes），並伴隨有核紅血球（黑箭頭）、點彩紅血球（橘箭頭）與大型血小板（藍箭頭），符合微血管病性溶血（TTP）。
features: Scattered schistocytes including helmet cells and small irregular fragments with pointed ends
Two nucleated RBCs (black arrows) with round, dense pyknotic nuclei and grayish-pink polychromatophilic cytoplasm
Red cell with fine basophilic stippling and slight polychromasia (orange arrow)
Large granular platelet (blue arrow); overall few platelets in the field
Background normocytic RBCs with central pallor, some polychromatophilic larger cells; no agglutination
64282.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with scattered schistocytes, including helmet cells and small irregular fragments. Two nucleated red blood cells with dense nuclei and polychromatophilic cytoplasm are present, along with a red cell showing fine basophilic stippling, indicating a brisk marrow erythroid response. Platelets appear decreased in this field, and those present include a large granular form consistent with increased platelet turnover. No red cell agglutination or spherocyte predominance is seen. Findings are consistent with a microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, compatible with the clinical diagnosis of thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; ADAMTS13 activity is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Peripartum HELLP shows similar schistocytes but has prominent transaminase elevation, hypertension, and ADAMTS13 activity is not severely deficient (<10%), unlike TTP.
DIC can produce schistocytes but shows prolonged PT/aPTT and low fibrinogen, whereas coagulation tests are typically normal in TTP.
Morphology is identical; aHUS is favored by dominant renal failure with ADAMTS13 activity above 10%.
AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT rather than helmet cells and fragments with thrombocytopenia.

exam.answer_en: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (MAHA) — schistocytes/helmet cells with thrombocytopenia and nucleated RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：指盔形細胞或碎片問名稱，並問血小板低下合併此發現的急症鑑別；答 schistocytes，MAHA，需立刻考慮 TTP。
確診：ADAMTS13 activity 嚴重降低（<10%）支持 TTP；可檢測 inhibitor 區分 immune TTP 與先天性 TTP（孕期可為首次表現）。
緊急處置：懷疑 TTP 即開始 plasma exchange 與類固醇，不必等 ADAMTS13 結果；immune TTP 可加 caplacizumab、rituximab。
非必要避免輸血小板（除非危及生命出血或侵入性處置）；DIC 的 PT/aPTT 與 fibrinogen 常異常，TTP 多正常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 孕產期最易與 HELLP/preeclampsia 混淆：HELLP 以肝酵素上升、高血壓為主且產後多改善，ADAMTS13 不會嚴重低下；也需與 aHUS（腎衰竭明顯）與 DIC（凝血時間延長）區分。

quiz.q: 此血片的紅血球碎片稱為什麼？確認 TTP 要驗哪一項檢查？
quiz.a: Schistocytes（含 helmet cells）；ADAMTS13 activity（<10%）。

64154.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的分葉嗜中性球，左邊那顆外圍被一整圈血小板緊密包圍，右邊那顆邊緣也有數顆血小板貼附；血小板黏在嗜中性球膜外形成花環狀，是典型血小板衛星現象。
features: Two adjacent mature segmented neutrophils with fine cytoplasmic granules
Left neutrophil encircled by a dense ring of adherent platelets; right neutrophil with fewer adherent platelets
Adherent platelets are normal in size and granularity
Occasional free platelets in the background
Red cells with occasional crenated forms and refractile drying artifact
64154.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils. The left neutrophil is surrounded by a nearly complete rosette of adherent platelets, and the right neutrophil has several platelets attached to its margin. The platelets are extracellular, of normal size, and not phagocytosed. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon that may produce pseudothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Phagocytosed platelets lie within cytoplasmic vacuoles inside the neutrophil, whereas here they sit on the outer membrane.
Platelet clumps are free-floating platelet aggregates not organized around leukocytes.

ddx.dx: Gray platelet syndrome or giant platelets
ddx.vs: These are intrinsic platelet abnormalities with pale or large platelets, while the platelets here are normal and only their distribution is abnormal.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — near-complete rosette of normal-sized extracellular platelets around a segmented neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：問左側嗜中性球外圍花環是什麼、血小板在細胞內還是外；答血小板在膜外（satellitism），不是被吞噬。
Satellitism 最常見於嗜中性球，偶見於單核球或淋巴球；屬體外 EDTA 現象，體內血小板功能與數量正常。
Pseudothrombocytopenia 的兩大抹片原因：platelet satellitism 與 EDTA-dependent platelet clumping；兩者皆可同時存在，處理方式相同（改抗凝劑重測）。
病歷上應註記此現象，避免日後每次抽血都被當成新發血小板低下而重複檢查或延誤手術。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 platelet phagocytosis 混淆：被吞噬的血小板位於胞質內並常被空泡包圍；本圖血小板大小正常且貼在細胞膜外緣，屬 satellitism。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球外圍的小顆粒位於細胞內還是細胞外？此現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: 細胞外、貼附於細胞膜；platelet satellitism。

64090.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大細胞，胞質豐富且深藍嗜鹼性、帶細小空泡，內有四個大小不一的圓形核、染色質呈塊狀；深藍胞質配多核，是多核（發育異常樣）漿細胞，本例為 AML 鞏固治療後的反應性變化。
features: Large cell with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles
Four separate round-to-oval nuclei of unequal size
Coarse, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleoli
Cytoplasmic outline irregular, with no distinct perinuclear hof in this plane
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and a small lymphocyte
64090.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell with abundant, deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and four round nuclei of variable size with coarsely clumped chromatin. The morphology is that of a pleomorphic multinucleated plasma cell. The background shows orderly granulocytic maturation without increased blasts in this field. Although multinucleation raises concern for a plasma cell neoplasm, it can occur in reactive or regenerating marrow; in a patient after AML consolidation, the findings are consistent with a reactive atypical plasma cell, and clonality should be assessed by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry if plasma cells are increased.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with pleomorphic plasma cells
ddx.vs: Myeloma shows increased, often clustered plasma cells with light-chain restriction and a serum/urine M-protein, which cannot be judged from a single cell.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often >10) uniform, well-separated nuclei and pale, granular pink-blue cytoplasm rather than a few unequal nuclei in deep blue cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have granular lilac cytoplasm and are CD61-positive, not deeply basophilic cytoplasm with plasma cell-type chromatin.
Carcinoma cells typically occur in cohesive clusters with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli rather than as a single cell with clumped plasma cell-type chromatin.

64026.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群小到中型淋巴細胞，核圓、染色質凝集，胞質少量淡藍色且常偏向一側，少數可見明顯核仁，背景有顆粒球前驅細胞，符合成熟 B 細胞淋巴瘤（如脾邊緣區淋巴瘤）侵犯骨髓。
features: Increased small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; a few cells with a visible nucleolus
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm, sometimes polar/eccentric giving a plasmacytoid look
Villous cytoplasmic projections not clearly evident on these cells
Background granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, band neutrophil) and scattered platelets
64026.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows an increased population of small to medium-sized mature-appearing lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm, which is eccentric in some cells. Occasional cells show a visible nucleolus. Distinct villous projections are not evident in this field, and maturing granulocytic precursors are present in the background. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a mature B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context; flow cytometry and trephine biopsy (intrasinusoidal pattern) are required for classification.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and 'soccer-ball' clumped chromatin, and flow shows CD5+/CD23+/dim sIg, while SMZL is typically CD5-/CD23-/CD103-.
HCL cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections, and are CD11c+/CD25+/CD103+/annexin A1+ with BRAF V600E.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, which overlaps morphologically with SMZL.
MCL cells have irregular, cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).

63770.recognize_zh: 組織切片中有大片成群分布的漿細胞，核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face），細胞質嗜伊紅偏紫並可見核旁淡染區，部分為雙核；單看形態無法區分反應性或單株性，需 kappa/lambda 輕鏈染色判定。
features: Sheets and clusters of plasma cells within a loose fragmented tissue core
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin; occasional binucleated forms
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear pale hof in some cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional histiocytes admixed; a small vessel on the right
No marked nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli or mitotic activity in this field
63770.describe_en: H&E-stained tissue section shows a fragmented cellular core containing sheets and clusters of plasma cells with admixed small lymphocytes and histiocytes. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin, moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs and occasional binucleation, without marked atypia, prominent nucleoli or mitoses in this field. The findings represent a dense plasma cell infiltrate; because morphology alone cannot distinguish a reactive plasmacytosis from a plasma cell neoplasm, CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry or in situ hybridization is required. In this case context of granulomatous (tubercular) infection, a reactive plasmacytosis is favored if polytypic.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows light chain-restricted (kappa or lambda) plasma cells, often with atypia or aberrant CD56/cyclin D1, together with an M-protein and CRAB features.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: These contain clonal CD20+ small B cells with admixed plasmacytoid cells sharing the same light chain restriction, often with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P in LPL.
IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and increased IgG4+ plasma cells with a high IgG4/IgG ratio.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of large immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, high Ki-67 and often EBER positivity, unlike these mature-appearing plasma cells.

63834.recognize_zh: 單一高倍視野內就有十顆左右的嗜中性球，多數為分葉核或帶狀核（band），細胞質內顆粒明顯，但沒有芽細胞、骨髓球或嗜鹼性球增加；白血球密度明顯上升而細胞形態成熟，符合嗜中性球增多（neutrophilia）。
features: Markedly increased number of neutrophils in a single high-power field
Mature segmented neutrophils admixed with band forms with C- or U-shaped nuclei
Clumped mature chromatin; no nucleoli
Pink-violet cytoplasmic granules that appear prominent, possibly representing mild toxic granulation
No blasts, myelocytes, basophils or Döhle bodies clearly identified; normocytic red cells with rare platelets
63834.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in neutrophils, with numerous mature segmented forms and several band forms in a single field. The neutrophils have clumped chromatin and conspicuous pink-violet cytoplasmic granules, suggestive of mild toxic granulation; no blasts, myelocytes or basophilia are seen in this field. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with neutrophilia with mild left shift, most often reactive, and correlation with the absolute neutrophil count and clinical context is recommended.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full spectrum of granulocytic precursors with a myelocyte peak, basophilia and eosinophilia with BCR::ABL1, rather than mature neutrophils and bands only.
CNL shows sustained mature neutrophilia with <10% precursors often with toxic granulation, and requires exclusion of reactive causes and demonstration of CSF3R mutation.
A leukemoid reaction is reactive neutrophilia above 50 x 10^9/L with toxic changes and left shift but no basophilia, dysplasia or clonal markers, and resolves with the underlying cause.
Dysplastic neutrophils show hypolobated bilobed nuclei with condensed chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm, unlike the well-granulated normally lobulated cells here.

63706.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是細長、彎曲如香蕉或新月形的藍紫色蟲體，中央帶深色瘧色素（malaria pigment），這種新月形配子體（crescent-shaped gametocyte）是熱帶瘧原蟲（Plasmodium falciparum）的特徵。
features: Elongated crescent/banana-shaped bluish parasites with dark central pigment (arrows)
Gametocytes lie adjacent to or distort the red cell outline, with the host cell membrane barely visible
No enlarged host red cells or Schüffner's dots
Background red cells show clumping and overlap; platelets present
Lymphocyte and a mononuclear cell with coarse chromatin in the field
63706.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several elongated, curved crescent-shaped parasites with bluish cytoplasm and dark central clumped pigment (arrows), consistent with gametocytes. The host red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner's stippling. Background red cells show clumping, and a lymphocyte, a mononuclear cell and platelets are present. Asexual ring forms are not clearly identified at this magnification, and parasitemia should be quantified on thick and thin films. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes.

ddx.vs: P. vivax and P. ovale gametocytes are large round to oval bodies filling an enlarged red cell with Schüffner's dots, not banana-shaped crescents.
P. malariae gametocytes are round and compact within normal-sized cells with coarse pigment, and trophozoites form band shapes rather than crescents.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Platelets and precipitate lack a defined elongated parasite body with central pigment and are often in a different plane of focus.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum — crescent (banana)-shaped gametocytes with central pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指新月形蟲體問種別；新月形配子體為 P. falciparum 特有，其他線索包括多重環狀體、雙染色質點、感染紅血球不變大且無 Schüffner dots。
檢查判讀：厚片用於偵測，薄片用於分種與計算寄生蟲血症百分比；P. falciparum 周邊血通常只見環狀體與配子體，成熟期多隔離於微血管內。
臨床意義：falciparum 可快速進展為重症（腦性瘧疾、腎衰竭、嚴重貧血），重症首選靜脈 artesunate；台灣多為境外移入，屬法定傳染病須通報。
配子體負責傳播給病媒蚊，多數血液期藥物對成熟配子體效果有限，低劑量 primaquine 可用於阻斷傳播（需先評估 G6PD）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. vivax/ovale 配子體混淆：後兩者配子體圓形、填滿變大的紅血球並可見 Schüffner dots；新月形且紅血球不變大即指向 falciparum。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的新月形構造是瘧原蟲的哪一期？代表哪一種瘧原蟲？
quiz.a: 配子體（gametocyte）；Plasmodium falciparum

63642.recognize_zh: 中央一顆顆粒粗大深紫、核被部分遮蓋的嗜鹼性球（basophil），左上的嗜中性球細胞質淡而顆粒稀少（hypogranular），右上為雙葉核的顆粒球，背景血小板增多並有棘狀、橢圓及淚滴形紅血球。
features: Central granulocyte with coarse dark purple granules partly obscuring a bilobed nucleus, consistent with a basophil
Neutrophil (upper left) with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm, a dysplastic feature
Granulocyte with bilobed nucleus (upper right), raising pseudo-Pelger-Huet change versus a second basophil at this resolution
Increased platelets throughout the field
Anisopoikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells
63642.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets and anisopoikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells. A basophil with coarse dark granules is present centrally. A neutrophil in the upper left has markedly pale hypogranular cytoplasm, and a bilobed granulocyte in the upper right may represent a pseudo-Pelger-Huet form, although resolution limits separation from a basophil. Findings are consistent with basophilia and dysgranulopoiesis in the setting of myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked leukocytosis with a myelocyte bulge and basophilia but lacks dysplastic hypogranular neutrophils, and is defined by BCR::ABL1.
ET has thrombocytosis without neutrophil dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
Inherited Pelger-Huet neutrophils have normal granulation and affect nearly all neutrophils without cytopenia or thrombocytosis.
aCML shows leukocytosis with ≥10% circulating immature granulocytes and prominent dysgranulopoiesis, without ring sideroblasts and marked thrombocytosis.

63578.recognize_zh: 高倍下箭頭所指的大型淋巴樣細胞，核被分割成多個圍繞中心排列的花瓣狀葉（flower cell），胞質為淡藍色嗜鹼性；這是成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤最具代表性的細胞形態。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cell with a nucleus divided into multiple petal-like lobes arranged around a pale center (flower cell)
Moderately condensed, finely clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent smaller cell with lobulated/indented nucleus and similar cytoplasm
Sparse background with red cells and a small lymphoid cell (cytospin preparation)
63578.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytocentrifuge preparation (Wright-Giemsa), high power, shows a large atypical lymphoid cell with a multilobated nucleus whose lobes radiate around a central clear area, producing a flower-like configuration. The chromatin is moderately condensed, nucleoli are inconspicuous, and there is a moderate rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm. A second smaller atypical cell with lobulated nucleus is adjacent. In the context of a CD4+/CD7-/CD25+ T-cell population and positive HTLV-1 serology, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells show cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than discrete petal-like lobes, and the patient lacks HTLV-1 infection.
These are far larger with abundant granular cytoplasm, and megakaryocyte lobes are coarse, whereas this cell has scant agranular lymphoid cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil or monocyte with cytospin artifact
ddx.vs: Neutrophils have dense pyknotic lobes with pink granular cytoplasm, and monocytes have grey vacuolated cytoplasm with folded rather than radial lobated nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, CNS involvement — flower cell with petal-like nuclear lobes in CSF
pearls_zh: 高倍單顆細胞題：考官指花瓣狀核問名稱與疾病；答 flower cell，adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma。
ATLL 為 CD4+ 成熟 T 細胞腫瘤，常 CD7 缺失、CD25 強陽性，部分 FOXP3 陽性（類 regulatory T 細胞）。
HTLV-1 的 Tax 與 HBZ 為致病關鍵；證明 provirus 單株整合可支持克隆性。
CSF 陽性代表 CNS 侵犯，需 intrathecal chemotherapy；aggressive 型適合者可考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Sézary cell 混淆：Sézary 核為腦迴狀（cerebriform）、病人有紅皮症且 HTLV-1 陰性；flower cell 核分葉更深、呈圍繞中心的花瓣狀。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞的核型態名稱為何？
quiz.a: Flower cell（多葉花瓣狀核）

63514.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質內含兩顆被吞噬的完整紅血球，細胞核被擠到一側呈新月形，這就是紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）；右下角另有一顆紅血球前驅細胞。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Two intact engulfed red cells within the cytoplasm
Nucleus compressed to the periphery into a crescent shape
Background red cells with irregular inclusions/artifactual refractile changes and occasional small intraerythrocytic dots
Adjacent erythroid precursor (basophilic normoblast) at lower right
63514.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm containing two intact phagocytosed red cells, with its nucleus displaced into a peripheral crescent. Surrounding red cells show variable refractile artifact, and an erythroid precursor is present nearby. Only a single phagocytic event is seen in this field, so the extent of hemophagocytosis cannot be assessed. Findings show erythrophagocytosis, which in this patient with babesiosis reflects macrophage activation; clinical and laboratory criteria are required before considering secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: HLH is a clinical diagnosis requiring fever, cytopenias, splenomegaly, and laboratory criteria such as ferritin and sCD25, as isolated marrow hemophagocytosis is nonspecific.
Occasional hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection shows the same morphology, so history rather than morphology distinguishes it.

ddx.dx: Overlapping red cells on a macrophage (smear artifact)
ddx.vs: Overlying red cells lie outside the plane of the cytoplasm without an indentation of the nucleus, whereas true engulfed cells are surrounded by cytoplasm and displace the nucleus.
Neoplastic histiocytes show marked nuclear atypia and form sheets, unlike this bland macrophage with a compressed normal nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Erythrophagocytosis — macrophage containing intact engulfed red cells with crescentic displaced nucleus (babesiosis-associated)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞問「細胞質內是什麼？」答被吞噬的紅血球（erythrophagocytosis），並追問可能的全身性病因。
骨髓中見噬紅血球現象可見於感染（如 babesiosis、EBV）、輸血後、自體免疫溶血；需結合臨床評估是否達 HLH 診斷。
HLH-2004 診斷需符合 8 項中 5 項（或分子診斷），骨髓 hemophagocytosis 只是其中一項，既不敏感也不特異。
寄生蟲感染的背景下應同時仔細看紅血球內有無病原（Babesia/瘧原蟲），並檢查 ferritin、fibrinogen、triglyceride 等 HLH 指標。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把抹片上紅血球疊在巨噬細胞上當成吞噬；真吞噬時紅血球位於細胞質內，周圍常有透明空泡且核被推擠變形。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞的細胞核為何被擠到一側呈新月形？這個現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: 細胞質內含被吞噬的完整紅血球；erythrophagocytosis（hemophagocytosis 的一種）

63450.recognize_zh: 四格薄層血片合圖：三格可見新月形／香蕉形的配子體，中央有聚集的深色染色質與色素顆粒，所在紅血球輪廓幾乎被撐成新月形；另一格為圓形早期配子體。新月形配子體是惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的代表特徵。
features: Crescent- or banana-shaped gametocytes longer than the red cell diameter
Central aggregated chromatin with dark granular pigment
Female (macro)gametocytes: slender, more pointed ends with compact central chromatin
Male (micro)gametocyte: broader, more sausage-shaped with more diffuse chromatin
Early-stage gametocyte: rounded intraerythrocytic form with chromatin and pigment
Surrounding red cells normal in size without Schüffner stippling
63450.describe_en: Composite thin blood smear panels show several crescent-shaped (falciform) gametocytes that distort and exceed the dimensions of the host red cell, with centrally aggregated chromatin and granular dark pigment. One panel labels a broader form as a male gametocyte, and another shows a rounded early-stage gametocyte. The uninfected red cells are normal in size without stippling. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes; note that sex assignment is often unreliable on routine light microscopy, and gametocytes alone do not indicate the asexual parasitemia level.

ddx.vs: P. vivax gametocytes are round to oval, fill an enlarged red cell, and are accompanied by Schüffner dots rather than being crescent-shaped.
These are round and compact, occupying a normal or enlarged red cell without crescentic shape.
Babesia forms small ring and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without pigment and never produces crescentic gametocytes.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes — crescent/banana-shaped forms with central chromatin and pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指新月形蟲體問種別與性別；答 P. falciparum 配子體，雌配子體細長尖端、染色質集中，雄配子體較寬呈香腸狀、染色質分散。
配子體是蚊子傳播期，不引起症狀；多數血液期抗瘧藥對成熟配子體效果有限，治療後仍可持續出現於血片。
WHO 建議在 P. falciparum 治療時加單次低劑量 primaquine 以阻斷傳播（適用情境依地區政策）。
新月形配子體為 P. falciparum 專屬；其他種配子體為圓形或卵圓形，且 P. vivax 配子體位於增大、具 Schüffner dots 的紅血球。
exam.pitfall_zh: 治療後血片仍見配子體易被誤判為治療失敗；配子體存在不代表無性期未清除，應以環狀體數量追蹤療效。

quiz.q: 圖中新月形蟲體是什麼期別？治療後仍持續出現是否代表治療失敗？
quiz.a: P. falciparum gametocyte；不代表失敗，應以無性環狀體清除評估療效

63386.recognize_zh: 這是毛細管血紅素電泳報告：HbS 49.7% 為最高峰，同時存在 HbA 36.1%、HbF 11.2%、HbA2 3.0%；HbS 大於 HbA，不符合單純鐮刀型特質（sickle trait），需考慮輸血後的鐮刀型貧血或 HbS/β+ 地中海貧血。
features: Capillary electrophoresis trace with four peaks: Hb A, Hb F, Hb S and Hb A2 in order of migration
Hb S is the dominant fraction at 49.7%, exceeding Hb A at 36.1%
Hb F elevated at 11.2% (reference 0-0.5%)
Hb A2 3.0%, within the stated reference range 2.5-3.5%
No additional variant peaks (e.g., Hb C or Hb D zones) identified
63386.describe_en: Capillary hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb S 49.7%, Hb A 36.1%, Hb F 11.2% and Hb A2 3.0%, with no other variant peaks. The proportion of Hb S exceeds Hb A, which is not the pattern of sickle cell trait, where Hb A predominates and Hb S is usually below 45%. Together with the elevated Hb F, this pattern is most compatible with sickle cell anemia after recent red cell transfusion, or alternatively Hb S/beta-plus thalassemia; transfusion history, red cell indices and family or DNA studies are needed to distinguish these.

ddx.vs: Trait shows Hb A greater than Hb S (typically Hb S 35-45%) with normal Hb F and normal red cell indices.
S/beta-plus has Hb S greater than Hb A with microcytosis and a raised Hb A2 (often above 3.5%) without a recent transfusion.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell anemia on hydroxyurea without transfusion
ddx.vs: Untransfused Hb SS shows no Hb A peak, with Hb F that may be markedly elevated on hydroxyurea.

ddx.dx: Hb S with hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin
ddx.vs: S/HPFH shows no Hb A with Hb F around 20-30% distributed pancellularly and a mild clinical course.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin capillary electrophoresis — HbS 49.7% > HbA 36.1% with HbF 11.2%, HbA2 3.0%: not sickle trait
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「HbS 大於 HbA，是鐮刀型特質嗎？」答不是；鐮刀型特質 HbA 恆大於 HbS（HbS 約 35–40%）。
HbS > HbA 的鑑別：HbSS 近期輸血（HbA 來自捐血者）、HbS/β+ thalassemia；需對照輸血史、MCV 與家族研究。
HbS/β-thal 通常 HbA2 >3.5% 並小球性；本例 HbA2 3.0% 在參考範圍內，不支持 β-thal，較傾向輸血後 HbSS。
HbF 11.2% 升高可見於 hydroxyurea 治療或 HPFH 共存；鐮刀型貧血慢性輸血預防中風時，常以 HbS <30% 為目標。
exam.pitfall_zh: 只看到 HbS 與 HbA 同時存在就判為鐮刀型特質是常見錯誤；必須比較比例，HbS > HbA 表示輸血後 HbSS 或 HbS/β+ thal。

quiz.q: 電泳結果 HbS 49.7%、HbA 36.1%，為何不是鐮刀型特質？
quiz.a: 鐮刀型特質 HbA 應大於 HbS；HbS > HbA 提示輸血後 HbSS 或 HbS/β+ thalassemia

63322.recognize_zh: 高細胞量骨髓切片中，中央一個圓形脂肪空泡周圍環繞著淡染、帶小空泡的組織球（foamy histiocytes）與少量淋巴球，形成小型肉芽腫樣結構，這就是脂肪肉芽腫（lipogranuloma / fat granuloma）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed fat spaces
Central lipid vacuole rimmed by histiocytes with pale eosinophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Small clear lipid droplets within and around the histiocytic collection
Admixed lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils; no necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Adjacent erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells; focal hemorrhage
63322.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. A small lipogranuloma is present, composed of histiocytes with pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm surrounding a central lipid vacuole, with admixed small lipid droplets, lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils. There is no caseous necrosis or well-formed epithelioid granuloma with giant cells. Findings are consistent with a fat granuloma (lipogranuloma), a common incidental finding of no specific diagnostic significance; special stains for organisms are not indicated by this morphology alone.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are compact aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes, often with Langhans giant cells or necrosis, and lack a central fat vacuole.
Gaucher cells form sheets of large histiocytes with fibrillary tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than a small cluster around a fat droplet.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with histiocytes
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical large cells (e.g., CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells) within a polymorphous infiltrate rather than bland foamy histiocytes.

63258.recognize_zh: 紅血球為主、細胞稀少的抹片中散在數個中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓至橢圓、染色質比小淋巴球細緻，細胞質中等量、淡灰藍色，邊緣呈毛糙不規則的細絲狀突起（hairy projections）；配合 CD25+/CD103+ 與 BRAF V600E，符合毛細胞白血病。
features: Paucicellular, erythrocyte-rich smear (hemodilute) with scattered mononuclear cells
Medium-sized lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times a small lymphocyte, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval, centrally or slightly eccentrically placed nuclei with homogeneous, less condensed chromatin; nucleoli not evident
Moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with irregular, frayed, fine hair-like surface projections
One small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin for comparison; no granulocytes seen in this field
Red cells largely normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
63258.describe_en: The smear is hemodilute and paucicellular, containing scattered medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin less condensed than that of a small lymphocyte, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have a moderate amount of pale gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm with irregular, frayed borders and fine circumferential hair-like projections. A single small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison, and no granulocytes are seen in this field, in keeping with the reported neutropenia. In conjunction with a CD25+, CD103+, CD5- lambda-restricted B-cell population and BRAF V600E mutation, the findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes of SMZL have short polar villi and more condensed chromatin, and are CD103-negative, CD25-variable, annexin A1-negative and BRAF V600E wild-type.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant presents with leukocytosis, cells with a prominent central nucleolus, CD25 and annexin A1 negativity and no BRAF V600E, unlike the leukopenic classic HCL here.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villi, are usually CD25- and CD103-variable, and lack BRAF V600E.
Monocytes are larger with folded or lobulated nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, rather than a round nucleus with circumferential fine projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — medium lymphoid cells with pale gray-blue cytoplasm and circumferential hair-like projections (CD25+/CD103+, BRAF V600E)
pearls_zh: 考法：指胞質邊緣毛狀突起的淋巴樣細胞問名稱，並追問典型血液變化：全血球減少，尤其 monocytopenia 是經典線索。
表型：CD19/CD20 強、CD11c+、CD25+、CD103+、CD123+；IHC annexin A1+、cyclin D1 弱陽性、TRAP 細胞化學陽性；典型 HCL 幾乎都帶 BRAF V600E。
骨髓常 dry tap（網狀纖維增生）；切片呈「fried-egg」外觀，細胞間距均勻；脾臟侵犯紅髓並形成 blood lakes。
治療：purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin）± rituximab；復發難治者可用 BRAF 抑制劑（如 vemurafenib）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 SMZL 的 villous lymphocytes 混淆：SMZL 絨毛短且集中在兩極、CD103−、無 BRAF V600E；HCL 細絲狀突起環繞整圈且 CD103+/CD25+。

quiz.q: 典型 HCL 最具特徵的分子變化為何？常見哪一種白血球明顯減少？
quiz.a: BRAF V600E；monocytopenia

63130.recognize_zh: 大型組織球有豐富淡染或泡沫狀細胞質、圓形泡狀核與小核仁，箭頭處組織球細胞質內可見完整的紅血球與淋巴球（emperipolesis），背景混有大量漿細胞與淋巴球，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型線索。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small distinct nucleoli
Emperipolesis: intact red cells and a lymphocyte within histiocyte cytoplasm (arrow)
Numerous plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei and perinuclear hof
Admixed small lymphocytes and fibrillary/fibrous stroma
63130.describe_en: Sections at high power show sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale to finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, admixed with numerous plasma cells and small lymphocytes in a fibrous stroma. A histiocyte contains intact erythrocytes and a lymphocyte within its cytoplasm (emperipolesis, arrow). No significant nuclear atypia, necrosis, or eosinophil-rich infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease, confirmed by S100 positivity of the histiocytes.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, coffee-bean nuclei, accompanied by eosinophils, are CD1a/langerin positive, and lack emperipolesis.
In HLH macrophages destroy engulfed cells within phagocytic vacuoles and are S100 negative, whereas RDD histiocytes host intact viable cells and are S100 positive.
ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD1a− histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, usually S100 negative and BRAF V600E mutated, without prominent emperipolesis.
IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis without large S100+ histiocytes showing emperipolesis.

exam.answer_en: Extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease — large pale histiocytes with vesicular nuclei showing emperipolesis of intact RBCs and lymphocytes, plasma cell–rich background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處組織球內的完整紅血球與淋巴球，問現象名稱（emperipolesis）及其代表的疾病。
IHC：RDD 組織球 S100+、CD68+、CD163+，CD1a 與 langerin（CD207）陰性；OCT2 亦常陽性，可作輔助標記。
Histiocyte Society 2016 分類屬 R group；部分病例帶 MAPK 路徑突變（如 KRAS、NRAS、MAP2K1），支持其為克隆性病變。
經典淋巴結型為無痛巨大頸部淋巴結腫大、發燒與多株高免疫球蛋白血症；結外好發皮膚、鼻竇、軟組織、骨與中樞神經。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 LCH；LCH 細胞較小、核有咖啡豆溝紋並伴大量嗜伊紅球，CD1a/langerin 陽性且無 emperipolesis。

quiz.q: 箭頭處組織球胞質內含完整紅血球與淋巴球的現象稱為什麼？確認診斷的關鍵 IHC 為何？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；S100 陽性（CD1a 陰性）

63066.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中漿細胞成片取代造血組織，其中許多細胞質內塞滿多顆圓形、嗜伊紅性的小球（Russell bodies），呈葡萄串狀，即 Mott cells（grape cells）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Numerous Mott cells with cytoplasm distended by multiple round, pale eosinophilic globules (Russell bodies) in a grape-like cluster
Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Mott cell nuclei often compressed or pushed to the periphery by the inclusions
Scattered extravasated red cells; a bony trabecula at the upper right
63066.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a markedly hypercellular marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula. The intertrabecular space is diffusely replaced by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei; many cells contain numerous round, pale eosinophilic cytoplasmic globules (Russell bodies) giving a grape-like appearance (Mott cells). Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Mott cell features; light-chain restriction (CD138, kappa/lambda ISH or IHC) should be documented.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered, perivascular and polytypic, whereas this field shows diffuse sheets that would be light-chain restricted.
LPL has a mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20+ B cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell sheet.

ddx.dx: Signet ring cell carcinoma / storage histiocytes
ddx.vs: Metastatic signet ring cells contain a single mucin vacuole and are keratin positive, and storage histiocytes are CD68+/CD138-, unlike the multiple discrete Russell bodies in CD138+ plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cells — sheets of plasma cells replacing marrow, many packed with multiple eosinophilic Russell bodies (grape cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質塞滿多顆嗜伊紅小球的細胞問名稱（Mott cell／grape cell），並問小球成分：堆積在內質網的免疫球蛋白（Russell bodies）。
Mott cell 本身不具診斷特異性，慢性發炎、反應性漿細胞增多與 LPL 也可見；診斷骨髓瘤要看漿細胞比例與成片分佈。
切片評估：CD138 算漿細胞比例，kappa/lambda IHC 或 ISH 證明輕鏈限制；切片比例常比受稀釋的抽吸抹片更準確，兩者取較高值。
Russell body 為 PAS 陽性的免疫球蛋白包涵體；核被推擠至邊緣時，易與 signet ring 細胞混淆。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為轉移性 signet ring carcinoma 或貯積性組織球；signet ring 細胞為單一大黏液空泡且 keratin 陽性，Mott cell 為多顆圓形小球且 CD138 陽性。

quiz.q: 細胞質內擠滿多顆圓形嗜伊紅小球的漿細胞叫什麼？小球本質為何？
quiz.a: Mott cell；Russell bodies（內質網中堆積的免疫球蛋白）

63002.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非顯微影像：左圖為重度血友病患者左大腿明顯腫大、皮膚緊繃發亮；右圖為手術後，大腿周徑明顯縮小，外側可見縱向手術疤痕。慢性肌肉內出血形成的假腫瘤（hemophilic pseudotumor）是重度血友病的罕見併發症。
features: Clinical photographs, not a microscopic image
Pre-operative: marked diffuse swelling of the left thigh with tense, shiny overlying skin
Post-operative: reduced thigh girth with a healed longitudinal surgical scar on the lateral thigh
No overt skin ulceration, sinus tract or ecchymosis visible in either photograph
63002.describe_en: Clinical photographs of the left lower limb of a patient with severe hemophilia. The pre-operative image shows marked, diffuse enlargement of the thigh with tense overlying skin, without visible ulceration or fistula. The post-operative image shows substantial reduction in thigh girth with a healed longitudinal scar along the lateral thigh. Microscopic and radiologic features cannot be assessed from these images. The appearance is consistent with a hemophilic pseudotumor of the quadriceps muscle treated by surgical excision under factor replacement.

ddx.vs: Sarcoma is a solid enhancing mass on MRI, whereas a pseudotumor is an encapsulated blood-filled cyst with heterogeneous blood products of varying age; biopsy should be avoided in hemophilia without factor cover.
An acute hematoma develops over hours to days and resolves with factor replacement, while a pseudotumor enlarges slowly over months with a fibrous capsule and bone erosion.
Infection presents with fever, erythema, warmth and leukocytosis with fluid collection and rim enhancement on imaging.

62938.recognize_zh: 這張是高度放大、嚴重模糊的單一白血球影像，只看得到深紫色團塊狀的核/顆粒區與邊緣幾顆較大的深色顆粒，無法確認細胞種類或顆粒形態；只能依病例背景推測為 Chediak-Higashi 異常顆粒，不宜單憑此圖診斷。
features: Single leukocyte photographed at very high digital magnification with marked pixelation and blur
Dense dark purple central mass (nucleus and/or granules) with lobulated contour
A few discrete large dark granules at the cell periphery
Cell lineage and granule size relative to normal cannot be reliably assessed
62938.describe_en: This digitally enlarged image of a single peripheral blood leukocyte is markedly pixelated and blurred. A dense, lobulated dark purple central mass is seen with a few discrete large dark granules at the periphery, but nuclear detail, cytoplasm, and granule size relative to normal cannot be reliably assessed. The image is non-diagnostic on its own; in the context of the other images from this case, it may represent a leukocyte with Chediak-Higashi giant granules.

ddx.vs: Normal cells would show a discernible nucleus with pale cytoplasm and no giant granules, which cannot be excluded at this resolution.
Toxic granules are fine and uniform throughout the cytoplasm rather than a few large discrete granules.
An overlying platelet shows a pale hyalomere with central purple granulomere in a different focal plane.

62874.recognize_zh: 並列的 CD4 與 CD8 染色：CD8 在腺窩之間的固有層呈瀰漫強陽性，CD4 只有零星散在細胞，呈現明顯 CD8 優勢，是 CD8+ 惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的典型免疫表型。
features: CD8: dense, diffuse strong staining filling the lamina propria between crypts
CD4: only scattered positive cells (likely residual T cells and histiocytes)
Marked CD8-over-CD4 predominance in the infiltrate
Crypts preserved and negative, separated by the expanded infiltrate
62874.describe_en: Side-by-side CD4 and CD8 immunostains of colonic mucosa at low power show that the expanded lamina propria infiltrate is diffusely and strongly CD8-positive, while CD4 highlights only scattered cells. The crypts are preserved and separated by the infiltrate. This marked CD8 predominance indicates a monotypic cytotoxic T-cell population and is consistent with CD8-positive indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: The CD4-positive variant shows the reverse pattern with diffuse CD4 and sparse CD8 staining.
Reactive lamina propria T cells show a mixed CD4 and CD8 population, typically CD4-predominant.
MEITL is also often CD8-positive but is CD56-positive, epitheliotropic and highly proliferative.

62810.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現成群的大型非造血細胞：細胞核圓而偏位、核仁可見、細胞質豐富且淡染，與周圍嗜中性球明顯不同；切片中同樣的大細胞呈核染色陽性的免疫染色，支持轉移性黑色素瘤細胞。
features: Clusters of large cells in peripheral blood, several times the size of neutrophils (A)
Round, eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin and visible nucleoli; abundant pale, lightly basophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders (B)
No melanin pigment clearly identifiable at this resolution
H&E section with scattered large epithelioid cells with vesicular nuclei among blood elements (C)
Nuclear immunostaining in a cohesive cluster of tumor cells (D; marker not labeled)
62810.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of large atypical cells, markedly larger than accompanying neutrophils, with round eccentric nuclei, visible nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm; melanin pigment is not clearly discernible at this resolution. A corresponding H&E section shows scattered large epithelioid cells with vesicular nuclei, and an immunohistochemical stain shows strong nuclear positivity in a cluster of tumor cells (antibody not labeled in the figure). These cells are morphologically non-hematopoietic. Findings are consistent with circulating metastatic melanoma cells, supported by immunophenotyping (e.g., SOX10, S100, Melan-A, HMB-45).

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells tend to form tighter cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive and SOX10/Melan-A negative.
Megakaryocytic cells have lobulated nuclei or cytoplasmic blebs with platelet budding and express CD61/CD42b rather than melanocytic markers.
