Hematolymphoid cells are dispersed rather than clustered and express CD45; melanoma cells are CD45 negative.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cells or squamous contaminants from venipuncture
ddx.vs: Contaminant cells have bland small nuclei, no nucleoli and do not show atypia or melanocytic marker expression.

62746.recognize_zh: H&E 中片狀分布的中大型不典型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、看似侵襲性淋巴瘤（A）；但免疫染色一個標記完全陰性（B，可能為原本淋巴瘤的 B 細胞標記），另有 T 細胞標記呈大片膜狀強陽性（C、D），提示浸潤細胞為活化的 CAR T 細胞而非復發淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm (A)
Admixed histiocytoid cells and delicate vessels without necrosis evident in this field
Complete absence of staining in the infiltrate with one marker (B)
Strong, diffuse membranous staining of the large cells with a second marker (C), consistent with a pan-T-cell antigen
Diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous staining with a third marker (D) and scattered positive cells with a fourth marker (E), indicating a mixed T-cell subset composition
62746.describe_en: Tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, which at H&E level mimics an aggressive large cell lymphoma. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled) shows the infiltrate is negative for one marker, while a second marker stains the large cells diffusely and strongly in a membranous pattern and additional markers highlight diffuse and scattered subsets, supporting a T-cell rather than B-cell composition. In a patient after CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy, findings are consistent with a reactive infiltrate of activated CAR T cells mimicking lymphoma; recurrence of the original B-cell lymphoma (including CD19-negative relapse) should be excluded with a B-cell panel (CD20, PAX5, CD79a) and, if needed, CAR transgene detection.

ddx.vs: Large cells express B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5, CD79a) even when CD19 is lost, whereas CAR T cells are CD3-positive and B-cell marker negative.
Shows aberrant pan-T-cell antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement independent of CAR therapy, whereas CAR T cells retain the infused product signature and are detected by CAR-specific PCR/IHC.

ddx.dx: CAR T-cell-derived T-cell lymphoma (secondary T-cell malignancy)
ddx.vs: Rare but requires demonstration of CAR transgene integration within a clonal, persistent T-cell population with progressive disease, not a transient post-infusion expansion.
Hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei show uniform strong CD30 and often ALK expression with frequent loss of CD3.

62746.stain: H&E and IHC panel (markers not labeled)

62682.recognize_zh: 中低倍可見多個邊界模糊、細胞較淡且較大的結節，彼此靠得很近，結節間是較深染的小淋巴球與小血管；結節內細胞單調、看不到明顯的易染體巨噬細胞（tingible body macrophages）。
features: Vague nodules of paler, larger lymphoid cells with ill-defined borders
Nodules closely spaced with narrow intervening zones of small dark lymphocytes
Interfollicular areas contain small vessels and dark small lymphocytes
Absence of well-formed mantle zones and of polarization
Tingible body macrophages not conspicuous
62682.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at low-to-intermediate power shows closely spaced, ill-defined nodules composed of paler, larger lymphoid cells without distinct mantle zones or polarization. The nodules are separated by narrow bands of small dark lymphocytes with small vessels. Tingible body macrophages are not conspicuous. The crowded, monotonous nodular pattern is consistent with follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed with CD10, BCL2 and CD21 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have sharp borders, distinct mantle zones, polarization and many tingible body macrophages.
NMZL shows pale monocytoid cells expanding interfollicular and perifollicular zones around residual follicles, rather than nodules of germinal center cells.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells with irregular nuclei and pink histiocytes, without centroblasts, and are cyclin D1 positive.

62618.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍：表皮下方真皮被梭形細胞增生取代，其間有不規則、裂隙狀的擴張血管腔，並散在淋巴球聚集；這是卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi sarcoma）的形態，屬於 PEL 病人同時具有的 KSHV 相關皮膚病灶，而非積液淋巴瘤本身。
features: Dermis expanded by a cellular proliferation of spindle cells between collagen bundles
Irregular, jagged, slit-like and dilated vascular spaces dissecting the dermis
Perivascular and patchy lymphoplasmacytic aggregates
Preexisting adnexal structure (hair follicle) surrounded by the proliferation (promontory-like pattern)
Overlying epidermis intact without significant atypia
62618.describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows an intact epidermis overlying a dermis diffusely expanded by a proliferation of spindle cells arranged between collagen bundles. Numerous irregular, jagged and slit-like vascular spaces dissect the dermis, and there are scattered perivascular lymphoplasmacytic aggregates; a preexisting hair follicle is surrounded by the proliferation. No sheets of large lymphoma cells are seen. The findings are most consistent with Kaposi sarcoma (plaque stage) in a patient with KSHV/HHV8-associated primary effusion lymphoma; HHV8 LANA-1 immunostaining would confirm.

ddx.vs: Extracavitary PEL shows sheets of large CD45+/CD138+ immunoblastic cells rather than spindle cells with slit-like vessels.
Angiosarcoma has more atypical, multilayered endothelial cells lining anastomosing channels and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative.
Acroangiodermatitis shows lobular proliferation of thick-walled small vessels in the upper dermis without dissecting slit-like channels and is HHV8 negative.
Dermatofibroma shows storiform fibrohistiocytic cells with collagen trapping and lacks the jagged vascular channels and HHV8 positivity.

62554.recognize_zh: 全切片掃描圖：上方為具指狀絨毛皺摺的腸道黏膜與肌層，下方被一大團均質紫色的腫瘤取代並破壞腸壁，腫瘤內散布白色小點（星空樣巨噬細胞）；呈現結外腸道大腫塊型的侵襲性淋巴瘤。
features: Whole-mount section of bowel wall with intact mucosa and muscularis propria at one edge
Large, solid, homogeneous basophilic mass expanding beneath and through the bowel wall
Numerous tiny pale dots within the mass at low power, corresponding to a starry-sky pattern
Fine linear cracks and focal pale areas within the tumor; no obvious glandular or nested architecture
62554.describe_en: A whole-slide low-power image shows a segment of bowel with intact mucosa and muscularis propria at one edge and a large, solid, homogeneously basophilic mass that expands the wall and extends deep to the muscularis. The tumor is diffusely cellular with numerous small pale dots distributed through it, corresponding to tingible-body macrophages. No glandular or nested epithelial architecture is identified within the mass. The low-power appearance is that of an extranodal gastrointestinal aggressive lymphoma; in this case the diagnosis of high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements depends on higher-power morphology, immunohistochemistry and FISH.

ddx.vs: Burkitt commonly presents as an ileocecal mass with an identical starry sky, but is BCL2-negative without BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger pleomorphic cells and lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.
Carcinoma arises from the mucosa with gland formation or cohesive nests and is keratin-positive.

62490.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 染色中，血管內皮呈線狀陽性（內部對照），另散在數顆圓形膜性陽性的母細胞，局部成小群聚集，但未見成片；用來估算 CML 加速期的母細胞比例。
features: Linear CD34 staining of capillary endothelium, serving as an internal positive control
Scattered round mononuclear cells with membranous/cytoplasmic CD34 positivity (blasts), with a small cluster in the center
No large aggregates or sheets of CD34-positive blasts
Megakaryocytes and most myeloid cells CD34 negative
Loosely cohesive, partly disrupted marrow tissue around fat spaces
62490.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights endothelial cells of small vessels and scattered CD34-positive blasts, including a small cluster of three to four cells. Megakaryocytes and maturing myeloid cells are negative. No large clusters or sheets of blasts are seen in this field. CD34 staining helps estimate blast percentage and detect focal blast aggregates; in CML, blasts of 10-19% support accelerated phase, whereas a large focal aggregate would indicate blast phase.

ddx.vs: Blast phase shows at least 20% blasts or large focal intramedullary aggregates of CD34-positive blasts, not the scattered small groups seen here.
Chronic phase has fewer than 10% blasts, which is difficult to separate by eye and requires aspirate differential counts.
Elongated, linear CD34-positive cells lining lumens are endothelial and should be excluded from the blast estimate.

62426.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中央有一顆巨大細胞，具多葉、深染的聚集核與拉長如尾巴的紫色細胞質，即循環中的巨核細胞（或其裸核碎片）；背景紅血球呈疊錢狀（rouleaux）排列、白血球很少，符合內臟利什曼病的高球蛋白血症與全血球減少。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a compact, multilobated, hyperchromatic nucleus
Elongated, stretched purple cytoplasmic extensions trailing from the nucleus
Prominent rouleaux formation of red cells throughout the field
Paucity of leukocytes, with only a single small granulocyte at the upper left
Low magnification (approximately 200x) limits evaluation of red cell and platelet detail
62426.describe_en: Low-power view of a Leishman-stained peripheral blood smear shows a circulating megakaryocyte with a compact multilobated hyperchromatic nucleus and elongated cytoplasmic extensions. Red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, and leukocytes are sparse. Detailed red cell and platelet morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification, and no parasites are evident in this field. Circulating megakaryocytes are nonspecific but can accompany marrow infiltration or stress; together with rouleaux (hypergammaglobulinemia) and pancytopenia, findings are compatible with visceral leishmaniasis, which is confirmed by amastigotes on the marrow aspirate.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other myeloproliferative neoplasm
ddx.vs: MPNs with circulating megakaryocytes show a leukoerythroblastic picture with teardrop cells and often thrombocytosis rather than pancytopenia with rouleaux.
Myeloma also causes rouleaux and cytopenias but shows circulating plasma cells and a monoclonal protein rather than polyclonal gammopathy and Leishmania.
Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of multiple cells with discrete nuclei, rather than a single cell with a lobulated nucleus and platelet-producing cytoplasm.
Smudged cells lack the multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasmic tails of a megakaryocyte.

62362.recognize_zh: 瀰漫的淋巴母細胞中，散在一部分細胞呈膜狀 CD1a 陽性，多數細胞為陰性；CD1a 陽性代表皮質型胸腺細胞階段，有助於將腫瘤歸為 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized cells with round to irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Membranous CD1a staining in a minority subset of scattered tumor cells
Most tumor cells negative for CD1a
A few cells with strong ring-like membranous staining
62362.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD1a shows membranous positivity in a minority of scattered cells within a diffuse lymphoblastic infiltrate, with the majority of tumor cells negative. CD1a is a marker of cortical thymocyte differentiation, and even partial expression, in combination with CD3 and TdT, supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and helps exclude early T-precursor phenotype, which by definition is CD1a-negative.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are CD1a+ and langerin+ with grooved nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, and are CD3- and TdT-negative.
CD1a+ thymocytes in thymoma are accompanied by a cytokeratin-positive epithelial network and lobulated fibrous septa.
ETP-ALL is CD1a-negative (under 5% positive) and expresses stem or myeloid markers.

62234.recognize_zh: 視野中央有兩顆細胞質深藍、核偏心並帶核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，但此視野大多仍是顆粒球系前驅細胞，單看本圖無法估算漿細胞比例。
features: Two plasma cells in the center with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof
Background dominated by granulocytic precursors: myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils
Large cell on the left with coarse, clumped chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes/late erythroblasts and an eosinophilic precursor at lower right
Hemodiluted background with vacuole-like clear spaces
62234.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoietic elements with predominance of maturing granulocytic precursors. Two plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs are present in the center of the field. The plasma cells in this single field are not numerous, so their proportion cannot be estimated from this image. Findings show plasma cells; correlation with a full differential count, clonality studies and serum/urine protein studies is required to support plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% and polytypic by kappa/lambda, whereas myeloma shows clonal (light-chain restricted, often CD56+/CD19−) plasma cells.
LPL has a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters, and have a perinuclear hof located away from the nucleus rather than immediately adjacent to it.

62170.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片滿布大型圓核細胞，細胞質邊緣深藍、核周稍淡染，染色質細顆粒狀，為原紅血球母細胞（proerythroblast）與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞，並夾雜少數較成熟紅系細胞，紅系前驅細胞呈片狀增生，支持純紅系白血病。
features: Sheets of large erythroid precursors with round nuclei and finely granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming a rim, with perinuclear pallor in some cells
Admixed smaller erythroblasts with condensed chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm
Occasional binucleate/irregular erythroid nuclei
Rare small lymphocytes and granulocytes; red cells in background
62170.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly hypercellular field composed predominantly of erythroid precursors. Most cells are large proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with smaller maturing erythroblasts showing condensed chromatin. Occasional erythroid cells are binucleate or have irregular nuclei, and granulocytic cells are scarce. Findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia, pending differential count and immunophenotyping (e.g. E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin).

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic blebbing cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and E-cadherin/glycophorin negative.
MDS lacks the ≥30% proerythroblast population and >80% erythroid predominance of pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor or lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are non-erythroid and negative for E-cadherin, CD71 and hemoglobin/glycophorin, expressing their own lineage markers.
Parvovirus causes scattered giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in a background of red cell aplasia rather than sheets of erythroid precursors.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia (AML with erythroid differentiation) — sheets of proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm replacing the marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：看到滿片深藍細胞質、圓核的大細胞，要說出是紅系原始細胞（proerythroblast）而非 myeloblast，並問需做哪些染色確認紅系。
定義：WHO 5th 稱 AML with erythroid differentiation，要求紅系前驅細胞 ≥80% 且其中 proerythroblast ≥30%；此時不以 myeloblast 比例計算。
IHC/細胞化學：E-cadherin、CD71、glycophorin A（早期細胞可弱）、hemoglobin；PAS 呈塊狀（block）陽性；MPO 陰性。
遺傳：常有 TP53 突變與 complex karyotype，ICC 2022 多歸入 AML with mutated TP53，預後極差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 megaloblastic anemia（紅系增生伴大細胞）或 megakaryoblastic leukemia：巨母細胞性貧血有完整成熟梯度且可補充矯正；megakaryoblast 為 CD61/CD42b 陽性。

quiz.q: 佔滿視野、細胞質深藍、核圓的大型細胞屬於哪一系？確認其系別可用哪兩個 IHC 標記？
quiz.a: 紅系（proerythroblast）；E-cadherin、CD71（或 glycophorin A）

62106.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓腔被大量無色、半透明的針狀結晶填滿，結晶排成放射狀扇形或玫瑰花形，之間有纖維母細胞與組織球穿插，完全不見造血細胞，是草酸鈣結晶沉積（oxalosis）的典型樣貌。
features: Marrow space replaced by abundant colorless-to-pale translucent crystals
Needle/plate-like crystals in radiating fan-shaped and rosette arrangements
Delicate fibrous septa with spindled fibroblasts and histiocytes between crystal clusters
Focal denser eosinophilic/hematoxyphilic areas at the lower right, possibly bone or calcified material
Absence of hematopoietic cells and fat in the field
62106.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy at higher magnification shows marrow spaces extensively replaced by colorless, needle-shaped crystals arranged in radiating fans and rosettes. Thin fibrous septa containing spindled fibroblasts and histiocytes run between the crystal aggregates, and no residual hematopoietic tissue is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis with crystal-induced fibrosis, which can cause refractory cytopenias in primary or secondary hyperoxaluria; polarized light examination will show strongly birefringent crystals.

ddx.vs: Urate deposits are amorphous after formalin processing with a palisading granulomatous rim, while oxalate forms persistent radiating rosettes that are birefringent in routine sections.
Fibrotic marrow shows streaming collagen and atypical megakaryocytes without extracellular crystalline material.
Crystals are intracytoplasmic within histiocytes (immunoglobulin light chain) rather than extracellular radiating sheaves.

62042.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色（紅色色原）顯示一片界線不清、斜向分佈的陽性細胞聚集區，周圍則是較疏散的陽性細胞，整體結節邊界模糊；這種不規則、擴散的分佈可對應 NLPHL 變異型態，但抗原未標示，需配合其他染色判讀。
features: Low-power field of a lymphoid proliferation with a poorly circumscribed, band-like aggregate of densely positive cells
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with membranous/cytoplasmic red chromogen
Numerous scattered positive cells extend into the surrounding negative lymphoid background
No well-formed, sharply delineated nodules in this field
Individual large-cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
62042.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled) of a lymph node shows an irregular, poorly delineated aggregate of positive small to medium-sized cells with numerous positive cells scattered in the surrounding lymphoid tissue. Distinct, well-formed nodules are not apparent in this field. In the context of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, the ill-defined, expansile distribution may reflect a variant growth pattern; cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification, and interpretation depends on the antigen and the companion stains of the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have sharply demarcated germinal centers with intact mantle zones, whereas this field shows an ill-defined, disrupted aggregate.
THRLBCL lacks residual small-B-cell nodules and FDC meshworks; loss of all nodular B-cell compartments would favor THRLBCL over variant NLPHL.
PTGC forms large but round, well-defined nodules without atypical LP cells.

61914.recognize_zh: 低倍下胃腸道黏膜切片的固有層被密集細胞浸潤明顯撐開，腺體被推開、間距變寬，但腺體本身與表面上皮大致保留、沒有破壞或潰瘍；這種「浸潤擴張固有層卻不破壞腺體」的樣式是NK細胞腸病（NK-cell enteropathy）的低倍線索，需靠高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Low-power view of gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy fragments with the lamina propria markedly expanded by a dense cellular infiltrate
Glands are widely separated and displaced but remain largely intact, without extensive gland destruction
Surface epithelium partially preserved without ulceration or necrosis in this field
Adjacent fragment at right shows less involved mucosa with closely packed glands
Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification
61914.describe_en: Low-power sections of gastrointestinal mucosal biopsies show the lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense cellular infiltrate that separates and displaces glands. The glands and surface epithelium are largely preserved, and there is no ulceration, necrosis or mass-forming destructive growth in this field. An adjacent fragment shows less involved mucosa. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification; in conjunction with higher-power morphology and an NK-cell immunophenotype (CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+, surface CD3-, CD5-, EBER-), these findings are compatible with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows angiocentric, angiodestructive growth with necrosis and ulceration and is EBER-positive, whereas NK-cell enteropathy is superficial, non-destructive and EBER-negative.

ddx.dx: Enteropathy-associated or monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: EATL/MEITL form transmural destructive masses with prominent epitheliotropism and a clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement, unlike this mucosa-confined non-destructive infiltrate.
Inflammatory lamina propria expansion is polymorphous with plasma cells, neutrophils and crypt/gland injury, rather than a monotonous sheet of medium-sized NK cells.

61850.recognize_zh: CD1a 免疫染色在小淋巴球背景中，標出一群較大、細胞質豐富、核不規則的細胞，呈膜狀與細胞質陽性；搭配 Langerin 陰性即支持不定型樹突細胞腫瘤（indeterminate dendritic cell tumor）。
features: Large cells with moderate-to-abundant cytoplasm and oval to irregular, occasionally grooved nuclei
Membranous and cytoplasmic CD1a positivity in the large cells
Variable staining intensity, forming loose clusters and sheets
Background of CD1a-negative small lymphocytes
No epidermotropic or sinusoidal pattern evident in this field
61850.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD1a shows a diffuse infiltrate of large histiocytoid cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval to irregular nuclei, displaying membranous and cytoplasmic positivity of variable intensity. Interspersed small lymphocytes are negative. CD1a expression establishes dendritic cell (Langerhans-type) lineage; distinction between Langerhans cell histiocytosis and indeterminate dendritic cell tumor requires Langerin (CD207) staining and/or electron microscopy for Birbeck granules. In conjunction with Langerin negativity, findings are consistent with indeterminate dendritic cell tumor.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are CD1a+ and also Langerin (CD207)+ with Birbeck granules and often admixed eosinophils, whereas indeterminate cell tumor is Langerin negative.
RDD histiocytes are S100+ with emperipolesis but CD1a negative.
IDCS is S100+ but CD1a and Langerin negative and shows a paracortical spindle-to-ovoid cell pattern.
CD1a+ T-lymphoblasts are small-to-medium cells with high N:C ratio and TdT/CD3 positivity, not large histiocytoid cells.

61786.recognize_zh: G-banding 核型圖中第 7 號被圈起，右側那條明顯比左側短、長臂中段帶型缺失，其他染色體成對、總數 46，對應 del(7q) 間隙缺失。
features: GTG-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes arranged by ISCN order
Chromosome 7 pair circled: one homolog shorter with loss of mid-to-distal long-arm bands, consistent with interstitial del(7)(q22q32)
No numerical abnormality; all autosomes otherwise paired
Single X and a small Y (partly obscured by watermark), consistent with a male karyotype
Band resolution is modest; exact breakpoints are inferred from the report rather than resolvable in this image
61786.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow aspirate culture shows a 46,XY complement. One chromosome 7 homolog is shortened owing to an interstitial deletion of the long arm, reported as del(7)(q22q32); the remaining chromosomes appear structurally normal at this resolution. The reported clone was present in 17 of 20 metaphases with a residual normal 46,XY population. In the setting of acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic maturation, the finding is consistent with AML with an MDS-related cytogenetic abnormality (del(7q)), which carries an adverse prognosis.

ddx.vs: Loss of an entire chromosome 7 leaves only one homolog and 45 chromosomes, whereas here both chromosome 7 homologs are present with one shortened.
Would show an abnormal derivative chromosome carrying extra material, identifiable by altered banding and confirmable with FISH/whole-chromosome paint rather than a simple shortened homolog.
An isochromosome has symmetric identical arms around the centromere, unlike the asymmetric loss of mid-long-arm bands seen here.

ddx.dx: Constitutional chromosome 7 variant or preparation artifact
ddx.vs: A constitutional change would be present in all metaphases including PHA-stimulated peripheral blood, whereas this clone coexists with normal metaphases.

61722.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 blast gate 的 CD2 對 CD4 散點圖：綠色腫瘤芽細胞群 CD4 呈中等陽性，並分成 CD2 陰性與 CD2 陽性兩個亞群；CD4 陽性但缺乏 CD3 的芽細胞是 BPDCN 的免疫表現型特徵之一。
features: Dot plot: CD2-APC (x-axis) versus CD4-ECD (y-axis), gated on blasts
Neoplastic population (green) uniformly CD4-positive at moderate intensity
Bimodal CD2: a major CD2-negative subset and a smaller discrete CD2-positive subset, both CD4+
Red events (residual normal blasts/progenitors) CD4-negative and CD2-negative
CD3 status is not shown on this plot
61722.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD2 versus CD4 gated on blasts shows that the neoplastic population (green) is uniformly positive for CD4 at moderate intensity. CD2 is bimodal, with a major CD2-negative subset and a smaller CD2-positive subset. Residual normal progenitors (red) are negative for both markers. CD4 expression by blasts, with partial CD2, is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which may aberrantly express CD2 or CD7; exclusion of T-lineage (surface/cytoplasmic CD3) and monocytic markers and demonstration of bright CD123 are required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts are CD4-dim positive but also express CD64, CD14, CD11b and CD36 with high side scatter, unlike BPDCN.
T-ALL is CD2/CD4+ but expresses cytoplasmic CD3, CD7 and TdT and lacks bright CD123 and TCF4.

ddx.dx: Early T-cell precursor or mixed-phenotype leukemia
ddx.vs: These require cytoplasmic CD3 and myeloid/stem cell markers (CD34, CD117, CD13, CD33) rather than a CD4+/CD56+/CD123-bright profile.

61658.recognize_zh: 血片中紅血球密密麻麻擠在一起、幾乎沒有空隙（反映血球容積升高），紅血球大小形狀大致正常，並可見嗜鹼性球（中央偏下的粗顆粒細胞）與嗜中性球、嗜酸性球，這些是真性紅血球增多症的非特異性血片線索。
features: Densely crowded, overlapping red cells with little intervening space, suggestive of erythrocytosis
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with minimal poikilocytosis; a few polychromatic cells
Basophil with coarse dark purple granules (lower centre)
Segmented neutrophil (upper right) and eosinophil-like bilobed granulocyte (left)
Angular mononuclear cell with indistinct nuclear detail, deformed by surrounding red cells (centre)
Platelets present in adequate to increased numbers, singly dispersed
61658.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed, overlapping red cells with scant background space, in keeping with an increased red cell mass. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis, and occasional polychromatic cells are present. Leukocytes include a segmented neutrophil, a bilobed eosinophil-like granulocyte and a basophil, and platelets are adequate to increased. No blasts, teardrop cells or leukoerythroblastic features are seen. These findings are nonspecific on their own but are consistent with polycythemia vera in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Secondary erythrocytosis also shows crowded red cells but typically lacks basophilia and thrombocytosis, has high erythropoietin and is JAK2 negative.
Dehydration-related relative polycythemia shows similar red cell crowding with a normal red cell mass and no leukocytosis, basophilia or thrombocytosis, and resolves with volume repletion.
CML shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted myeloid series including myelocytes and prominent basophilia, not predominant red cell crowding.
The spent phase shows teardrop cells, anisopoikilocytosis and a leukoerythroblastic picture, which are absent here.

61594.recognize_zh: 單一顆高核質比的母細胞，染色質細緻，核上可見散在細小嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），細胞質深藍；在剛打過 G-CSF 的移植後病人，這種帶淡顆粒的「再生性」母細胞屬生長因子效應，但本圖未見中性球的毒性顆粒或 Döhle 小體。
features: Single intermediate-to-large blast-like cell with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin
Fine azurophilic granules scattered over the nucleus/cytoplasm
Thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale crescent at one edge
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and rare teardrop forms; platelets markedly reduced
61594.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single intermediate-to-large immature myeloid cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing scattered fine azurophilic granules. A pale crescent is seen at one edge of the cytoplasm; definite Döhle bodies cannot be resolved with confidence in this cell. No neutrophils are present in this field, so the toxic granulation and Döhle bodies described in the neutrophils cannot be evaluated here, and platelets are markedly decreased. In a post-transplant patient recently given G-CSF, a rare circulating granulated blast is suggestive of growth factor effect, but correlation with blast percentage trend and marrow/MRD studies is required to exclude relapse.

ddx.dx: Relapsed acute leukemia (Ph+ ALL or therapy-related AML)
ddx.vs: Relapse shows a persistent or rising blast population with an aberrant immunophenotype/MRD positivity, whereas G-CSF-related blasts are transient, few, granulated and accompanied by a left-shifted maturing granulocytic series.

ddx.dx: Infection-related left shift with toxic changes
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps (toxic granulation, Döhle bodies); history of recent G-CSF and the transient course favor growth factor effect.
Shows larger, sharply defined Döhle-like inclusions in all neutrophils together with giant platelets, without circulating blasts.

61530.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜內一個淋巴細胞結節，結節內大多數細胞呈 BCL6 核陽性，陽性細胞明顯集中在結節中，周圍固有層僅零星陽性；顯示結節由生發中心 B 細胞組成，搭配 BCL2 陽性支持濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Nodular lymphoid aggregate in the duodenal lamina propria
Nuclear BCL6 positivity in most cells within the nodule, with variable intensity
Scattered BCL6-positive cells outside the nodule in the interfollicular lamina propria
Crypt epithelium negative; weak nonspecific staining of smooth muscle bundles at the top left
61530.describe_en: Duodenal mucosal biopsy stained for BCL6 shows a nodular lymphoid aggregate in which the majority of cells exhibit nuclear BCL6 positivity of variable intensity. Scattered positive cells are also present in the adjacent lamina propria, while crypt epithelium is negative and smooth muscle shows only faint background staining. The findings indicate a germinal center B-cell phenotype. In conjunction with CD10 and aberrant BCL2 expression, this is consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are also BCL6+ but BCL2 negative, so BCL6 alone cannot separate them from follicular lymphoma.
Neoplastic marginal zone cells are BCL6 negative, with BCL6 limited to colonized residual germinal centers.
Mantle cell lymphoma is BCL6 negative in most cases and is cyclin D1+/CD5+.

61466.recognize_zh: 許多正常大小紅血球內有細小環狀體，其中不少為雙核點（double chromatin）或一顆紅血球內兩個環狀體；中央白血球胞質內可見吞噬的寄生蟲殘骸與棕色瘧色素，符合惡性瘧（P. falciparum）。
features: Numerous normocytic erythrocytes with small, delicate ring forms; several with double chromatin dots and double infections
Appliqué (marginal) ring forms at the RBC edge
Infected RBCs are not enlarged and show no Schüffner stippling
Central phagocyte (neutrophil) containing phagocytosed parasite material and brown hemozoin granules
Adjacent immature myeloid cell (metamyelocyte/myelocyte) with coarse chromatin
No mature trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes in this field
61466.describe_en: Peripheral blood thin smear shows numerous intraerythrocytic ring-form parasites within normal-sized red cells, many with double chromatin dots and multiple rings per cell, including appliqué forms. Infected red cells lack enlargement and Schüffner stippling, and no late trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes are seen. A central neutrophil contains ingested parasite remnants and brown malarial pigment, next to an immature granulocyte. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection; parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Enlarged RBCs with Schüffner dots and ameboid trophozoites are expected, whereas here the rings are tiny and the RBCs normal-sized.
Babesia lacks hemozoin pigment and may show extracellular forms and tetrads; pigment in the leukocyte here favors Plasmodium.
Parasitemia is low with band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts in normal-sized or small RBCs, not a high burden of multiply infected cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — numerous rings with double chromatin dots and multiple infection; neutrophil with ingested malarial pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：辨識 ring 期並判斷蟲種 → double chromatin dot、appliqué、多重感染、紅血球不變大、無 Schüffner dots = P. falciparum。
周邊血只見 ring（無 trophozoite/schizont）符合 P. falciparum 的 sequestration；P. vivax 通常可見各期且紅血球變大。
白血球吞噬 hemozoin 為感染線索，在寄生蟲數少或治療後仍可殘留。
必報 parasitemia %；P. falciparum 屬急症，重症（如 parasitemia >10%、意識改變、腎衰竭）用 IV artesunate。
P. falciparum 對 chloroquine 普遍抗藥，非重症常用 artemisinin-based combination therapy（ACT）。
exam.pitfall_zh: Ring 易與 Babesia 混淆；Babesia 無 hemozoin 色素、可見四聯體 Maltese cross 且可在紅血球外，本圖 neutrophil 含瘧疾色素支持 Plasmodium。

quiz.q: 紅血球內 ring 帶有兩個 chromatin dot 且一顆紅血球多個 ring，最支持哪一種瘧原蟲？
quiz.a: Plasmodium falciparum

61402.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球中散佈大量碎裂紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔細胞、三角形與角形碎片，同時血小板幾乎看不到；配合新生兒黃疸、貧血、血小板低下，應想到微血管病變性溶血，例如先天性 TTP（ADAMTS13 缺乏）。
features: Numerous schistocytes: helmet cells, triangular and irregular angular fragments, and keratocytes
Background of normocytic red cells with variable central pallor; scattered larger, bluish-tinged polychromatophilic cells
Occasional small, dense spherocyte-like microspherocytes
Platelets markedly decreased; only rare small platelet-sized particles seen
Single dark nucleated cell at upper right edge; fine dark specks over red cells likely stain precipitate
61402.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly abnormal red cell population with abundant schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular fragments and keratocytes, admixed with occasional microspherocytes and polychromatophilic red cells. Platelets are markedly decreased. No red cell agglutination or intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. In a neonate with jaundice, anemia and thrombocytopenia, the findings indicate a microangiopathic hemolytic anemia; congenital thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (ADAMTS13 deficiency, Upshaw-Schulman syndrome) should be excluded by ADAMTS13 activity and genetic testing. Findings are consistent with thrombotic microangiopathy.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes can look identical, so separation relies on prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and high D-dimer in DIC versus normal coagulation tests and severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity in TTP.
Morphology overlaps completely; aHUS shows prominent renal failure with preserved ADAMTS13 activity (>10%) and complement pathway abnormalities.
Shows extreme micropoikilocytes, budding forms and elliptocytes with a very low MCV and normal platelet count, rather than helmet cells with thrombocytopenia.

ddx.dx: Alloimmune hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: Features spherocytes, polychromasia and nucleated red cells with a positive DAT, lacking abundant schistocytes and severe thrombocytopenia.

exam.answer_en: Microangiopathic hemolytic anemia in a neonate — numerous schistocytes (helmet cells) with thrombocytopenia; consider congenital TTP (Upshaw-Schulman)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 helmet cell、三角形碎片、keratocyte，問「這是什麼細胞、代表什麼」→ schistocytes，MAHA；合併血小板低下 = thrombotic microangiopathy。
新生兒 MAHA + 嚴重高膽紅素血症需想到 congenital TTP（ADAMTS13 雙對偶基因變異）；ADAMTS13 activity <10% 且無抑制抗體。
治療：congenital TTP 以補充 ADAMTS13 為主（FFP/plasma infusion 或 recombinant ADAMTS13），不需 immunosuppression。
鑑別：DIC（PT/aPTT 延長、fibrinogen 低）；aHUS（補體調控異常、腎損傷為主）。TTP 通常凝血功能大致正常。
急症意義：TMA 是血液科急症，應同時送 ADAMTS13 再開始治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 hereditary pyropoikilocytosis 的碎片化紅血球；HPP 無血小板低下且 MCV 極低、熱敏感，TMA 則合併血小板低下與溶血指標上升。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球碎片（如 helmet cell）稱為什麼？新生兒出現此血片加血小板低下，應檢測哪個酵素活性？
quiz.a: Schistocytes；ADAMTS13 activity

61338.recognize_zh: 視野中有數顆大小不一的淋巴樣細胞，細胞核有缺刻、摺疊或呈 U 形／腦迴狀輪廓（上右與下中央最明顯），染色質粗、細胞質少，與旁邊正常的單核球及桿狀嗜中性球不同，提示皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤的異常淋巴球侵犯骨髓。
features: Atypical lymphoid cells of variable size with scant to moderate blue cytoplasm
Nuclear contours notched, folded or U-shaped with convoluted cerebriform outlines (upper right, lower center)
Coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Smaller lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei (right, lower left)
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and vacuolated gray cytoplasm and a band neutrophil (upper left) for comparison
61338.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several lymphoid cells of variable size with scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm and irregular nuclear contours, including notched, U-shaped and convoluted cerebriform nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A monocyte and a band neutrophil are present for size comparison. No blasts are seen in this field. In a patient with known cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by atypical cerebriform T cells, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry (e.g. CD4+ with loss of CD7/CD26) or immunohistochemistry on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: Shows more pronounced polylobated flower cells, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 infection.
Reactive lymphocytes have round nuclei with abundant cytoplasm and lack a phenotypically aberrant CD4+ population.
Small round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
Have lacy chromatin, abundant gray vacuolated cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity, unlike the dense chromatin of cerebriform lymphocytes.

61210.recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片中大量中至大型淋巴樣細胞，核膜極度不規則、呈折疊或腦迴狀（cerebriform），細胞質淡藍、部分含細小紫紅色顆粒，與少數小而深染的正常淋巴球對比，符合 T 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯 CSF。
features: Markedly increased cellularity composed of atypical small to large lymphoid cells
Profound nuclear membrane irregularities: deeply folded, convoluted, lobulated and cerebriform nuclei
Finely granular to slightly clumped chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, some cells containing fine azurophilic granules
Scattered small mature lymphocytes with dense round nuclei and rare red cells for size comparison
61210.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a marked lymphocytosis dominated by atypical small to large lymphoid cells with profoundly irregular, folded and cerebriform nuclear contours, finely granular chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, some containing fine azurophilic granules. Scattered small mature lymphocytes are present for comparison, and there is no neutrophilic or monocytic component. The atypia is well beyond that of reactive lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with CSF involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma, supported by flow cytometry showing an aberrant CD3+/CD5-/CD7 bright/CD8+/CD16/56+ T-cell population.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are mostly small with smooth to mildly indented nuclei, admixed with monocytes, and show no aberrant antigen loss on flow cytometry.
Flower cells with multilobated nuclei are typically CD4+/CD25+/CD7- and HTLV-1 positive, unlike this CD8+/CD7-bright phenotype.

ddx.dx: Sézary syndrome / mycosis fungoides with CNS spread
ddx.vs: Cerebriform cells are CD4+ and CD7/CD26 negative with a cutaneous history.
Cells are large with round to cleaved nuclei and prominent nucleoli and express CD19/CD20 rather than T-cell antigens.

61146.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量大型細胞，核圓、染色質較細緻並可見核仁，部分雙核，胞質內含深紫色嗜異染顆粒且顆粒大量散落在背景中；這種不成熟、高核質比的顆粒性細胞是嗜異染母細胞/前肥大細胞（promastocyte），見於肥大細胞白血病。
features: Many large cells with round nuclei, relatively fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Variable N:C ratio; several cells show immature, blast-like features and binucleation
Cytoplasm contains dark purple metachromatic granules, often densely overlying the nucleus
Abundant free metachromatic granules scattered throughout the background
Interspersed mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and a macrophage with blue-grey cytoplasm
61146.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field dominated by large, immature-appearing cells with round nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and variably abundant cytoplasm containing dark metachromatic granules; some are binucleated. Numerous free granules are scattered in the background. Mature neutrophils and lymphocytes are sparse. The predominance of immature granulated cells (metachromatic blasts/promastocytes) is consistent with mast cell leukemia; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 studies and exclusion of myelomastocytic leukemia are recommended.

ddx.vs: Myelomastocytic leukemia has ≥20% myeloblasts with increased immature tryptase-positive cells but does not meet systemic mastocytosis criteria (no KIT D816V/CD25 aberrancy).
Basophilic blasts are CD117-negative and tryptase weak/negative, with granules that are ultrastructurally basophil-type.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, azurophilic granules and Auer rod bundles, with strong MPO and PML::RARA.

61082.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見大卵圓形紅血球、淚滴與碎片紅血球及多分葉嗜中性球（插圖為嗜鹼性點彩）；骨髓中紅系前驅細胞體積大、染色質呈細緻篩孔狀且核質發育不同步，並有巨大後骨髓球，切片呈大量幼稚細胞易被誤認為白血病。
features: PB (A): marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop and fragmented cells, and a hypersegmented neutrophil; inset shows basophilic stippling
Aspirate (B): hypercellular with erythroid predominance; many large precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Aspirate (C): megaloblasts with open, finely stippled (sieve-like) chromatin and nuclear–cytoplasmic asynchrony; giant cells with ribbon-like/mitotic chromatin
Giant metamyelocyte/band forms and dysplastic granulocytes
Biopsy (D): sheets of large immature cells with open chromatin and scattered eosinophilic precursors, mimicking acute leukemia
61082.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells, schistocytes, basophilic stippling and a hypersegmented neutrophil. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia and megaloblastic maturation, characterized by large precursors with finely stippled open chromatin and nuclear–cytoplasmic asynchrony, together with giant granulocytic forms. The core biopsy shows sheets of large immature-appearing cells that can mimic acute leukemia. In an exclusively breastfed infant with low serum B12, findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, usually complex/TP53-mutated, and does not correct with B12 replacement.
MDS megaloblastoid change occurs with normal B12/folate, clonal cytogenetics and persistent dysplasia, rather than reversing after replacement.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by serum/RBC folate and methylmalonic acid (elevated only in B12 deficiency).
CDA shows binucleated/internuclear bridging erythroblasts with normal vitamin levels and lacks hypersegmented neutrophils and giant metamyelocytes.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency — megaloblastic erythroid precursors, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：PB 指 hypersegmented neutrophil、macro-ovalocyte；骨髓指 megaloblast（篩狀染色質、核質不同步）與 giant metamyelocyte；切片可像急性白血病。
嬰兒病因：純母乳哺育而母親 B12 缺乏（素食、惡性貧血、減重手術後）；嬰兒可有發展遲緩、張力低下等神經症狀。
B12 vs 葉酸：MMA 與 homocysteine 在 B12 缺乏皆升高，葉酸缺乏僅 homocysteine 升高。
無效造血使 LDH、間接膽紅素升高；補充 B12 後數天網狀紅血球上升。只補葉酸可部分改善貧血，但神經損傷會持續。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨髓切片易誤診為急性白血病（尤其 erythroid leukemia）；見 giant metamyelocyte、多分葉嗜中性球，且 B12 低、補充後可逆，即可區分。

quiz.q: 骨髓中核呈大馬蹄形、體積明顯大於正常的顆粒球前驅細胞叫什麼？指向何種疾病？
quiz.a: Giant metamyelocyte/band；megaloblastic anemia (B12/folate deficiency)

61018.recognize_zh: 視野中許多紅血球呈「標靶」狀：中央有一團血紅素、外圍一圈淡染區、再外一圈血紅素（target cell），另混有緻密無中央淡染的小紅血球與皺摺狀細胞；大量標靶細胞在 HbC 特質或 HbC 疾病中常見。
features: Numerous target cells (codocytes) with a central hemoglobin disc surrounded by a pale ring and peripheral hemoglobin rim
Several dense, spherocyte-like cells lacking central pallor
Occasional folded cells with linear or slit-like central pallor
Mild anisocytosis; red cells appear normocytic to slightly microcytic
No HbC crystals, leukocytes or parasites identified in this field; few platelets
61018.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells, accompanied by occasional dense, spherocyte-like cells and folded cells with slit-like pallor. There is mild anisocytosis without significant hypochromia. No intraerythrocytic HbC crystals are seen in this field. In the clinical setting, these findings are consistent with a hemoglobin C trait, which should be confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC.

ddx.vs: Homozygous HbC shows more target cells with numerous spherocytic cells and characteristic hexagonal/rod-shaped HbC crystals, plus mild hemolytic anemia.
Thalassemia target cells are accompanied by marked microcytosis, hypochromia and basophilic stippling, and electrophoresis shows altered HbA2/HbF rather than HbC.
Target cells from membrane lipid excess are macrocytic, often with acanthocytes or stomatocytes, and hemoglobin electrophoresis is normal.
HbSC shows target cells plus boat-shaped/folded cells and 'Washington monument' SC crystals with a distinct electrophoretic pattern.

exam.answer_en: Numerous target cells (codocytes) with dense spherocyte-like and folded cells — consistent with hemoglobin C trait/disease; confirm by HPLC
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「中央一團血紅素、外圍淡染圈再一圈血紅素」的細胞問名稱與機轉 → target cell，因表面積相對體積過大（膜脂質增加或細胞內血紅素減少）。
鑑別清單：hemoglobinopathy（HbC、HbE、HbS/C）、thalassemia、阻塞性黃疸/肝病（膜脂質堆積）、脾切除後；台灣與東南亞族群需特別想到 thalassemia 與 HbE。
確診檢查：Hb electrophoresis 或 HPLC；thalassemia 看 HbA2/HbF 與 MCV，缺鐵時 HbA2 可被低估，需先矯正鐵缺乏再判讀。
Target cells 的滲透脆性（osmotic fragility）降低，與 hereditary spherocytosis 的脆性增加相反，可作為觀念題。
exam.pitfall_zh: 推片乾燥過慢或濕度高會產生假性 target cell（僅出現在抹片局部區域）；真正病理性 target cell 應均勻分布於整張片的適當觀察區。

quiz.q: 圖中大量出現的紅血球形態是什麼？請舉出兩種在台灣最需優先考慮的血紅素相關原因與確診檢查。
quiz.a: Target cell（codocyte）；thalassemia、HbE（或 HbC）等 hemoglobinopathy，以 Hb electrophoresis/HPLC 確診

60954.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中，血小板聚集成大團、顆粒豐富的血小板凝集塊，集中在抹片邊緣一帶（A），而紅血球分布均勻的區域幾乎只剩零星單顆血小板與小團塊（B）；新生兒血小板計數極低卻有大量凝集，配合家族史提示 von Willebrand 病 2B 型。
features: Panel A: numerous large aggregates of well-granulated platelets, several containing larger platelets, distributed in streaks toward the thin/feathered area
Panel B: monolayer area with only scattered single platelets and a few small clumps between evenly spread red cells
Occasional leukocytes within or adjacent to aggregates; no platelet satellitism around neutrophils
Red cells and leukocytes without evident morphologic abnormality at this low magnification (×20)
60954.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows numerous large aggregates of well-granulated, partly large platelets, predominantly in the thin edge of the smear, while the monolayer contains few single platelets and only small clumps. There is no platelet satellitism, and red cell and leukocyte morphology is unremarkable at this power. The platelet aggregation explains a falsely low or genuinely reduced automated platelet count; in a neonate with a family history of VWD type 2B, the findings are consistent with von Willebrand disease type 2B-associated in vivo platelet aggregation, which requires confirmation by RIPA and VWF multimer analysis.

ddx.vs: Clumps form in EDTA only and resolve in citrate or fingerstick smears, and there is no family history or loss of high-molecular-weight VWF multimers.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by mixing studies/RIPA showing a GPIBA platelet defect rather than a VWF gene mutation.
Shows uniformly giant single platelets (and Döhle-like inclusions in MYH9) without prominent aggregates.

ddx.dx: Clotted specimen from difficult neonatal collection
ddx.vs: Clots contain fibrin strands with entrapped leukocytes and red cells, and repeat clean collection normalizes the count.

60890.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中一小群大小相近的芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等嗜鹼性，但細胞質一側可見聚集的粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，外觀近似前骨髓細胞或嗜鹼性球；結合 B-ALL 病史與 MPO 陰性，為顆粒型（hypergranular）B-ALL 的中樞神經復發。
features: Cluster of medium to large blasts with round nuclei and high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not well seen
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Coarse purple-pink azurophilic granules aggregated in one region of the cytoplasm, partly overlying the nucleus
No Auer rods; clean CSF background without other inflammatory cells
60890.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a small cluster of medium to large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts contain coarse azurophilic granules aggregated in a paranuclear region of the cytoplasm, mimicking promyelocytes or basophils. Auer rods are not seen. In a patient with known precursor B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (CD19+, CD10+, TdT+, MPO negative), findings are consistent with CNS relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia with granular (hypergranular) blast morphology.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia / acute promyelocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts with azurophilic granules are MPO positive and may have Auer rods, whereas these granular lymphoblasts are MPO negative and express CD19, CD10 and TdT.
Basophilic blasts show metachromatic granules with toluidine blue and express CD123/CD203c without B-lineage markers.
Reactive cells are heterogeneous with mature chromatin and lack the uniform blastic nuclei with fine chromatin.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles rather than azurophilic granules and are TdT negative with MYC rearrangement.

60826.recognize_zh: 低倍下組織被密集、瀰漫的淋巴組織球浸潤取代，中間穿插粉紅色、不規則的膠原硬化帶，沒有清楚的淋巴濾泡；這種大片細胞浸潤加上硬化的背景，是縱膈灰區淋巴瘤的低倍線索，但須靠高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse, dense cellular infiltrate effacing normal architecture
Irregular pink collagenous bands and interstitial sclerosis traversing the infiltrate
Mixed population of lymphocytes and paler histiocytes/larger cells at low power
No well-formed follicles or nodules separated by broad fibrous bands
Individual large atypical cells not resolvable at this magnification
60826.describe_en: Low-power section shows diffuse effacement of the architecture by a dense lymphohistiocytic infiltrate traversed by irregular bands and strands of collagenous sclerosis. There is no discernible follicular pattern and no well-defined nodularity. Large atypical cells cannot be adequately assessed at this magnification. In conjunction with high-power morphology and immunohistochemistry, the findings are compatible with a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Nodular sclerosis cHL shows broad birefringent collagen bands encircling cellular nodules with lacunar cells, and large cells are CD20/Oct-2 weak or negative.
PMBL has sheets of medium-to-large cells with clear cytoplasm compartmentalized by fine fibrosis with fewer background inflammatory cells.
Reactive fibrosis lacks atypical large cells and shows polyclonal mixed inflammation on immunostaining.

60762.recognize_zh: 四格組圖：A、B 骨髓抹片的巨噬細胞細胞質內充滿 2–4 µm、帶透明暈的小酵母菌（箭頭），B 同時吞噬有核細胞與紅血球（噬血現象）；C 切片中的巨噬細胞含多顆吞噬細胞與小酵母；D 銀染（GMS）將成群黑色卵圓形酵母染出，綜合指向組織漿菌感染引發的噬血症候群。
features: Panel A (Wright-Giemsa): macrophage with vacuolated blue cytoplasm containing numerous small (2-4 um) oval intracellular yeasts with a clear halo and eccentric dark chromatin (arrow)
Panel B (Wright-Giemsa): macrophage engulfing nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells (hemophagocytosis) together with clustered intracellular yeasts (arrow)
Panel C (H&E): large histiocyte containing several phagocytosed nucleated cells, with small yeast forms in an adjacent histiocyte (arrows)
Panel D (GMS/silver stain): clusters of black-staining small oval yeasts, some with narrow-based budding, against a green counterstain
Background marrow elements including red cells, lymphocytes and myeloid precursors
60762.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow findings. Aspirate smears (A, B) show macrophages whose cytoplasm contains numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms with a surrounding clear halo, and one macrophage has engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells, indicating hemophagocytosis. The marrow section (C) shows histiocytes containing phagocytosed nucleated cells and small intracellular yeasts, and a Grocott methenamine silver stain (D) highlights clusters of small oval yeasts with occasional narrow-based budding. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis secondary to disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by fungal culture, Histoplasma urine/serum antigen or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Amastigotes are similar in size but show a rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and do not stain with GMS.
Intracellular yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding, and are often sausage-shaped.
Yeasts are larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped and GMS negative, whereas Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped, extracellular and lack budding.

exam.answer_en: Secondary HLH due to disseminated histoplasmosis — marrow macrophages with hemophagocytosis and 2–4 µm intracellular haloed yeasts, GMS-positive with narrow-based budding
pearls_zh: 考法：四格圖通常考兩件事——指著巨噬細胞內的小酵母問病原（Histoplasma capsulatum），再指吞噬有核細胞的巨噬細胞問現象（hemophagocytosis），合併成「感染引發的 secondary HLH」。
HLH-2004 診斷標準（8 項符合 5 項）：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球減少、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、組織中噬血現象、NK 活性低下、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 升高；噬血現象本身既非必要也不足以診斷。
「iatrogenic」線索：TNF-α inhibitors（如 infliximab）、類固醇或其他免疫抑制治療是播散性組織漿菌病的重要危險因子。
確認與治療：尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen、真菌培養、GMS/PAS 染色；重症播散型以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，之後改 itraconazole；治療感染誘因是 secondary HLH 的核心。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes：兩者大小相近且都在巨噬細胞內，但 Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast、GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、有透明暈、GMS 陽性且可見窄基出芽。

quiz.q: 圖 D 以銀染（GMS）染成黑色的小型卵圓酵母，與 Leishmania 最關鍵的形態與染色差異是什麼？
quiz.a: Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、GMS 陽性並可見窄基出芽；Leishmania 有 kinetoplast 且 GMS 陰性。

60634.recognize_zh: 抹片中成群的大型淋巴樣細胞，核大、染色質疏鬆且有明顯核仁，細胞質嗜鹼性並有小空泡；B 圖免疫染色顯示腫瘤細胞瀰漫成片陽性，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤白血病期。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, 2–3 times the size of a red cell, with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with vesicular/open chromatin and one or more distinct nucleoli
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles
Adjacent macrophage with foamy, debris-laden cytoplasm (panel A, upper left)
Panel B: tissue section with diffuse sheets of tumor cells showing strong brown immunostaining (specific antigen not labeled), effacing normal architecture
60634.describe_en: Panel A shows a smear with numerous large atypical lymphoid cells having vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, accompanied by a macrophage containing phagocytosed debris. Panel B shows a tissue section in which the tumor grows in diffuse sheets with strong immunohistochemical positivity; the antigen is not labeled in the figure, so lineage must be confirmed with B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5, CD19) and flow cytometry. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with multiple small nucleoli and intensely basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles, a Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement without BCL2.
Blasts have finer chromatin and express TdT/CD34 or myeloid markers, whereas DLBCL cells are mature (surface light chain restricted, TdT negative).
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14), which is absent in DLBCL.
Prolymphocytes have a single central prominent nucleolus with more condensed chromatin and a CLL phenotype (CD5+, CD23+).

60698.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中可見體積巨大的原紅血球 (giant pronormoblasts)，核內呈淡染玻璃樣包涵體、細胞質深藍帶空泡；免疫染色在這些巨大細胞的核膜呈環狀陽性，符合急性小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Panel A: scattered giant erythroid precursors with large nuclei containing glassy, pale-eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin
Panel A: relative paucity of maturing erythroid precursors; granulocytic cells present
Panel B: giant proerythroblast with abundant deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and large round nucleus
Panel C: IHC with strong nuclear rim/whole-nucleus staining in enlarged cells (consistent with parvovirus B19 antigen)
Megakaryocytes present
60698.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows scattered giant erythroid precursors with large nuclei containing glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and peripherally condensed chromatin, with few maturing erythroid forms. The aspirate shows giant proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry highlights the enlarged cells with a nuclear rim/nuclear pattern consistent with parvovirus B19 capsid antigen. Findings are consistent with acute parvovirus B19 infection with erythroid hypoplasia.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets without intranuclear glassy inclusions and are negative for parvovirus IHC/PCR, with TP53 alterations.
Megaloblastic marrow shows erythroid hyperplasia across all maturation stages with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, not isolated giant pronormoblasts with inclusions.

ddx.dx: Thymoma- or drug-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Non-viral PRCA lacks giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions and is negative for parvovirus B19 staining.

exam.answer_en: Acute parvovirus B19 infection — giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and erythroid hypoplasia, confirmed by B19 IHC
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核內玻璃樣包涵體、染色質推擠到核膜的巨大紅系前驅細胞，問「什麼病毒？」→ parvovirus B19（giant pronormoblast / lantern cell）。
機轉：B19 以 P antigen（globoside）為受體，感染並破壞紅系前驅細胞，造成網狀紅血球顯著下降。
臨床：慢性溶血病人（如 hereditary spherocytosis、sickle cell）引發 transient aplastic crisis；免疫低下者可成慢性 pure red cell aplasia，以 IVIG 治療。
免疫低下者抗體反應差，血清學可能陰性，應以 B19 DNA PCR 診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pure erythroid leukemia：後者為成片不成熟紅系母細胞、常有 TP53 突變且無核內病毒包涵體；B19 為散在巨大前驅細胞加上紅系成熟階段缺乏。

quiz.q: 圖中帶核內玻璃樣包涵體的巨大紅系細胞提示哪種病毒？該病毒的細胞受體為何？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19；P antigen（globoside）

60570.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片中央有一個大型細胞，周圍有空暈 (retraction artifact)，細胞含兩個相鄰的大型空泡狀核，其中一個有明顯的嗜酸性巨大核仁，背景為小淋巴球、組織球與嗜酸性球，符合典型霍奇金淋巴瘤的 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Large cell with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm surrounded by a clear retraction halo
Two closely apposed large vesicular nuclei with thin, crisp nuclear membranes and cleared chromatin
Large, inclusion-like eosinophilic/magenta macronucleolus in one nucleus and a smaller nucleolus in the other
Background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes with vesicular nuclei and an occasional eosinophil (lower right)
Delicate fibrillary stroma between cells
60570.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows a large atypical cell with abundant pale cytoplasm set in a retraction space, containing two apposed vesicular nuclei with thin nuclear membranes and a prominent inclusion-like eosinophilic macronucleolus. The background consists of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and scattered eosinophils. Although the image caption describes a mononuclear variant, the depicted cell appears bilobed/binucleate at this plane of section. Findings are consistent with a Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, CD15, PAX5 (weak) and CD45 negativity is recommended.

ddx.vs: LP 'popcorn' cells have multilobated folded nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20+/CD45+ and CD30/CD15 negative.
ALCL shows sheets of hallmark cells with horseshoe/kidney nuclei and sinusoidal growth, CD30+ with T-cell markers or ALK and no CD15/PAX5.
Reactive immunoblasts have smaller amphophilic nucleoli, retain CD45/CD20 expression and occur in a polymorphous proliferation with preserved architecture.
THRLBCL large cells are strongly CD20+/CD45+ and CD30/CD15 negative in a histiocyte-rich background.

exam.answer_en: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma — large bilobed cell with eosinophilic macronucleoli in a lymphocyte-rich background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有大型嗜伊紅包涵體樣核仁、周圍有收縮空隙的大細胞，問「這是什麼細胞？如何確認？」→ HRS cell，做 CD30/CD15/PAX5/CD45。
Lymphocyte-rich cHL：多呈結節狀、背景以小淋巴球為主、嗜伊紅球與嗜中性球少，HRS 細胞常位於擴大的 mantle zone。
LRcHL 形態與 NLPHL 最像，需 IHC 鑑別：HRS 為 CD30+、CD15+、PAX5 弱、CD20 陰性或弱、OCT2/BOB1 不同時強陽性。
LRcHL 好發年長男性、周邊淋巴結、分期較早，預後屬 cHL 中較佳者。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 NLPHL 的 LP（popcorn）cell 混淆：LP cell 核多分葉如爆米花、核仁較小、CD20+、OCT2/BOB1 強、CD30−/CD15−；HRS 細胞核仁巨大且 CD30+/CD15+。

quiz.q: 圖中帶巨大嗜伊紅核仁的大細胞是什麼？與 LP cell 鑑別最有用的一組 IHC 為何？
quiz.a: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell；CD30、CD15（陽性）與 CD20、OCT2/BOB1（HRS 弱或陰性）

60442.recognize_zh: 低細胞量骨髓 CD34（紅色色原）染色只見零星散在的單顆陽性細胞，部分呈線狀為血管內皮，沒有 CD34 陽性細胞成簇聚集，估計母細胞少於 5%，不支持母細胞增加。
features: Hypocellular fatty marrow with thin interstitial hematopoietic cords
Rare scattered single CD34-positive mononuclear cells with membranous staining
Some linear CD34 staining of capillary endothelium (internal positive control)
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Estimated CD34-positive hematopoietic cells well below 5% of cellularity
60442.describe_en: CD34 immunostain on a hypocellular bone marrow biopsy shows only rare, scattered single positive mononuclear cells, with additional linear staining of capillary endothelium serving as an internal control. No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive cells are identified, and positive hematopoietic cells account for less than 5% of the cellularity. There is no evidence of increased blasts. In the context of a hypocellular marrow with dysplasia, findings support refractory cytopenia of childhood rather than MDS with increased blasts.

ddx.vs: It shows 2-19% blasts in the marrow or blood, often with CD34-positive clusters on biopsy.
CD34 cells are also reduced, so distinction relies on dysplasia, megakaryocyte morphology, and clonal cytogenetics.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts with sheets or clusters of CD34-positive cells.

60186.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片細胞密集、幾乎無脂肪，中央有兩顆偏小的巨核細胞，各只有單一圓形、不分葉的細胞核（monolobated），周圍夾雜許多染色質較開放、核仁可見的未成熟細胞，符合伴隨過多芽細胞的骨髓發育不良（RAEB/MDS-EB）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of hematopoietic cells and minimal fat
Small megakaryocytes with a single round, non-lobated nucleus (monolobated forms) and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous immature-appearing mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Interspersed erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic granulocytes
No fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates evident in this field
60186.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with little residual fat. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including small forms with single round, non-lobated nuclei. The background contains a mixed population of maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors with numerous immature mononuclear cells showing open chromatin and small nucleoli, raising concern for an increase in blasts. CD34 immunohistochemistry and an aspirate differential are needed to quantify blasts. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: CMML shares dysplastic megakaryocytes but requires persistent peripheral monocytosis, with CD14/CD163-positive monocytes increased in the marrow.
CML has small hypolobated megakaryocytes too, but with a packed granulocytic marrow, basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts, typically forming sheets of CD34-positive cells, whereas MDS-EB has 5–19% marrow blasts.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow after G-CSF or regeneration
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a left shift with synchronous maturation and normally lobated megakaryocytes, without monolobated forms or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

60122.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大多數細胞是各階段紅系前驅細胞：深藍細胞質的原紅血球、多染性與正染性紅血球母細胞成群，並可見分裂像與核出芽/碎裂（nuclear budding）；紅系比例約 62%，符合溶血所致的壓力性造血。
features: Marked erythroid predominance with the full spectrum of maturation
Pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear halo
Numerous polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts with round, condensed nuclei
Occasional nuclear budding/fragmentation and a mitotic figure
Few myeloid precursors; no increase in blasts; scattered fat vacuoles
60122.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked erythroid hyperplasia (62% erythroid precursors) with orderly maturation from pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm to numerous polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts. Occasional nuclear budding and a mitotic figure are present, consistent with stressed erythropoiesis, while megaloblastic change and ring-sideroblast-type dysplasia are not evident on this stain. Myeloid precursors are relatively decreased and blasts are not increased (1%). Findings are consistent with a hemolytic process such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplasia beyond occasional budding (megaloblastoid change, multinucleation, ring sideroblasts) and often cytogenetic abnormalities, unlike this orderly maturation.
Pure erythroid leukemia consists of >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas here maturing normoblasts predominate.
Megaloblastic precursors are larger with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, not the condensed nuclei seen here.

60058.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎被單一形態的中型圓核細胞呈片狀取代，核染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，正常造血只剩角落的小群紅血球系與零星巨核細胞；這種瀰漫性母細胞片狀浸潤符合急性白血病，此例經流式與染色體確認為 Ph+ B-lymphoblastic leukemia。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Residual normal hematopoiesis limited to small erythroid islands and occasional megakaryocytes
Scattered adipocytes remain; bony trabecula at upper left
60058.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is markedly reduced and confined to small clusters of erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute leukemia; lineage cannot be assigned on H&E, and immunophenotyping (here CD19+, CD10+, CD34+ with aberrant CD13) and cytogenetics establishing BCR::ABL1 support B-lymphoblastic leukemia with t(9;22).

ddx.vs: Morphology on core biopsy overlaps; myeloid lineage requires MPO or strong CD33/CD117 expression, whereas this case is CD19/CD10/CD79a positive with only aberrant CD13.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Also BCR::ABL1-positive (often p210) but has a preceding chronic phase with granulocytic hyperplasia, basophilia, and small megakaryocytes in residual marrow.
Shows a starry-sky pattern with tingible-body macrophages, basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm on smear, and mature CD20+/sIg+ TdT-negative phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, TdT and CD34 negative, with CCND1 rearrangement.

30170.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞旁可見一群小型、呈臘腸狀或橢圓形、中央有橫隔（transverse septum）的酵母樣菌體，部分成雙排列；這種以分裂而非出芽繁殖的橫隔菌體是馬尼菲青黴菌（Talaromyces/Penicillium marneffei）的特徵。
features: Clusters of small (about 2-6 micron) oval to elongated sausage-shaped yeast-like organisms
Organisms show a central transverse septum/bipolar staining, dividing by fission rather than budding
Organisms lie adjacent to and within vacuolated macrophage cytoplasm
Macrophages and myeloid precursors with coarse granules in the background
Image is slightly out of focus, limiting fine structural detail
30170.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows clusters of small oval to elongated, sausage-shaped yeast-like organisms, several with a distinct central transverse septum, located adjacent to and within macrophages. No budding forms or capsules are appreciated, although focus is suboptimal. Background marrow elements include macrophages and granulated myeloid precursors. Findings are consistent with Talaromyces (Penicillium) marneffei infection; confirmation by fungal culture (red diffusible pigment at 25 C) and GMS/PAS stains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are uniform, round to oval, 2-4 micron with a pseudocapsular halo and narrow-based budding, lacking a transverse septum.
Amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast instead of a septum, and are not GMS positive.
Candida shows budding yeasts and pseudohyphae without transverse septation.
Storage histiocytes contain fibrillar or crystalline material without discrete organisms with a septum.

exam.answer_en: Talaromyces (Penicillium) marneffei in bone marrow — small oval/sausage-shaped yeasts with central transverse septum in and around macrophages
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞旁的臘腸狀菌體，問「中間那條線代表什麼」；答 transverse septum，菌以 fission（分裂）繁殖而非出芽，為 Talaromyces marneffei 特徵。
流行病學：東南亞、華南、台灣等地流行；典型宿主為 CD4 <100/µL 的晚期 HIV，另見於抗 interferon-γ 自體抗體的成人免疫缺陷及其他免疫抑制。
確認：黴菌培養 25°C 為產生紅色可溶性色素的菌絲相、37°C 為酵母相（dimorphic）；GMS/PAS 陽性。血液培養、皮膚病灶與骨髓皆可檢出。
臨床與治療：發燒、體重減輕、肝脾腫大、似 molluscum 的中央臍凹皮疹；治療以 amphotericin B 誘導，接續 itraconazole 並作次級預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Histoplasma capsulatum 混淆：Histoplasma 為大小一致的圓形至橢圓酵母，有 pseudocapsule halo 與窄基出芽，無橫隔；本圖菌體長短不一、臘腸狀且中央有橫隔。Leishmania 則有 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 圖中骨髓巨噬細胞旁帶中央橫隔的臘腸狀酵母樣菌體是什麼菌？與 Histoplasma 最關鍵的形態差異為何？
quiz.a: Talaromyces（Penicillium）marneffei；以 fission 分裂並有 transverse septum，Histoplasma 為出芽且無橫隔。

29402.recognize_zh: 影像上雙側股骨遠端與脛骨近端呈對稱性骨硬化並有 PET 與骨掃描高攝取，切片則是成片泡沫狀組織球（foamy histiocytes）且免疫染色瀰漫陽性，組合起來指向 Erdheim-Chester disease。
features: Bilateral, symmetric increased tracer uptake in the distal femora and proximal tibiae on FDG-PET and bone scintigraphy (panels A, B)
Patchy intramedullary sclerosis of the distal femoral metadiaphysis on CT and abnormal marrow signal in the tibial diaphysis on MRI (panels C, D)
Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant foamy/xanthomatous vacuolated cytoplasm and small bland round nuclei (panel E)
Interspersed fibrous stroma and scattered small lymphocytes; no significant atypia or mitoses
Diffuse strong cytoplasmic immunoreactivity of the histiocytes for a histiocytic marker (panel F; marker not labeled)
29402.describe_en: Composite figure: whole-body FDG-PET and technetium bone scan show bilateral, symmetric increased uptake in the metadiaphyseal regions of the distal femora and proximal tibiae, with corresponding patchy medullary sclerosis on CT and abnormal marrow signal on MRI. Biopsy sections show a diffuse infiltrate of large histiocytes with abundant foamy, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and small, bland nuclei in a fibrotic background with scattered lymphocytes. The histiocytes are diffusely positive by immunohistochemistry (marker not specified in the image). Findings are consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease; correlation with CD1a/langerin negativity and BRAF V600E (or other MAPK pathway) testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: LCH shows grooved, reniform Langerhans cells with eosinophils and CD1a/langerin positivity, and typically lytic rather than symmetric sclerotic long-bone lesions.
RDD histiocytes are S100-positive with pale abundant cytoplasm showing emperipolesis, rather than lipid-laden foamy cells in a fibrotic stroma.
Reactive lesions are usually unifocal with infection or cholesterol-rich injury context and lack the bilateral symmetric diaphyseal osteosclerosis and MAPK mutations.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear vacuolated foamy cytoplasm, with low glucocerebrosidase activity.

exam.answer_en: Erdheim–Chester disease — bilateral symmetric long-bone osteosclerosis with sheets of foamy histiocytes (CD68+/CD163+, CD1a−)
pearls_zh: 考法：影像加切片合成圖，考官問「雙側股骨遠端與脛骨近端對稱骨硬化＋泡沫狀組織球」代表什麼；答 Erdheim-Chester disease，並說出必做 IHC 與分子檢查。
IHC：組織球 CD68+、CD163+、Factor XIIIa+，CD1a 與 langerin（CD207）陰性，S100 陰性或弱陽；常見 Touton giant cells 與纖維化。
分子：BRAF V600E 突變見於過半病人，其他 MAPK 路徑（MAP2K1、KRAS、NRAS 等）變異亦常見；治療可用 BRAF 抑制劑（vemurafenib、dabrafenib）或 MEK 抑制劑（cobimetinib）。
系統侵犯：腎周浸潤「hairy kidney」、主動脈周圍包覆「coated aorta」、右心房假腫瘤、眼窩、尿崩症；約一成多病人合併 LCH（mixed histiocytosis）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Langerhans cell histiocytosis 混淆：LCH 細胞有核溝（coffee-bean）、CD1a 與 langerin 陽性、S100 陽性，骨病灶多為溶骨性；ECD 為泡沫狀組織球、CD1a/langerin 陰性，長骨骨幹端對稱骨硬化。

quiz.q: 此泡沫狀組織球病變要與 LCH 區分，應做哪兩個 IHC？最常見的致病突變為何？
quiz.a: CD1a 與 langerin（CD207），ECD 皆陰性；BRAF V600E。

27930.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中散布大量中大型、細胞質少、染色質細緻的芽細胞（blasts）小叢集，成熟中的顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞相對稀少；這種外觀只提示急性骨髓性白血病，CEBPA 突變須靠分子檢驗確認。
features: Numerous medium-to-large blasts scattered singly and in small clusters
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm; granules and Auer rods not resolvable at this low magnification
Relative paucity of maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
Blood-rich smear with fat-droplet spaces in the background
27930.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with fat spaces and a markedly increased population of medium-to-large blasts occurring singly and in loose clusters. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm; cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the CEBPA mutation status is a molecular finding and cannot be inferred from morphology.

ddx.vs: Often shows cup-like nuclear invaginations and monocytic differentiation, but separation from CEBPA-mutated AML requires molecular testing.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and express lymphoid markers (CD19/CD79a or cCD3) on flow cytometry, whereas CEBPA-mutated AML blasts are typically MPO-positive with CD34/CD13/CD33 and aberrant CD7.
Requires multilineage dysplasia or MDS-defining cytogenetics/mutations, which are not evaluable in this low-power field.

17754.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一大團由許多顆粒狀血小板緊密聚集而成的團塊，旁邊中性球附近亦有少數血小板聚集，背景單顆血小板稀少，符合周邊血液抹片中的血小板凝集（platelet clump）。
features: Large aggregate of numerous individual platelets with purple granules at upper left
Platelets in the clump retain discrete outlines; no fibrin strands or nucleated cells within
Small cluster of platelets adjacent to a segmented neutrophil at lower center
Few isolated platelets in the background
Neutrophils with normal segmentation and granulation; RBCs without significant poikilocytosis
17754.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at higher power shows a large aggregate composed of many individual granular platelets, with a smaller platelet cluster near a segmented neutrophil and few isolated platelets elsewhere. Neutrophils appear morphologically normal and red cells show no significant abnormality. Platelet clumps are excluded from automated platelet counts. Findings are consistent with platelet clumping, typically EDTA-induced pseudothrombocytopenia; the platelet count should be verified on a citrate-anticoagulated sample.

ddx.vs: Genuine thrombocytopenia shows uniformly few platelets with no aggregates on the smear.
Satellitism shows platelets encircling neutrophils in a rosette rather than forming large free aggregates.
Megakaryocyte fragments contain a nucleus or a cohesive cytoplasmic mass, whereas this clump is made of separable individual platelets.

exam.answer_en: Platelet clump (EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia) — large aggregate of discrete granular platelets without fibrin or nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍下考官指著這團問「是 megakaryocyte 碎片還是血小板團？」看得到一顆顆分離的血小板輪廓、無細胞核→platelet clump。
EDTA 依賴抗體多在室溫下反應，抽血到上機時間越長越明顯；以 citrate 或其他抗凝劑重抽並立即計數可確認。
部分病人換 citrate 管仍會凝集；此時可用指尖血直接做抹片估計血小板數，並在報告註明檢體有凝集。
此現象不代表凝血或血小板功能異常，不需處置；重要的是避免被當成 ITP 或骨髓衰竭而進行不必要的檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易將大血小板團誤認為 megakaryocyte 碎片或 micromegakaryocyte；後者有細胞核或為連續的胞質團，血小板團則由可分辨的單顆血小板組成。

quiz.q: 圖左上由許多顆粒小體聚成的團塊是什麼？最簡單的確認方法為何？
quiz.a: 血小板凝集（platelet clump）；改用 citrate 管重抽並立即計數，並核對抹片

14298.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個大型巨噬細胞的細胞質內有多個 2–4 µm 小型卵圓形酵母菌，菌體中央有深染的核質、周圍有透明暈圈，同時可見被吞噬的紅血球，符合組織漿菌症造成的全血球減少。
features: Large macrophage with abundant vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus with coarse chromatin
Multiple small (approximately 2–4 µm), uniform, oval intracellular yeasts each surrounded by a clear halo
Yeasts with a central or polar basophilic dot/crescent of cytoplasm; no kinetoplast
Phagocytosed red cell/erythroid remnant within the macrophage cytoplasm (hemophagocytosis)
Additional small dark intracytoplasmic fragments; surrounding red cells and a nucleated cell at the lower edge
14298.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small, uniform, oval yeast forms, each with a basophilic center and a surrounding clear halo, together with a phagocytosed red cell. No kinetoplasts are seen, distinguishing the organisms from Leishmania amastigotes. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection of the marrow with associated hemophagocytosis, explaining the pancytopenia; confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture or Histoplasma antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a nucleus and a separate bar-shaped kinetoplast without a surrounding halo or PAS/GMS-positive cell wall.
Talaromyces yeasts show central septation from binary fission and elongated forms rather than budding oval yeasts with halos.
Candida glabrata is slightly larger, less consistently intracellular and grows rapidly in routine culture without the endemic exposure history.
Toxoplasma bradyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and PAS-negative walls, lacking clear halos.

exam.answer_en: Marrow histoplasmosis causing pancytopenia — macrophage containing multiple 2–4 µm haloed oval yeasts plus phagocytosed red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內帶暈圈的小體問「是什麼微生物？為何病人全血球減少？」答 Histoplasma capsulatum 骨髓侵犯，合併噬血現象。
Histoplasma 感染可誘發繼發性 HLH；遇到發燒、全血球減少、ferritin 很高的免疫低下病人，應同時評估 HLH 條件。
切片上以 GMS 或 PAS 染色顯示真菌細胞壁；骨髓培養與尿液/血清抗原檢測可提高診斷率，骨髓 H&E 可能只見肉芽腫或組織球聚集。
台灣與東南亞需鑑別 Talaromyces marneffei：同樣為巨噬細胞內小酵母，但以二分裂增殖、中央有橫隔，且可見長形「香腸狀」菌體。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 visceral leishmaniasis 混淆：Leishmania 在胞內有核與棒狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈與真菌細胞壁；也要避免將小顆粒碎片或血小板誤認為菌體。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內有透明暈圈的小卵圓形體最可能是什麼？哪種特殊染色可顯示其細胞壁？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母菌；GMS（或 PAS）染色

12890.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球小而蒼白、中央淡染區擴大，並有鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cells），血小板明顯增多；右上內視鏡圖可見食道蹼（esophageal web），合起來是缺鐵加 Plummer-Vinson 症候群。抹片本身無法看出 JAK2 骨髓增生性腫瘤，需分子檢測。
features: Hypochromic, microcytic red cells with enlarged central pallor
Anisopoikilocytosis with elongated pencil (cigar) cells and occasional target cells
Increased platelets scattered throughout the field
No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or teardrop cells in the field
Inset endoscopic image showing a thin mucosal web in the upper esophagus
12890.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic, microcytic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including pencil cells and occasional target cells, and a conspicuously increased number of platelets. No nucleated red cells, teardrop cells, or immature myeloid cells are seen in this field. The endoscopic inset shows a thin esophageal web. Findings are consistent with iron deficiency anemia with thrombocytosis and Plummer-Vinson syndrome; because thrombocytosis may persist after iron repletion, testing for JAK2 V617F, CALR, and MPL mutations is warranted, as the morphology cannot distinguish reactive thrombocytosis from an underlying myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows microcytosis with more target cells and basophilic stippling, a normal or high RBC count and normal iron studies.
ET shows thrombocytosis with normochromic red cells, and the diagnosis rests on driver mutations and marrow megakaryocyte morphology.

ddx.dx: Polycythemia vera with iron deficiency (masked PV)
