ddx.vs: Iron-deficient PV may show microcytosis with a normal hemoglobin and an elevated red cell count, and is confirmed by JAK2 mutation and low EPO.
Anemia of chronic disease is usually normocytic or mildly microcytic with fewer pencil cells, high ferritin and low TIBC.

11866.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中型淋巴球，核深裂成兩到多葉（bilobed / lobulated），染色質濃縮、胞質少，核葉之間有明顯切痕，屬於成人 T 細胞白血病淋巴瘤（ATLL）中典型的分葉核淋巴球。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply cleaved, bilobed to multilobated nuclei
Nuclear lobes separated by sharp clefts, giving a clover-like outline
Condensed, mildly coarse chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Background normocytic red cells and normal-appearing platelets
11866.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical medium-sized lymphocytes with scant agranular cytoplasm and deeply indented, bilobed to multilobated nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma cells; HTLV-1 serology and flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7 loss) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have finely convoluted cerebriform nuclei rather than deep clefts into discrete lobes, and are HTLV-1 negative.
Leukemic MCL cells can have cleaved nuclei but are B cells (CD19/CD20/CD5+, cyclin D1+), whereas ATLL cells are CD4+CD25+ T cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes with nuclear cleft artifact
ddx.vs: Occasional cleaved normal lymphocytes are few and lack an expanded monotonous population, and flow shows no aberrant T-cell phenotype.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — circulating medium-sized lymphocytes with deeply indented bilobed to multilobated nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：不一定每顆都是完美的 flower cell，考官可能指雙葉或深裂核淋巴球，要求聯想到 ATLL 並說出下一步：HTLV-1 抗體與 T 細胞 flow。
Shimoyama 分型依據：淋巴球增多程度、異常細胞比例、LDH、血鈣、有無淋巴結/器官侵犯，分為 acute、lymphoma、chronic、smoldering 四型。
治療與預後：acute/lymphoma type 為侵襲性，需化療並評估 allogeneic HSCT；部分 indolent type 可觀察或使用 interferon-α 合併 zidovudine。
流行病學：HTLV-1 主要經母乳垂直傳染，終生發生 ATLL 的風險僅少數帶原者；避免哺餵母乳可降低母嬰傳染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 leukemic mantle cell lymphoma 或 CLL 的裂核細胞混淆：MCL 為 B 細胞（CD5+、cyclin D1+、SOX11+），ATLL 為 CD4+、CD25+ 的 T 細胞；Sézary 細胞則為腦迴狀而非深裂分葉。

quiz.q: 圖中分葉核淋巴球提示 ATLL，其典型 flow 表型中哪一個活化標記會強陽性？常丟失哪一個 T 細胞抗原？
quiz.a: CD25 強陽性；CD7 丟失

7578.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型細胞有三個圓形核，細胞質豐富、深藍嗜鹼性並帶小空泡，周圍還有數顆核偏位、藍色細胞質的單核漿細胞，可認出為多核（三核）漿細胞。
features: Large plasma cell containing three round, separate nuclei
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Nuclei with coarse to clock-face chromatin; one nucleus shows a faint nucleolus
Adjacent mononuclear plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and pale perinuclear hof
Smear background with red cells and a small lymphocyte
7578.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large trinucleated plasma cell with abundant deep blue cytoplasm containing small vacuoles and three round nuclei with coarse chromatin. Several nearby mononuclear plasma cells show eccentric nuclei and perinuclear clearing. Multinucleation is a cytologic atypia seen more often in neoplastic than reactive plasma cells, but it is not diagnostic in isolation. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; quantification of plasma cells and demonstration of clonality (light chain restriction by IHC/ISH or flow cytometry) are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, mononuclear and polytypic for kappa and lambda, whereas multinucleation and nucleoli favor neoplasia.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often more than five) uniform nuclei and granular, less basophilic cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof.
Erythroid precursors have round central nuclei, very dark blue cytoplasm and lack the eccentric nuclei and hof of plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli and is often EBER positive in immunodeficient patients.

1370.recognize_zh: 血片整片幾乎看不到正常大小的血小板，只見三顆接近小淋巴球或紅血球大小的巨大血小板（giant platelets），紅血球與白血球形態正常，符合周邊破壞增加所致的血小板低下（ITP）。
features: Marked paucity of normal-sized platelets across the field
Three large to giant platelets, approaching or exceeding red cell size, with dense purple granular centers
Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes
No platelet clumping at this magnification
No leukocyte abnormality evident in this field
1370.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly decreased platelets, with the few platelets present being large to giant forms approaching the size of a red cell. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, spherocytes, or polychromasia. No platelet clumps are seen. In the setting of isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with increased peripheral platelet destruction such as immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), after exclusion of inherited macrothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MYH9-related disease shows Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils, and both disorders have lifelong macrothrombocytopenia with family history, whereas ITP lacks leukocyte inclusions and often responds to immune therapy.
TMA shows schistocytes and polychromasia, which are absent here.
Pseudothrombocytopenia shows platelet clumps or platelet satellitism at the feathered edge, not isolated large platelets.
Underproduction typically shows small platelets and may have cytopenias or blasts, so marrow examination is needed when other lineages are abnormal.

exam.answer_en: Immune thrombocytopenia — markedly reduced platelets with scattered giant platelets; no schistocytes or clumps
pearls_zh: 考法：考官請你「估計血小板數並描述大小」，再問鑑別；需點出正常大小血小板缺乏、僅見接近紅血球大小的 giant platelets。
必要排除：看 feathered edge 有無血小板聚集或 satellitism（假性低下）、有無 schistocytes（TTP/HUS）、有無嗜中性球 Döhle-like 包涵體（MYH9）。
兒童 ITP 多於病毒感染後急性發生、多數自行緩解；成人較易慢性化，需篩檢 HIV、HCV、H. pylori 及其他自體免疫疾病（如 SLE、CLL 相關）。
治療：一線 corticosteroids，需快速提升（出血或手術前）加 IVIG；二線 TPO receptor agonists（eltrombopag、romiplostim）、rituximab 或 splenectomy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大血小板在儀器上可能被計為紅血球或淋巴球而低估數量；別把 giant platelet 當成淋巴球，其無核、呈紫色顆粒狀。

quiz.q: 圖中僅見少數巨大血小板、紅血球正常。請描述血小板變化並說明最可能的診斷。
quiz.a: 嚴重血小板低下伴 giant platelets；immune thrombocytopenia（ITP，排除性診斷）

2714.recognize_zh: 抹片上一顆大型細胞的豐富細胞質呈細顆粒狀的紅紫色陽性反應，周圍紅血球為未染色的黃色，符合高雪氏細胞的細胞化學染色（可能為抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶 TRAP）陽性；核本身不易辨識。
features: Large cell with abundant cytoplasm showing diffuse, finely granular red-purple positive staining
Staining is densest centrally and fades toward the cell periphery
Nucleus is obscured and not clearly discernible
Surrounding red cells appear yellow and unstained, with no counterstained background cells
Image resolution and staining limit identification of the specific cytochemical reaction
2714.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with a cytochemical reaction shows a large cell with abundant cytoplasm displaying diffuse, finely granular red-purple positivity, most intense centrally. The nucleus is obscured by the reaction product. Adjacent red cells are yellow and unstained. The appearance is most suggestive of an acid phosphatase (tartrate-resistant) reaction, although the stain is not labeled and a PAS reaction cannot be excluded. Findings are consistent with a cytochemically positive Gaucher cell.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are also strongly TRAP positive but show multiple discrete nuclei, whereas Gaucher cells have one or few small eccentric nuclei.
Hairy cells are TRAP positive but are much smaller lymphoid cells with circumferential hairy projections.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML or myeloma can share cytochemical reactivity, so enzyme assay or GBA testing and marrow context are required.

2458.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中箭頭指出數顆組織球（histiocytes），細胞較大、細胞質豐富且呈淡藍灰色，內含細顆粒狀碎屑與小空泡，核呈腎形或卵圓偏心，與周圍的顆粒球前驅細胞及脂肪空泡並存。
features: Several histiocytes (arrows) larger than surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Cytoplasm containing fine granular debris and small vacuoles
Oval to reniform eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors, erythroid cells and large fat vacuoles
2458.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors with large fat vacuoles. Several histiocytes (arrows) are identified, characterized by abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with indistinct borders, fine granular debris and small vacuoles, and oval to reniform eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin. No hemophagocytosis of intact red cells or leukocytes, organisms, or storage-type cytoplasm is evident. Findings are consistent with normal marrow histiocytes (macrophages).

ddx.vs: Monocytes are smaller with folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, lacking the phagocytosed debris of tissue histiocytes.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain engulfed intact red cells, platelets or nucleated cells, which are not seen here.
Storage histiocytes have fibrillary tissue-paper cytoplasm or distinct deep blue granules rather than scant granular debris.
Mast cells are packed with dense purple metachromatic granules obscuring a round central nucleus.

2586.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型巨噬細胞，核卵圓、細胞質淡染泡沫狀，周圍環繞許多深染圓核的晚期有核紅血球，形成紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central macrophage with an oval nucleus, fine chromatin and abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblasts with dense round nuclei surrounding and overlying the macrophage
A few earlier erythroid and myeloid precursors at the periphery, including a band/segmented neutrophil
Normal-appearing erythroid maturation without megaloblastic change
Surrounding red cells with drying artifact
2586.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island consisting of a central macrophage with an oval nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. The macrophage is surrounded by numerous late polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts with dense round nuclei, and a few earlier precursors and granulocytes are seen at the periphery. Erythroid maturation appears orderly without megaloblastic or dysplastic changes. This is a normal structural unit of erythropoiesis, in which the central macrophage supplies iron and phagocytoses extruded nuclei.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the macrophage has engulfed intact cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles, whereas here normoblasts are attached around the macrophage surface in an orderly arrangement.
Lymphoid aggregates consist of small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin, lacking a central macrophage and the dense pyknotic normoblast nuclei.
Tumor clusters are cohesive with large pleomorphic nuclei and lack a central macrophage and maturing normoblasts.

exam.answer_en: Erythroblastic island — central macrophage surrounded by maturing polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts (normal erythropoiesis)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著中央那顆大而淡染的細胞問身分與功能；答 central macrophage（nurse cell），提供鐵給周邊紅血球前驅細胞並吞噬 orthochromatic normoblast 排出的核（pyrenocyte）。
Central macrophage 可用 CD163、CD169 等巨噬細胞標記辨識；Prussian blue 鐵染色時儲存鐵主要位於此類巨噬細胞，是評估骨髓鐵儲存的位置。
這是正常造血的結構單位；紅血球系增生（溶血、失血後）時 island 變多，看到它代表紅血球系有正常且有秩序的成熟。
觀察周邊 normoblast 是否有 megaloblastic change、多核或核出芽等 dyserythropoiesis，是本圖延伸題常考方向。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 hemophagocytosis：吞噬現象是完整細胞被包在巨噬細胞空泡「內」；erythroblastic island 則是有核紅血球有秩序地貼附在巨噬細胞表面周圍。

quiz.q: 圖中央被有核紅血球環繞的大細胞是什麼？寫出一項功能。
quiz.a: Central macrophage（nurse cell）；供應鐵給紅血球前驅細胞，或吞噬排出的紅血球核

1178.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量小淋巴球，夾雜細胞質較多、核偏心的漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocytes）與漿細胞，從淋巴球到漿細胞呈連續光譜，並散在少數含顆粒的肥大細胞，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered mature plasma cells with perinuclear hof
Occasional granulated cells consistent with mast cells
Reduced residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors; scattered neutrophils
1178.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a marked increase in small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Admixed are plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and more abundant basophilic cytoplasm and scattered mature plasma cells, forming a spectrum of lymphoplasmacytic differentiation. Occasional granulated cells compatible with mast cells are noted, and normal hematopoietic precursors are reduced. In the setting of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation, findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia).

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MZL usually lacks MYD88 L265P and has monocytoid/villous cells, so molecular and clinical correlation are needed.
CLL cells are uniform small lymphocytes with smudge cells and lack a plasmacytoid component, and are CD5+/CD23+.
IgM myeloma shows sheets of clonal plasma cells without a clonal small B-lymphocyte population, and often has t(11;14).
Reactive infiltrates are polytypic with a mixed population and no monoclonal IgM or MYD88 mutation.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia) — small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells in a continuous spectrum, with admixed mast cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會要你找出「小淋巴球→plasmacytoid lymphocyte→漿細胞」的連續光譜，並指出旁邊的 mast cell；LPL 骨髓中 mast cell 增加是經典伴隨線索。
分子：MYD88 L265P 見於 >90% 的 WM，CXCR4 突變約 30–40%，後者與 BTK inhibitor 反應較差相關；MYD88 也可見於部分 MZL，不能單獨確診。
表型：B 細胞 CD19+、CD20+，通常 CD5−、CD10−；漿細胞成分與 B 細胞同一 light chain 限制，漿細胞多為 CD138+、CD19+、CD45+（不同於 myeloma 的 CD19−）。
臨床：WM 定義為 LPL 合併骨髓侵犯與任何量的 IgM 單株蛋白；注意 hyperviscosity（頭痛、視力模糊、出血），急症處置為 plasmapheresis。
IgM 相關併發症常考：cryoglobulinemia、cold agglutinin、anti-MAG 周邊神經病變，以及類澱粉沉積。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認成 MZL 伴漿細胞分化或 CLL；LPL 為 CD5−、CD23 多陰性、MYD88 L265P 陽性且常有 IgM 副蛋白，MZL 則需結合脾/淋巴結結外表現判斷，形態常無法區分。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球、漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞呈連續光譜，這類病人最常檢出的點突變是什麼？
quiz.a: MYD88 L265P

1306.recognize_zh: 骨髓淋巴聚集的免疫染色中，陽性棕色細胞密集於聚集周邊，中央一個淡色圓形區域只含零星陽性細胞，這種「周邊多、中心少」的分布符合 T 細胞標記勾勒出反應性濾泡與其生發中心內的少量 T 細胞。
features: Lymphoid aggregate with strongly membranous-staining cells concentrated at the periphery
Central pale, rounded zone largely negative with only scattered positive cells, consistent with a germinal center
Positive cells are small lymphocytes with crisp membranous staining
Scattered positive cells in the interstitial marrow
Surrounding hematopoietic cells and adipocytes are negative
1306.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a lymphoid aggregate in which positive small lymphocytes are concentrated at the periphery, while a central rounded zone is largely negative with only scattered positive cells. This distribution matches a T-cell marker (such as CD3) outlining a B-cell follicle with a germinal center containing scattered follicular T cells; the specific antibody is not stated. Scattered positive interstitial T cells are also present. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with a germinal center in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: FL follicles also contain scattered T cells, so separation relies on paratrabecular location and BCL2 co-expression by CD10-positive follicle center cells.
NLPHL nodules show T-cell rosettes around large LP cells, not a uniform negative germinal center.
PTCL shows diffuse sheets of atypical T cells with antigen loss rather than a T-cell rim around a preserved follicle.

1114.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片上的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由脂肪空泡與網狀基質組成，造血細胞極少，只剩散在的基質細胞核，呈現放射治療後的骨髓再生不良。
features: Marrow particle composed of a delicate stromal meshwork with numerous fat vacuoles
Marked paucity of hematopoietic cells within the particle
Scattered small spindle to oval stromal/endothelial nuclei
Occasional dark pigment granules in the stroma
Background of fat droplets with few red cells and nucleated cells
1114.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed almost entirely of fat vacuoles and a delicate stromal network with scattered stromal nuclei. Hematopoietic precursors are markedly reduced to nearly absent within the particle, and the background contains few nucleated cells. No infiltrating tumor cells are identified. Findings indicate a markedly hypocellular, fatty marrow particle consistent with post-radiation marrow aplasia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Idiopathic aplastic anemia produces identical empty fatty particles, so distinction relies on history of radiation, and PNH clone or telomere studies.
Serous atrophy shows pink-purple amorphous extracellular ground substance and small fat cells, often with cachexia, rather than a clean fat-stromal meshwork.
Hypocellular MDS retains residual dysplastic hematopoietic islands and may show clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

1050.recognize_zh: 單顆大型淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍、形狀不規則，邊緣接觸紅血球處顏色加深（peripheral basophilia），核呈橢圓、染色質中度濃縮，是反應性淋巴球（Downey type II）的典型外觀。
features: Large lymphocyte, about 2.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Low N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and irregular outline
Deeper cytoplasmic basophilia at the margin abutting a red cell
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed, slightly open chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Normochromic red cells and scattered platelets in the background
1050.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large reactive lymphocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm, an irregular cell border and peripheral basophilia where it contacts adjacent red cells. The nucleus is oval with moderately condensed chromatin and lacks prominent nucleoli; no cytoplasmic granules are seen. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a reactive (Downey type II) lymphocyte, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than abundant scalloped cytoplasm.
Monocytes show folded or reniform nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey vacuolated cytoplasm.
Plasmacytoid cells show eccentric nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof rather than pale cytoplasm with edge basophilia.

exam.answer_en: Reactive lymphocyte (Downey type II) of infectious mononucleosis — abundant pale cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia where it abuts red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：問 Downey 分型。Type I 胞質較少、核可凹陷；type II 胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣接觸紅血球處變深藍（ballerina skirt）；type III 為 immunoblastic、可見核仁。
Peripheral basophilia 是 reactive lymphocyte 的關鍵形態：胞質邊緣因細胞質 RNA 較多而染深藍，blast 或 monocyte 不會出現此包覆紅血球的外觀。
病因不只 EBV：CMV、急性 HIV、病毒性肝炎、藥物過敏（如 DRESS）與 toxoplasmosis 都可有 reactive lymphocytosis。
檢驗：EBV VCA IgM、heterophile 抗體；持續異常或伴 cytopenias、高 ferritin 要警覺 EBV-HLH 或 EBV+ T/NK 增生性疾病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 monocyte：monocyte 核摺疊或腎形、染色質蕾絲狀、胞質灰藍帶空泡；Downey II 核為橢圓、染色質較凝集、胞質淡藍且邊緣嗜鹼性。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞屬於 Downey 分類的哪一型？請指出支持的形態特徵。
quiz.a: Type II；胞質豐富淡藍、接觸紅血球處邊緣嗜鹼性變深

4186.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加、脂肪減少，粒系與嗜酸性細胞為主；此 H&E 視野並未清楚看到典型緊密的紡錘形肥大細胞聚集，需以 tryptase、CD117、CD25 免疫染色才能確認全身性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with reduced fat spaces between bony trabeculae
Predominance of granulocytic precursors with numerous eosinophilic granulocytes
Scattered megakaryocytes; erythroid islands present
Occasional cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm, but no definite compact spindle-cell mast cell aggregates in this field
Bone trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis
4186.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with decreased fat, composed predominantly of granulocytic precursors with numerous eosinophils, scattered megakaryocytes and erythroid elements. Occasional cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm are present, but discrete compact aggregates of spindled mast cells are not definitely identified in this field. The findings are compatible with a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and, in context, may represent systemic mastocytosis; immunohistochemistry for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 and KIT D816V testing are needed to document the mast cell infiltrate.

ddx.vs: MPNs show similar hypercellularity with eosinophils, but lack tryptase+/CD25+ mast cell aggregates and are defined by BCR::ABL1, JAK2, CALR or MPL.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms can show loose atypical mast cells but lack KIT D816V and are identified by FIP1L1::PDGFRA testing.
Reactive marrow shows eosinophilia without atypical spindle-shaped mast cell clusters or molecular clonality.

3994.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片保存不佳、細胞間水腫，組織球細胞質內可見成群直徑約 2–3 µm 的小圓點狀體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）；此解析度看不清核與動基體，需 Giemsa 抹片或 PCR 佐證內臟利什曼原蟲症。
features: Edematous, poorly preserved marrow with vacuolated, loosely arranged cells
Histiocytes with abundant pale, granular-foamy cytoplasm
Clusters of tiny round dot-like bodies (~2–3 µm) within and around histiocytes, most evident near the lower center
Scattered plasma cells and lymphocytes with dense nuclei; occasional erythroid/myeloid precursors
Nucleus and kinetoplast of individual organisms not resolvable at this resolution
3994.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows edematous, poorly preserved marrow containing histiocytes with abundant foamy cytoplasm, admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and scattered hematopoietic precursors. Clusters of minute round intracellular bodies approximately 2–3 µm in size are present within histiocytes, consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes). The nucleus and kinetoplast cannot be resolved on this H&E image. In a patient with HIV infection, findings are suggestive of visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by Giemsa-stained aspirate, CD1a-negative intracellular organisms, culture or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo and no kinetoplast, and stain with GMS/PAS, whereas Leishmania amastigotes are GMS-negative with a bar-shaped kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites lack a kinetoplast and are rarely seen in marrow histiocytes; immunostain or PCR separates them.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central septum and are GMS-positive.
Debris is irregular in size and shape, while amastigotes are uniform ovoid bodies of consistent size.

4058.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一個緊密聚集的細胞團呈強烈棕色膜/胞質染色，周圍另有散在的梭形陽性細胞，其他造血細胞陰性；這種多灶緻密聚集型態符合系統性肥大細胞增生症的主要診斷標準（標記未標示，推測為 tryptase 或 CD117）。
features: Dense compact aggregate of strongly immunoreactive cells (well over 15 cells)
Strong cytoplasmic/membranous brown staining with round to spindled cell shapes
Scattered individual spindle-shaped positive cells in adjacent interstitium
Surrounding hematopoietic cells and fat largely negative
Aggregate located between fat spaces at low power
4058.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy (DAB; marker not specified, likely a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117) highlights a large, dense, compact aggregate of positive cells, with additional scattered spindle-shaped positive cells in the interstitium. The remaining hematopoietic elements are negative. A compact aggregate of more than 15 mast cells fulfills the major WHO criterion; findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis, with CD25/CD2 aberrancy and KIT D816V testing recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered singly and round, without compact aggregates of >15 cells, and are CD25-negative.
These show increased blasts with tryptase expression but no compact spindled aggregates meeting SM criteria and lack KIT D816V typically.
Lymphoid aggregates are tryptase/CD117-negative and CD3/CD20-positive.

4058.stain: IHC: marker not specified (likely tryptase/CD117), DAB

3930.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則，骨小樑之間的造血空間被稠密交織的黑色網狀纖維取代，細胞稀少且竇狀血管擴張，符合骨髓纖維化合併骨硬化（osteomyelosclerosis）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae occupying much of the field (osteosclerosis)
Dense, diffuse meshwork of reticulin fibers with extensive intersections in the intertrabecular space
Coarse fibers streaming between trabeculae
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity
Dilated sinusoidal spaces
3930.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae with narrowed intertrabecular spaces. The remaining marrow space contains a dense, diffuse network of reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, streaming bundles, associated with dilated sinusoids and markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity. Findings correspond to high-grade reticulin fibrosis (at least MF-2 to MF-3, pending trichrome assessment) with osteosclerosis, consistent with advanced primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor produces fibrosis around cohesive epithelial nests that are keratin positive, whereas this fibrosis is diffuse with atypical megakaryocytes in PMF.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows paratrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption, rather than diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis with MPN megakaryocytes.
HCL causes diffuse reticulin fibrosis with a fried-egg infiltrate of CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive cells, without new bone formation.
Mastocytosis shows fibrosis and osteosclerosis around spindle mast cell aggregates that are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.

exam.answer_en: Advanced myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis — reticulin stain showing dense diffuse fibers (high grade) and thickened irregular trabeculae
pearls_zh: 考法：reticulin 染色要會分級。MF-0 散在線狀纖維；MF-1 鬆散網狀、交叉多；MF-2 瀰漫稠密、交叉廣泛，常伴局部 collagen 或骨硬化；MF-3 再加粗大 collagen 束與明顯骨硬化。
分級只在造血區評估，血管周圍與骨小樑旁原有的 reticulin 不計入；collagen 需另以 trichrome 評估，骨硬化亦另外分級。
Overt PMF 需 reticulin/collagen fibrosis grade ≥2；prefibrotic PMF 為 grade ≤1，需與 ET 區分，兩者預後不同。
繼發性纖維化原因：post-PV／post-ET myelofibrosis、MDS with fibrosis、acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis、轉移癌、systemic mastocytosis、腎性骨病。
高度纖維化骨髓抽吸常 dry tap，需以 core biopsy 與 touch imprint 補足評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把切片過厚或血管周圍正常 reticulin 當高度纖維化；應在適當厚度、造血區內評估纖維密度與交叉程度。

quiz.q: Reticulin 染色見瀰漫稠密、廣泛交叉的纖維並伴粗大 collagen 束與明顯骨硬化，屬 WHO 纖維化分級哪一級？
quiz.a: MF-3

3866.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆分葉嗜中性球的細胞質內（箭頭）有數顆 2–4 µm 小型卵圓形微生物，周圍有透明暈、內含新月形深染物質，是瀰漫性組織漿菌病在血球內的酵母菌；本圖為血液抹片而非骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing several small intracytoplasmic oval organisms (arrow)
Organisms approximately 2–4 µm with a clear halo and crescent-shaped basophilic chromatin cap
No kinetoplast visible within the organisms
Adjacent neutrophil with toxic-appearing granulation and irregular nuclear lobation
Background red cells with echinocytes/crenation
3866.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing several small, oval, intracytoplasmic yeast-like organisms (arrow) measuring approximately 2–4 µm, each with a clear surrounding halo and an eccentric crescent of basophilic material; no kinetoplast is seen. An adjacent neutrophil shows toxic-appearing granulation, and red cells are crenated. Although titled as a marrow granuloma case, this image is a blood smear. Findings are consistent with circulating intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum in disseminated histoplasmosis, to be confirmed by culture and antigen testing.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast, reside mainly in macrophages, and are not GMS positive, whereas Histoplasma yeasts lack a kinetoplast and stain with GMS.
Candida yeasts are usually larger, more variably sized and may show pseudohyphae, without the characteristic halo and crescent pattern.
Toxic granules are small dark granules and Döhle bodies are pale blue patches, not discrete oval organisms with clear halos.
Platelets and precipitate lack the uniform oval shape, halo and internal crescent of yeast forms.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — Histoplasma capsulatum yeasts with clear halos inside a circulating neutrophil (peripheral blood)
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指嗜中性球內帶透明暈的小圓體，問是什麼病原；答 Histoplasma，並用「無 kinetoplast、有 halo 與新月形深染核」排除 Leishmania。
周邊血抹片直接看到細胞內酵母菌代表菌量極高的瀰漫性感染，多見於晚期 HIV（CD4 低）或重度免疫抑制，屬急症。
台灣／東南亞需鑑別 Talaromyces marneffei：同樣小型細胞內，但以橫隔分裂、不出芽；兩者皆可於周邊血單核球或嗜中性球內看到。
確認：尿液／血清 Histoplasma antigen、血液培養；GMS 或 PAS 可染出酵母菌壁（Leishmania 不染）。
治療：重症以 liposomal amphotericin B 起始，之後 itraconazole；注意合併繼發 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把細胞質空泡、吞入血小板或 Anaplasma morula 誤認；Histoplasma 是透明暈中含新月形深染核的獨立圓體，morula 則是無暈的點狀團塊。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指嗜中性球內帶透明暈的小圓體，與 Leishmania amastigote 最主要的形態區別為何？
quiz.a: Histoplasma 沒有 kinetoplast（且 GMS 陽性）；Leishmania 有核＋棒狀 kinetoplast

3738.recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片中，紅髓被瀰漫的小淋巴樣細胞取代，看不到白髓結節，並散布大小不一、形狀不規則的紅血球湖（blood lakes），符合毛細胞白血病侵犯脾臟。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small, evenly spaced mononuclear cells throughout the red pulp
Numerous irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes / pseudosinuses)
Absence of recognizable white pulp follicles in this field
Cells have pale cytoplasm imparting a lighter, spaced-out appearance at low power
Scattered small hemosiderin-like dark deposits
3738.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows effacement of normal architecture by a diffuse red pulp infiltrate of small, evenly spaced lymphoid cells with pale cytoplasm. Numerous irregular red cell lakes are distributed throughout, and white pulp follicles are not identified. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by hairy cell leukemia; higher-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, CD123, BRAF V600E) are recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows a micronodular white pulp–based infiltrate with marginal zone differentiation rather than diffuse red pulp with blood lakes.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also red pulp predominant, so annexin A1 negativity, CD25 negativity and wild-type BRAF are needed to separate it.
Congestion expands sinuses with red cells and fibrosis but lacks a monotonous neoplastic lymphoid infiltrate.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia involving spleen (low power) — diffuse red pulp infiltrate with numerous blood lakes and absent white pulp
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍題考「脾臟浸潤模式」：先看白髓是否還在、紅髓是否被取代，再指出散在的紅血球池（blood lakes），推到 HCL。
Blood lakes 並非 HCL 獨有，但紅髓瀰漫浸潤 + blood lakes + 白髓消失的組合在考題中高度指向 HCL；確認需 CD20、annexin A1、CD123、BRAF V600E（VE1）。
臨床連結：HCL 常有明顯脾腫大與全血球低下但少有周邊淋巴結腫大；過去以脾切除治療，現以 purine analog 為主。
Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma 亦侵犯紅髓，但為竇內（sinusoidal）分布的 CD3+ T 細胞，常 γδ TCR 並有 isochromosome 7q。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為充血性脾腫大；充血只是竇內充滿紅血球並纖維化，沒有單一形態的腫瘤淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤，HCL 則有均勻間隔的淡染細胞取代紅髓。

quiz.q: 這張低倍脾臟切片的浸潤是以紅髓還是白髓為主？散在的紅色池子叫什麼？
quiz.a: 紅髓瀰漫浸潤；blood lakes

3610.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆分葉核嗜中性球，細胞核分成 3–4 葉、以細絲相連並圍成環狀排列，染色質粗塊，細胞質淡粉紅並散佈細小紫色顆粒，無空泡或杜勒小體，是正常成熟的嗜中性球。
features: Cell about 1.5–2 times the diameter of an RBC
Nucleus with 3–4 lobes connected by thin filaments, arranged in a loose circle
Coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine to slightly prominent purple granules
No Döhle bodies or vacuoles
Adjacent red cells in a thicker area with a few platelets
3610.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a mature segmented neutrophil with a three- to four-lobed nucleus connected by thin chromatin filaments, coarse chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is pale pink with fine to slightly prominent granules, without Döhle bodies or vacuoles. Surrounding red cells overlap in a thicker area, and a few platelets are present. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are coarse and dark blue-black throughout the cytoplasm, usually with vacuoles or Döhle bodies, rather than fine purple granules.
A ring nucleus is a single continuous doughnut without separate lobes, whereas this nucleus is composed of distinct lobes joined by filaments.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes (or many five-lobed cells), not the three to four seen here.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature segmented neutrophil — 3–4 discrete lobes joined by thin filaments arranged in a loose circle, fine granules, no toxic change
pearls_zh: 考法：本張分葉排成環狀，考官會故意問「這是不是 ring nucleus（dysplasia）」；答不是，各葉分離、以細絲相連，屬正常分葉核。
嗜中性球分葉排列與抹片製作角度有關，判讀分葉時要確認葉與葉之間是細絲（segmented）還是寬帶相連（band）。
嗜中性球增多的鑑別：反應性（感染、類固醇、吸菸、無脾）vs 腫瘤性（CML、chronic neutrophilic leukemia 與 CSF3R 突變）；CNL 以成熟嗜中性球為主、幾乎沒有前驅細胞。
Leukemoid reaction 通常伴毒性顆粒與 Döhle body，而 CML 有 basophilia 與完整成熟譜系；正常形態的嗜中性球本身不能排除兩者，需看全片與臨床。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把環狀排列的分葉誤判為 dysplastic ring nucleus；環形核是一條連續核質中央有洞，本圖是多個分離的葉以細絲相連。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球的分葉排成一圈，為何不算 ring nucleus？
quiz.a: 各葉分離並以細絲相連，而非連續核質中央有孔

3674.recognize_zh: 視野中多數顆粒球（包括後骨髓球、帶狀核與分葉核嗜中性球）的細胞質布滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯粗黑，即為毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）；伴隨左移的未成熟顆粒球。
features: Granulocytes at multiple stages (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) with coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules
Granule density and staining intensity exceed normal secondary granules of mature neutrophils
Marked left shift with numerous myelocytes and metamyelocytes, suggesting marrow aspirate or buffy coat preparation
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuolization in a mature neutrophil
Scattered small lymphocyte and red cells with drying artifact
3674.describe_en: This cellular smear, likely a bone marrow aspirate or buffy coat preparation, shows predominantly granulocytic cells spanning myelocyte to segmented neutrophil stages. The maturing and mature neutrophils contain conspicuously coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation, with occasional cytoplasmic vacuolization. No increase in blasts, Auer rods, or dysplastic hypogranularity is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation in a left-shifted granulocytic population, as seen with infection, inflammation, or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Coarse azurophilic granules are present in all leukocytes including lymphocytes and monocytes and persist without inflammation, often with mucopolysaccharidosis.
Granules are few, giant, and irregular rather than numerous fine-to-coarse uniform granules.
Morphologically identical toxic granulation and left shift; separation depends on the history of growth factor administration.
Primary azurophilic granules are normal in promyelocytes but should not persist in bands and segmented neutrophils as seen here.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation — coarse dark purple granules in left-shifted neutrophils and precursors, with occasional vacuolization
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指分葉核或帶狀核中性球裡的粗黑顆粒，要答 toxic granulation，並指出同時存在 left shift。
機轉：成熟中性球中保留或異常染色的 primary（azurophilic）顆粒，反映感染、發炎或 G-CSF 刺激下加速的顆粒球生成。
常伴隨的毒性變化：Döhle body、細胞質空泡；中性球空泡化對細菌感染/敗血症較具提示性。
鑑別遺傳性顆粒異常：Alder-Reilly（mucopolysaccharidoses，各系白血球都有粗顆粒）、Chédiak-Higashi（LYST 突變，巨大顆粒）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨髓中正常 promyelocyte/myelocyte 本來就有深色 primary 顆粒，易被誤判為 toxic granulation；判斷應看分葉核、帶狀核等成熟中性球是否仍有粗黑顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中成熟中性球細胞質內的粗大深紫色顆粒稱為什麼？列出兩種常見原因。
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；細菌感染/敗血症、發炎或 G-CSF 治療。

3482.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見多個大而淡染、形狀相近的結節彼此擠壓排列，只被細纖維帶分隔，結節內缺乏淡暗分區與清楚套區，是濾泡性淋巴瘤腫瘤性濾泡「背靠背」的結構特徵。
features: Large, pale-staining nodules of similar size crowding the field
Back-to-back arrangement with thin fibrous septa between nodules
Absent or attenuated mantle zones and no light/dark zone polarity
Nodules composed of a monotonous-appearing population at this magnification
Small portion of colonic mucosa at upper left corner
3482.describe_en: At low power, the submucosa is replaced by large, pale, closely packed nodules of relatively uniform size separated by delicate fibrous bands. The nodules lack distinct mantle zones and show no germinal center polarization, and interfollicular areas are compressed. A small portion of colonic mucosa is present at the upper left. The architecture is suggestive of follicular lymphoma; cytologic grading and immunophenotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show dark/light zone polarization with tingible-body macrophages and have well-formed mantles.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells with irregular nuclei, often with naked germinal centers, and are cyclin D1 positive.
NLPHL nodules are larger and moth-eaten by scattered LP cells in a small B-cell background and lack the CD10+/BCL2+ neoplastic follicle phenotype.

3226.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片透明腔隙中有一團約十餘顆緊密堆疊、完整的橘紅色紅血球，右緣可見被推擠成新月形的組織球核，代表紅血球被組織球吞噬；周圍為紅血球前驅細胞豐富的骨髓。
features: Cluster of about a dozen intact, tightly packed orange-red erythrocytes
Crescentic, compressed histiocyte nucleus at the right edge of the cluster, indicating intracytoplasmic location
Additional red cell just outside the cluster within the same clear space
Surrounding cellular marrow with erythroid precursors (dense round nuclei) and occasional larger cells with open chromatin
Delicate histiocyte cytoplasmic membrane barely visible around the ingested cells
3226.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a histiocyte distended by a tightly packed cluster of intact erythrocytes, with its nucleus compressed into a crescent at the periphery. The histiocyte lies within a clear space, and the surrounding marrow is cellular with numerous erythroid precursors and occasional larger mononuclear cells. The delicate histiocyte cytoplasm is only faintly visible, so an intrasinusoidal red cell aggregate is a technical consideration, but the compressed peripheral nucleus supports phagocytosis. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis in a patient with acute EBV infection, requiring clinical correlation for HLH.

ddx.dx: Red cell aggregate within a sinusoid
ddx.vs: Intravascular red cells lack an enveloping cell membrane and a compressed histiocyte nucleus at the edge of the cluster.
Erythroblastic islands contain nucleated erythroid precursors around a central macrophage, not anucleate red cells inside it.
Siderophages contain amorphous golden-brown granules rather than discrete round red cells and stain with Prussian blue.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — histiocyte packed with intact erythrocytes, its nucleus compressed into a peripheral crescent
pearls_zh: 考法：組織球胞質很淡幾乎看不到，考官會問「怎麼證明紅血球在細胞內而非竇狀隙內」；答邊緣被擠壓成新月形的組織球核。
HLH-2004 標準中噬血現象可來自骨髓、脾臟、淋巴結或肝臟；單一次骨髓未見不能排除 HLH。
EBV 相關 HLH 常見 CD8+ T 細胞 EBV 感染；需驗 EBV DNA 並排除 chronic active EBV 與 EBV+ T/NK lymphoma。
HLH 是急症：高燒、全血球低下、DIC 樣凝血異常與多器官衰竭，確診前可視病情提早開始治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為竇狀隙內紅血球聚集；靠包覆的細胞膜與邊緣被擠壓的新月形組織球核確認為胞質內吞噬。

quiz.q: 此團緊密堆疊的紅血球邊緣可見新月形核，此發現支持什麼現象？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis（紅血球位於組織球胞質內）

3034.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織 H&E 呈多形性浸潤：小淋巴球、漿細胞、大量大型免疫母細胞，並可見分裂相與一個大型多核或雙核細胞，細胞大小呈連續光譜而非單一族群，是傳染性單核球增多症的組織學特徵。
features: Diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and large immunoblasts
Numerous immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli
Scattered large binucleate/Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Mitotic figures and apoptotic debris present
Continuous spectrum of cell sizes without a monotonous sheet
3034.describe_en: Sections of lymphoid tissue (lymph node or tonsil) show a diffuse, polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and many large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Occasional large binucleate cells resembling Reed-Sternberg cells, mitotic figures, and apoptotic bodies are present. The cells form a continuous spectrum of maturation rather than a monomorphic population. Findings are consistent with florid immunoblastic proliferation of infectious mononucleosis; EBER in situ hybridization and serology help confirm, and immunohistochemistry helps exclude lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is a monotonous sheet of large cells with architectural effacement and light-chain restriction, unlike this polymorphous, polyclonal immunoblastic proliferation.
cHL has CD15+/CD30+/CD45- HRS cells in an inflammatory background, whereas IM immunoblasts are CD20+/CD45+ and form a continuum with plasma cells.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which IM lacks.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis — florid polymorphous immunoblastic proliferation with plasma cells, mitoses and RS-like cells forming a continuous size spectrum
pearls_zh: 考法：低到中倍看到大量大細胞與分裂相，考官測你會不會誤判成淋巴瘤；答題要強調「polymorphous、continuous spectrum」。
IM 淋巴結常見特徵：副皮質區擴張、免疫母細胞增生、竇與濾泡部分保留、凋亡小體與漿細胞多。
EBV 經 CD21 感染 B 細胞；EBER ISH 陽性細胞大小不一。Kappa/lambda 呈多株性，有助排除 DLBCL。
臨床：發燒、咽炎、頸部淋巴結腫大、脾腫大；避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂；使用 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹。
年輕病人扁桃腺或淋巴結出現此圖像時，應先查 EBV 血清學，避免過度診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 DLBCL；DLBCL 為單一形態大細胞片狀取代架構且輕鏈限制，IM 則是小淋巴球、漿細胞與免疫母細胞混合的多株性增生。

quiz.q: 此切片大量免疫母細胞與分裂相，哪兩個特徵支持反應性 IM 而非 DLBCL？
quiz.a: 細胞多形性呈連續大小光譜（含漿細胞），且輕鏈多株性／EBER 陽性於大小不同細胞

2970.recognize_zh: 鐵染色高倍下，中央一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質含瀰漫藍色含鐵血黃素，並包住數顆紅色核的細胞，提示含鐵的噬血巨噬細胞；周圍散布藍色鐵顆粒。
features: Macrophage with diffuse blue hemosiderin-laden cytoplasm
Several red-counterstained nuclei enclosed within or overlying the macrophage, suggestive of engulfed cells
Extracellular clumps of blue iron nearby
Surrounding hematopoietic nuclei stained red by counterstain
Cytoplasmic detail limited by the iron stain
2970.describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant diffuse blue hemosiderin that appears to enclose several red-counterstained nuclei, suggestive of phagocytosed nucleated cells. Additional extracellular iron clumps are present nearby. Because the iron stain obscures cytoplasmic detail, true engulfment is best confirmed on a Wright-Giemsa smear. Findings are compatible with an iron-laden hemophagocytic macrophage as seen in hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Overlapping cells can mimic engulfment; Wright-Giemsa showing cells within vacuoles confirms hemophagocytosis.
Ringed sideroblasts are erythroblasts with perinuclear granules, not large macrophages with diffuse iron.
Iron overload shows increased macrophage iron without engulfed cells and with a history of transfusions.

2842.recognize_zh: 單顆大淋巴球有豐富淡藍色細胞質，內含數顆清楚的粗大嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核圓、染色質成熟，是教科書式的大顆粒淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte with low N:C ratio
Round to oval nucleus with mature, condensed chromatin; no nucleoli
Abundant pale to clear cytoplasm with a faintly basophilic rim
Several discrete coarse azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Background normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
2842.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an oval nucleus containing mature, condensed chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm containing scattered coarse azurophilic granules. Nucleoli are not seen. Surrounding red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; when these cells are persistently increased and clonal, the picture supports T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate them; clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation and persistence favor T-LGL leukemia.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are often more atypical with open chromatin and nucleoli, the patient is acutely ill and EBER is positive.
Myeloid cells have folded or lacy nuclei and more numerous fine granules, whereas an LGL has a round condensed lymphocyte nucleus with few coarse granules.

exam.answer_en: Large granular lymphocyte (supporting T-LGL leukemia when clonal and persistent) — abundant pale cytoplasm with discrete coarse azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：單顆細胞放大，考官要你說出「large granular lymphocyte」並指出 azurophilic granules；接著問其兩種譜系（cytotoxic T cell 或 NK cell）與如何區分（flow CD3、CD56、CD57）。
顆粒內含 perforin、granzyme B 與 TIA-1，IHC 在骨髓切片可顯示 intrasinusoidal linear clusters of CD8+/TIA-1+ cells，是 T-LGL 骨髓的特徵。
T-LGL 與 NK 型：T-LGL 為 CD3+/TCRαβ 多數，NK 為 surface CD3−、CD16+/CD56+，以 KIR restriction 推測克隆性。
STAT3 突變與 neutropenia 相關，且可作為克隆性的分子證據。
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia（EBV+、亞洲年輕成人、急性病程、常合併 HLH）型態可相似，但臨床極為凶險，必須區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 LGL 誤認為 reactive/atypical lymphocyte（細胞質嗜鹼性邊緣擁抱紅血球、無顆粒）或 monocyte；LGL 有清楚分散的紅紫色顆粒、染色質成熟、細胞質淡。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質內的紅紫色顆粒是什麼？其內含主要的細胞毒性蛋白舉兩例。
quiz.a: Azurophilic granules；perforin、granzyme B（或 TIA-1）

2778.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片在骨小樑之間可見淋巴聚集，其中有淡染的圓形中心（生發中心）被深色小淋巴球環繞，周圍仍有三系造血與巨核細胞，符合骨髓內反應性淋巴濾泡（germinal center）。
features: Hypercellular marrow between bony trabeculae with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
Central lymphoid aggregate containing pale-staining rounded zones (germinal centers)
Germinal centers rimmed by a darker cuff of small mantle-zone lymphocytes
Aggregates are well circumscribed and non-paratrabecular
No fibrosis or effacement of the surrounding marrow
2778.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, including scattered megakaryocytes, between bony trabeculae. A well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate contains pale-staining germinal centers surrounded by a darker cuff of small mantle lymphocytes. The adjacent hematopoietic marrow is not effaced. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with germinal center formation in the marrow, as can be seen in autoimmune disease or other chronic immune stimulation.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma typically forms paratrabecular aggregates that lack well-formed germinal centers with polarity and tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-positive.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma aggregates are often multiple, larger, poorly circumscribed or intrasinusoidal and composed of a monotypic B-cell population.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with a mixed inflammatory background and CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells rather than an organized follicle.

2522.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，細胞密密麻麻鋪成一整片，幾乎看不到脂肪空泡，右上方為較稀疏的血液區，顯示骨髓細胞量明顯增加（hypercellular）。
features: Low-power field with densely packed nucleated cells forming a continuous sheet
Near absence of fat vacuoles within the cellular area
Thinner hemodilute zone with scattered cells at the upper right
Darker thick areas at the edges where cells overlap
Lineage composition and cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
2522.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a densely cellular spread with sheets of nucleated cells and minimal fat, with a thinner hemodilute area at the upper right. The field indicates a hypercellular aspirate. Lineage composition, maturation and the presence of blasts or abnormal populations cannot be evaluated at this magnification and require high-power review and a differential count. Cellularity should be confirmed on the core biopsy; hypercellularity alone is nonspecific and may be reactive or neoplastic.

ddx.vs: Acute leukemia shows a monotonous blast population on high power, whereas reactive hypercellularity retains orderly trilineage maturation.
MPNs show panmyelosis with abnormal megakaryocytes and driver mutations, which cannot be distinguished at this power.

ddx.dx: Thick smear area of a normocellular aspirate
ddx.vs: Crowding at the thick end of a smear can mimic hypercellularity, so cellularity should be judged from particles and the biopsy.

2394.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿各階段顆粒球（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、桿狀核為主），夾雜含深紫黑色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球與幾顆藍色細胞質、細緻染色質的芽細胞/早幼粒細胞；CML 背景下嗜鹼性球與芽細胞增多提示加速期。
features: Hypercellular smear with granulocytic predominance at all stages (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented forms)
Basophil-lineage cells with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus (lower left and scattered)
Several larger immature cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm (blasts/promyelocytes), not forming sheets
Occasional hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger-like neutrophils
Scattered free granules from ruptured cells in the background; very few erythroid precursors
2394.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with all stages of maturation, predominantly myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and bands. Basophil-lineage cells with coarse dark granules are readily identified, and several larger immature cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and basophilic cytoplasm consistent with blasts and promyelocytes are present without forming sheets. Erythroid precursors are sparse. An exact blast and basophil percentage cannot be established from a single field; in a patient with known BCR::ABL1-positive CML, increased basophils (≥20% in blood) and blasts (10–19%) would support accelerated phase/high-risk disease features.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase has <10% blasts and <20% basophils in blood; the distinction rests on quantitative counts, cytogenetic evolution and clinical findings rather than single-field morphology.
Leukemoid reaction shows toxic granulation without absolute basophilia, has high LAP score, and is BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with little or no basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1, often with SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.

1818.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見許多比周圍造血細胞大數倍的組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色且帶纖維狀條紋（像皺褶的薄紙），核小而偏位，成群散布於骨髓顆粒中，為高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells）。
features: Numerous very large histiocytes clustered within the marrow particle
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, eccentric, round to oval nuclei, some cells multinucleated
Background of normal hematopoietic cells, including a megakaryocyte (bottom center)
Abundant erythrocytes in the aspirate background
1818.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows numerous large histiocytes clustered within marrow particles. These cells have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with a fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper appearance. Background trilineage hematopoiesis, including a megakaryocyte, is present. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; the diagnosis of Gaucher disease should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar, but occur with an underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity; mycobacteria-laden histiocytes are AFB-positive.
Foam cells have uniformly vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm and sea-blue lipid rather than fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes contain coarse blue-green granules of ceroid rather than a wrinkled fibrillar cytoplasm.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio, atypical nuclei and prominent nucleoli.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher cells — clusters of large histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei and fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm in marrow particles
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍考官問「這些大細胞是什麼？缺什麼酵素？」答 Gaucher cell；glucocerebrosidase（β-glucosidase）缺乏，glucosylceramide 堆積於巨噬細胞。
遺傳：GBA1 突變，體染色體隱性；type 1（非神經型）最常見，表現脾腫大、血球低下、骨病（Erlenmeyer flask deformity、骨壞死）。
確診靠白血球或 dried blood spot 的酵素活性測定加 GBA1 基因檢測，骨髓形態只是線索。
特殊染色：Gaucher 細胞 PAS 陽性、tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase 陽性，常帶鐵染色陽性。
治療：enzyme replacement therapy（如 imiglucerase）或 substrate reduction therapy（如 eliglustat）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 pseudo-Gaucher cells（CML、myeloma、thalassemia、MAC 感染）；形態可幾乎相同，區分靠背景疾病、酵素活性正常，MAC 則抗酸染色陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質呈皺摺薄紙樣的大型組織球是什麼？堆積的物質與缺乏的酵素為何？
quiz.a: Gaucher cell；glucosylceramide（glucocerebroside）堆積，缺乏 glucocerebrosidase。

1626.recognize_zh: 綠色對比染色背景中，一個卵圓形生發中心內的細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，邊界清楚，外圍外套區與濾泡間區則為陰性；中心內散在的白色空洞為巨噬細胞，符合正常生發中心標記（如 CD10）的染色樣式。
features: Sharply circumscribed oval follicle center with brown membranous staining of most cells
Stronger staining toward one pole of the germinal center
Scattered unstained clear spaces within the center (tingible body macrophages)
Negative surrounding mantle and interfollicular zones with green counterstain
Specific antigen not identified in the image
1626.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a green counterstain shows a sharply circumscribed oval germinal center in which most cells show brown membranous staining, somewhat stronger toward one pole, while the surrounding mantle and interfollicular zones are negative. Unstained clear spaces within the center correspond to tingible body macrophages. The antigen is not specified; the pattern is typical of a germinal center B-cell marker such as CD10. Findings are consistent with a normal reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: In FL, CD10 highlights crowded neoplastic follicles and often also interfollicular neoplastic cells, and the follicles lack tingible body macrophages and polarization.
FDC markers show a dendritic lacy network rather than crisp membranous staining of individual lymphoid cells.

1434.recognize_zh: 這是骨髓抹片的細胞化學染色（外觀像 PAS），多顆圓形、小至中型的前驅細胞呈深洋紅色瀰漫陽性，旁邊較大的細胞只淡染；在 MDS 中，紅血球前驅細胞 PAS 陽性代表紅系發育異常。
features: Cytochemical stain without a strong counterstain; red cells stain pale tan-pink
Numerous small to medium round nucleated cells with intense, diffuse magenta positivity, morphologically suggestive of erythroid precursors
Larger cells with oval or folded nuclei show only weak, pale staining
Positivity appears diffuse/granular rather than coarse block-like at this resolution
Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail is poorly resolved, limiting lineage assignment
1434.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with a cytochemical stain, most likely periodic acid-Schiff (PAS), shows numerous small to medium round nucleated cells with intense diffuse magenta positivity, morphologically suggestive of erythroid precursors, while larger cells with oval nuclei are only weakly stained. Detailed nuclear and cytoplasmic morphology cannot be assessed on this stain and the image resolution is limited. PAS positivity in erythroid precursors is an abnormal finding that supports dyserythropoiesis and is consistent with the stated diagnosis of myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia when accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages on Romanowsky-stained smears.

ddx.vs: Shows a predominance (>80%) of erythroid precursors, mostly proerythroblasts, often with coarse globular PAS positivity, rather than a mixed population.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with block PAS positivity
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts show coarse block-like PAS granules on a negative cytoplasmic background and are confirmed by CD19/TdT flow cytometry.
These may show faint erythroid PAS positivity but lack clonal cytogenetics and multilineage dysplasia.
Megaloblastic precursors are typically PAS negative and show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony that corrects with B12/folate replacement.

60506.recognize_zh: 核為偏心的圓至卵圓形、無凹陷，染色質有粗塊聚集而無明確核仁，細胞質豐富偏藍並布滿細小的粉紅／淡紫色顆粒，是骨髓細胞（myelocyte）。
features: Large cell, over twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Eccentric round-to-oval nucleus without indentation
Moderately condensed chromatin with a few coarse chromatin clumps; no definite nucleoli
Abundant, slightly basophilic cytoplasm filled with fine pink-lilac secondary granules and a small clear area
Background red cells with mild crenation of a few cells
60506.describe_en: High-power smear shows a large granulocytic precursor with an eccentric round-to-oval nucleus lacking indentation. The chromatin is moderately condensed with a few coarse clumps, and no definite nucleoli are seen. The cytoplasm is abundant and slightly basophilic, containing numerous fine pink-lilac secondary granules. Findings are consistent with a myelocyte, which in peripheral blood indicates a left shift or marrow stress/infiltration.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have finer chromatin with nucleoli, a perinuclear hof and coarse dark azurophilic granules.
Metamyelocytes have an indented, kidney-shaped nucleus with more condensed chromatin.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm and a paranuclear hof.

exam.answer_en: Neutrophilic myelocyte — eccentric round nucleus without indentation, condensed chromatin without nucleoli, abundant cytoplasm with fine pink-lilac granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官要你依「核形、核仁、顆粒種類」三步驟排序 myeloblast → promyelocyte → myelocyte → metamyelocyte → band → seg，並指出這顆的位置。
判別口訣：核仍圓無凹陷＝myelocyte；凹陷小於核寬一半＝metamyelocyte；凹陷超過一半＝band。
周邊血見 myelocyte 合併 nucleated RBC 與 teardrop cells（leukoerythroblastosis），要想到骨髓纖維化或骨髓浸潤。
骨髓抹片中 myelocyte 是正常顆粒球系中比例較高的階段之一；比例明顯減少或成熟停滯需考慮藥物、感染或腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 plasma cell：plasma cell 較小、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質深藍無顆粒並有明顯核旁淡染區；myelocyte 細胞質含大量細小粉紅紫色 specific granules。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞核圓無凹陷、無核仁、細胞質有細小粉紅紫色顆粒，名稱為何？在周邊血出現代表什麼？
quiz.a: Myelocyte；left shift（感染、G-CSF、骨髓浸潤或 MPN）

90.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內成片、帶腎形或馬蹄形核（hallmark cells）的大型多形性細胞，細胞質豐富且呈泡沫狀，背景有嗜中性球與嗜酸性球；免疫染色 CD30 呈強膜狀加高基氏體（Golgi）陽性、CD4 與細胞毒性標記（TIA1、granzyme B、perforin）陽性，但 CD3、CD20、PAX5 為陰性，符合 ALK 陰性 ALCL（本組未附 ALK 染色，ALK 陰性需由案例資料確認）。
features: Sheets and cohesive clusters of large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm
Eccentric kidney- and horseshoe-shaped nuclei (hallmark cells) with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli; occasional multinucleated forms
Admixed neutrophils and eosinophils; low power shows partial nodal effacement adjacent to a sclerotic, fibrotic area
CD30 strong, uniform membranous and Golgi-dot staining of the large cells, in cohesive clusters
Large cells CD4+, GATA3 nuclear+ in many cells, and cytotoxic granule proteins TIA1, granzyme B and perforin positive
Large cells negative for CD3, CD20, PAX5 and CD8, which stain only background small lymphocytes
90.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show partial effacement of the architecture by a diffuse and cohesive infiltrate of large atypical cells, bordering a sclerotic area. At high power, the neoplastic cells have abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and pleomorphic, eccentric kidney- and horseshoe-shaped nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli (hallmark cells), with admixed neutrophils and eosinophils. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells show strong, uniform membranous and Golgi CD30 expression and are positive for CD4, GATA3 (subset), TIA1, granzyme B and perforin, while CD3, CD20, PAX5 and CD8 highlight only background reactive lymphocytes. An ALK stain is not included among these images; with ALK negativity documented in the case, the findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-negative, and FISH for DUSP22 and TP63 rearrangements is recommended for risk grouping.

ddx.vs: Morphology and the CD30+/cytotoxic phenotype overlap; ALK-positive ALCL shows nuclear/cytoplasmic ALK staining (e.g., NPM1::ALK) and typically occurs in younger patients, so an ALK stain is required.

cHL has scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background that are PAX5 dim-positive, CD15+ and lack cytotoxic markers, whereas here the CD30+ cells form sheets and are PAX5-negative with TIA1/granzyme B/perforin expression.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS usually shows heterogeneous, variable CD30 staining and retains pan-T antigens such as CD3, whereas ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 in hallmark cells with frequent loss of CD3.
The cohesive clusters can mimic a non-hematopoietic tumor, but these cells are CD30+/CD4+ with cytotoxic granules and would be keratin- and S100/SOX10-negative.

90.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD3, CD4, CD8, GATA3, TIA1, GrB, perforin
captions: H&E, low power: nodal parenchyma with partial effacement bordering a sclerotic, fibrotic area
H&E, intermediate power: sheets of larger pale atypical cells alongside a residual small-lymphocyte area
H&E, high power: large pleomorphic cells with foamy cytoplasm, horseshoe-shaped nuclei and admixed neutrophils
H&E, high power: hallmark cells with eccentric kidney-shaped nuclei and prominent nucleoli, with scattered eosinophils
CD20: staining limited to a background B-cell population; the large neoplastic cells are negative
PAX5: nuclear staining of scattered background B cells only; tumor cells negative
CD3: positive background small T cells; the large atypical cells lack CD3
CD30: strong membranous and Golgi staining of cohesive clusters of large cells
CD4: diffuse membranous positivity of the large neoplastic cells
CD8: only scattered small reactive T cells positive; tumor cells negative
GATA3: nuclear staining in many of the neoplastic cells
TIA1: granular cytoplasmic positivity in the large cells
Granzyme B: granular cytoplasmic positivity in a subset of large cells
Perforin: strong cytoplasmic staining of the large neoplastic cells

exam.answer_en: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-negative — cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30, CD4+ and cytotoxic markers, loss of CD3
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指腎形/馬蹄形核、核旁嗜酸區的 hallmark cell 問名稱，或問 CD30 膜狀＋Golgi 點狀陽性的意義。
ALCL 常失去 CD3 等 pan-T 標記，但保留 CD4、cytotoxic（TIA1、granzyme B、perforin）、EMA；ALK 陰性要靠 ALK IHC 確認。
ALK− ALCL 建議 FISH 查 DUSP22 與 TP63 重排作分層；DUSP22 重排者常缺 cytotoxic 標記、LEF1 陽性。
一線治療 brentuximab vedotin + CHP；乳房植入物相關 ALCL（BIA-ALCL）為獨立 entity，不要混為一談。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為古典何杰金淋巴瘤：cHL 的 HRS 細胞散在於混合背景、CD15+、PAX5 弱陽性；ALCL 為黏聚成片、竇內生長、PAX5 陰性且帶 T/cytotoxic 表型。

quiz.q: 圖中核偏心呈馬蹄形、核旁有嗜酸區的大細胞稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Hallmark cell（ALCL 特徵細胞）
